text: "'Every key has its lock' sounds much grander than when we say that every spanner has its nut. But both remain true." — Serena Blackwood
translation: 「『每把钥匙都有它的锁』,听起来可比『每把扳手都有它的螺母』气派多了。但两者都依然成立。」 ——塞蕾娜·布莱克伍德

text: "'Our company it was that shattered it,' Ghirbi says suddenly. He begins again to weep his molten tears..." — Conversations at the Stag Door
translation: 「砸碎它的正是我们会社,」吉比尔突然说道。他再度流下熔融的泪水…… ——《牡鹿之门的闲谈》

text: "...and then she says, 'but then why does the Form have four ends?"' [Pause for laughter]
translation: “……然后她说:『那为什么“形态”有四个末端?』”[停一停,等笑声]

text: "...and then she says, 'but why lamb?"' [Pause for laughter]
translation: “……然后她说:『可为什么是羔羊?』”[停一停,等笑声]

text: "...he lays up the deep in his house of lights."
translation: 「……他把深渊,收存在自己的光之屋中。」

text: "A guest should not come empty-handed."
translation: 『客人不该空手登门。』

text: "A thief of sights, a scavenger of thrones; a border-reaver and a thief of knots; a thief of colours and a thief of bones." — Mischiefs of the Aviform Hours
translation: 「盗目光之贼,掠王座之贼;犯边之贼,解结之贼;盗色彩之贼,盗骸骨之贼。」 ——《鸟形司辰的恶作剧》

text: "Did you hear this one yet? A [[Crucian]] walks into a bar in Berlin..."
translation: “这个笑话你听过吗?一个[[介壳种]]走进柏林的一家酒吧……”

text: "Each hour has its colour - each flame has its fuel."
translation: 『每个时辰有它的颜色——每簇火焰有它的燃料。』

text:
"Flint is gone; but her facets echoed each a separate Star. When the Forge is ashes, Flint shreds what remains." - attr. Thomas Dewulf

What's left of Spencer has surrendered to the night. Perhaps he'll descend into Nowhere. Perhaps he'll close his eyes and open the gates of his spirit. Whatever his hollow flesh does next, it won't be our story.

This is not a positive ending.
translation:
「燧石已逝;但她的每一道棱面都曾各自回响着一颗独立的星辰。当铸炉化为灰烬,燧石便撕碎残存的一切。」——归于托马斯·德伍尔夫

斯宾塞残余的部分已向黑夜投降。也许他会坠入虚无之地。也许他会闭上双眼,打开灵魂之门。无论他那空空的躯壳接下来会做什么,那都不再是我们的故事。

这不是一个好结局。

text: "For behold, the Sun offers the waters of the sea as from a ewer..."
translation: 「因为看哪,太阳献出海水,如自执壶中倾出……」

text:
"Hours don't dream. Long try not to."

Mortals who gained immortality through devotion to a [[Principle]], in service to an [[Hour]], are called Long. Most were formerly counted among the [[Know]]. Possibly some were never mortal.

Few remain. Those with dead or [[Uncounted]] patron [[Hours]] are now '[[remortals]]'.
translation:
「司辰不做梦。长生者努力不做。」

因信奉某项[[准则]]、侍奉某位[[司辰]]而获得永生的凡人，被称为长生者。他们大多曾被视为[[知者]]之列。也许有些从来就不是凡人。

如今所剩无几。那些庇护[[司辰]]已死或被[[除名]]的，如今是『[[长生者]]』。

text: "Light reveeals, light blinds." For almost two thousand years, the Church of the Unconquered Sun has claimed to be the only true nterpreter of Eternity's light. But even the Church cannot claim dominion over  sight.
translation: 「光揭示一切，光令人目盲。」近两千年来，不败之日教会一直声称，自己是永恒之光的唯一真正阐释者。但即便是教会，也无法宣称自己能主宰视界。

text: "Mercy," saith the [[Watchman]], "is found only in shadow." But he does not say that mercy is nowhere found; and shadows lie long here.
translation: 「仁慈，」守夜人言道，「唯在阴影之中方能寻得。」但他并未说仁慈无处可寻；而此地的阴影，绵长地铺展着。

text: "My heart is not my own." I've heard that phrase. But, pilgrim, you mean something different, yes? I thank you.
translation: 「我的心已不是我自己的。」我听过这句话。但,巡礼者,你说的不是那个意思,对吧?我谢谢你。

text: "Not all doors are wounds; but every wound is a door." A place to call on powers that would be forbidden elsewhere.
translation: 「并非所有的门都是伤口；但每一道伤口都是一扇门。」一处召唤他处禁绝之力的地方。

text:
"One, Great, and Free." The Caudillo in Madrid has made good on the first boast, but the other two are nowhere within reach. Still, things may be looking up for this kingless kingdom. The Darlan regime in the French [[State]] has opened the border again. The [[Incorporates]] are ready to overlook old sins in the fight against [[Icarianism]]. The  frost begins to thaw.

Spain stayed out of the Wars - it has less need of [[Gleam]] or [[Corona]] - and there is something else here - a high host that visits select doors in the deep night. The scent of burning wax goes before it.
translation:
「统一、伟大、自由。」马德里的考迪罗兑现了第一句豪言,但另外两句依旧遥不可及。不过,这个没有国王的王国,境况或许正在好转。法兰西[[邦国]]的达尔朗政权重新开放了边境。[[集团]]在对抗[[伊加利亚主义]]的战争中,愿意宽恕旧日的罪愆。霜冻开始消融。

西班牙置身于战争之外——它对[[烁]]或[[冕]]的需求较少——而这里还有别的什么:一支高贵的行列,在深夜里造访特定的门扉。燃烧的蜡香先它而至。

text: "Speech is a Wound; Silence is Silver. There is no Silver Door, nor can there be, even in the Moon's House…"
translation: “言语是一道创口；沉默是白银。白银之门并不存在，也不可能有，纵在月之居屋中……”

text: "Thank U Chi"
translation: 「谢谢小池」

text: "That sweet city, with her screaming choirs" (Crispin)
translation: “那座甜蜜的城市，以及她尖叫的合唱团。”（克里斯宾）

text:
"The Stars are pinpricks. The Sun is a wound. Behind them, above them, Eternity." - Sereno Blackwood

What's left of Spencer has surrendered to the light. Perhaps he'll cross the Sea to the great radiances of joyous commerce. Perhaps he'll dry into rags and rise flapping like a kite into the Sun. Whatever his hollow flesh does next, it won't be our story.

This is not a positive ending.
translation:
「群星不过是针孔。太阳是一道伤口。在它们之后,在它们之上,是永恒。」——塞蕾娜·布莱克伍德

斯宾塞残余的部分已向光芒投降。也许他会渡过大海,前往喜乐贸易的煌煌光辉。也许他会干枯成破布,像风筝一般拍打着升入太阳。无论他那空空的躯壳接下来会做什么,那都不再是我们的故事。

这不是一个好结局。

text: "The sun is a cut throat", the night recites.
translation: 「骄阳是道割开的喉咙」，夜色如此吟诵。

text: "There are common sentiments in every thunderclap. Let us acknowledge them." — A Thunderous Secret
translation: 「每一记雷霆之中都有共通的情感。让我们承认它们。」 ——《轰雷的秘密》

text: "There is never only one History."
translation: 「历史从来不止一条。」

text:
"To the conception of the imperishable, the immortal, we oppose, in art, that of becoming, the perishable, the transitory, and the ephemeral." - Marinetti

[[Eternity]] was always and clearly the real deal. History was a jumble of shadows cast by the [[Glory]], a necessary confusion to be reconciled into one ultimate truth. Anyone who argued otherwise, like [[Coseley]], was mocked as an anarchist or a [[Worm.]] That's shifted, since the Wars.

Traditionally, there were five great Histories, all true, and a thousand demi-real branches. How were they reconciled?
translation:
“在艺术中，我们用变化、易逝、短暂与瞬时的概念，来对抗不朽与永恒的概念。”——马里内蒂

[[永恒]]始终且明确是真实之物。历史不过是辉光投下的纷乱阴影，是一种必要的混乱，终将被调和为唯一的终极真理。任何持异议者，如[[科赛利]]，都会被嘲笑为无政府主义者或蠕虫。自大战以来，这种情况已经改变了。

传统观点认为存在五重伟大历史，皆是真实不虚，此外还有数千条亦真亦幻的分支。是什么调和了它们彼此间的矛盾？

text: "Welland." Of course. He usually went by 'Captain', but it's definitely him. There are photos in the [[Bureau]] records - of a man whose features had hardly changed since the time of this painting.
translation: “韦兰。”当然。他通常被人称作“船长”，但肯定是他。[[防剿局]]档案里有照片——那人的面容，自这幅画的时代以来几乎毫无变化。

text: "What is within, without; what is without, within."
translation: 「内即是外;外即是内。」

text:
"When the Sun-in-Splendour was divided, its Names fractured too." 

The Names of the [[Hours]], are their major servants, or aspects, or emanations. Some, perhaps all, Names were previously [[Long]].

[[Mansus]]-spirits often like to tell gullible mortals they're Names. Who's going to quibble?
translation:
「当骄阳被分割，它的尊名也随之碎裂。」

[[司辰]]的尊名，是它们主要的仆从、面向或流溢。有些尊名——也许全部——先前都是[[长生者]]。

[[漫宿]]的灵体常常喜欢对轻信的凡人自称尊名。谁会去计较呢？

text: ''The Moth, the Grail, and the Egg Unhatching all tell different stories of the world's beginning. One of those stories is the oldest, but it may not be the first.' - Abbess Nonna, [[Abbey of St Brandan]]
translation: 『飞蛾、赤杯与逆孵之卵，对世界的开端各有各的讲述。其中一则故事最为古老，但它也许并非最先。』——诺娜院长，[[圣布伦丹修道院]]

text: ''The oldest and strongest emotion of mankind is fear, and the oldest and strongest kind of fear is fear of the unknown.' - Lovecraft
translation: 『人类最古老、最强烈的情感是恐惧，而最古老、最强烈的恐惧，是对未知的恐惧。』——洛夫克拉夫特

text: ''Wit's forge and fire-blast, meaning's press and screw.' - Coleridge, 'On Donne's Poetry'
translation: 『机智的锻炉与火风，意义的压机与螺钉。』——柯勒律治，《论多恩的诗》

text: 'A curse.'
translation: “诅咒。”

text: 'A few days.' How long, exactly?
translation: 「几天。」具体是多久？

text: 'A questing knight. Yes. I like that.
translation: “一位行侠的骑士。”不错。我喜欢这个说法。

text:
'A ridged barrier of blood-streaked horn, huge enough for a ship to pass. It was broken long ago, and even now the scars are not quite healed.'

The Stag Door is the Adept's Gate. To pass it is to be <link="Know">initiated</link> into the first true mystery of the <link="Mansus">House of the Sun</link>.

I used to go there, in my higher dreams, when I was younger. And then again, when I was away from the world. I got to know its guardian pretty well.
translation:
『一道由染血兽角构成的棱脊屏障，大得足以容一艘船通过。它早已被打碎，即便如今，那些伤疤也尚未完全愈合。』

牡鹿之门是学徒之门。通过它，便是被<link="Know">接引</link>进<link="Mansus">太阳居屋</link>的第一个真正奥秘。

我年轻时，常在更高的梦境里去那里。后来，当我离开人世的时候，又去过。我同它的守护者相当熟稔。

text: 'Absence of evidence is not evidence.' There is still room for optimism, Aristide.
translation: 『证据的缺席不是证据。』总还有乐观的余地，阿里斯蒂德。

text: 'And though his flesh was hollow, her eyes were opened!'
translation: 「“他的肉身虽已空乏,她的眼睛却睁开了!”」

text: 'Antibes. Before War came to the World, this was the sweet blue eye of the Riviera. Yachts and parties and film-star villas. Picasso painted Pierrots, here by the sea...'
translation: “昂蒂布。在战争降临世界之前,这里是里维埃拉湛蓝温柔的眼眸。游艇,派对,影星的别墅。毕加索在海边画下皮埃罗……”

text: 'As above, so below,' an old friend used to say when he came back from seeing a man about a dog.
translation: '如其在上,如其在下,'一位老友每次办完一桩语焉不详的差事回来,总爱这样说。

text: 'Behind your own image is a secret chamber with a beast-image...'
translation: 「在你自身影像的背后，有一间秘室，秘室里藏着野兽之像……」

text: 'Believe'? It's true, or it isn't true. And in dreams, nothing is untrue.
translation: 「相信」？事情要么是真的，要么不是。而在梦中，没有什么是假的。

text: 'Beneath the skin of the world we find the Mansus, also called the World-Spine, also called the House of the Sun. Above the House is the [[Glory]], the origin of light, to which souls aspire. At the foot of the House, and around its walls - though it has no walls - is the [[Wood]].'
translation: “在世界表皮之下,我们寻得漫宿——亦名世界之脊,亦名太阳居屋。居屋之上是[[辉光]],光的源头,众灵魂所向往者。居屋脚下,环绕四壁——虽说它并无墙壁——是那[[木材]]。”

text: 'Black market'. It's a diffuse concept, is it not? Of course one makes certain... informal transactions. But nothing that would interest the authorities.
translation: 「黑市。」这是个含混的概念，不是吗？当然，人难免会做某些……非正式的买卖。但绝无会让当局感兴趣的事。

text: 'Blessed are those who died in earth incarnate.'
translation: 「“那些死于大地化身之中的人,有福了。”」

text: 'Blood is a very special sap.'  (Goethe)
translation: “血液是一种非常特殊的液体。”（歌德）

text: 'Bright as a mirror, bright as fresh snow, bright as the migraine moon'
translation: “明亮如镜子，如新雪，如弯月”

text: 'Buffoon?'
translation: 「蠢货」?

text: 'Burning summers; icy winds; never masters of the science of sailing by light' (García Márquez)
translation: “……那里的夏天酷热，冬天寒风刺骨，居民也从未掌握借光航行的技艺。”（加西亚·马尔克斯）

text: 'But we must use the knife,' said the Lion-Throned One, 'the noose, the flame, the Waking Word, against those who have passed the Three-Valved Door. And so none may pass: that is our Law, and the Law of the Sun.'
translation: 「但我们必须动用刀锋,」狮座者说,「用绞索、烈焰与唤醒之言,来对付那些已穿过三重门扉者。因此无人得以通过:那是我们的律法,也是太阳的律法。」

text: 'By Heaven, Sir, we shall have no Cigars in the Library, and yet we shall have no House without a Smoking-Room.'
translation: 『天哪，先生——图书馆里决不能有雪茄；可一座宅邸又怎能没有吸烟室。』

text: 'Daphne.'
translation: 《达芙妮》。

text: 'Die together, live alone.'
translation: 「同死容易，独活难。」

text: 'Disappointment is the nurse of wisdom...'
translation: 「失望是智慧的乳母……」

text: 'Dr Sinombre'?
translation: “西诺姆布尔医生”?

text: 'Dreamers and the Dead pass the White Door, but they must abandon their shapt, that part of the soul which speaks - like a key in the door, or a sword outside a king's hall.' The White Door is the lowest point of access to the [[Mansus]]. When I was young, even uninitiated dreamers might visit it by accident. It is much too dangerous for that now.
translation: 「梦者与亡者皆可穿过白门，但他们必须舍弃自己的声魂——灵魂中会言语的那一部分——如同插在门上的钥匙，又如留在王殿门外的利剑。」 白门是通往[[漫宿]]的最低入口。我年轻时，连未经启蒙的梦者也可能在无意间造访那里。如今那已太过危险。

text:
'Fire,' I read once, 'is the winter that warms and the spring that consumes.`

The Hour we called the Forge of Days is Uncounted now, but Forge is still the  [[Principle]] that transforms and destroys.
translation:
「火,」我曾读到,「是温暖的冬天,是吞噬的春天。」

我们称之为白日铸炉的那位司辰如今已除名,但铸仍是那转化与毁灭的[[准则]]。

text: 'Frida Kahlo'. I hadn't heard of her. Is this a self-portrait? That face painted on her brow. Does he rule her? Or has she captured him?
translation: 「弗里达·卡罗」。我没听说过她。这是自画像吗?她眉间画着的那张脸。是他支配着她?还是她俘获了他?

text: 'Friend'?
translation: “朋友”?

text: 'Gentleman'?
translation: 「绅士」？

text:
'Gentlemen perspire, ladies glow, horses sweat.' Ergo, I'm not sweating. But I'd be slightly more comfortable in something lighter.

[A lighter Outfit would provide a small bonus.]
translation:
「绅士冒汗,淑女泛光,马儿淌汗。」所以说,我没有出汗。不过穿得更轻便些,我会更舒服一点。

[更轻便的行头会提供小幅加成。]

text: 'God save us always,' I said, 'from the innocent and the good.'
translation: 「愿上帝永远保佑我们,」我说,「远离那些天真无辜与良善之人。」

text: 'Good evening, Jeremy.'
translation: “晚上好,热雷米。”

text: 'Guess who!'
translation: 「猜猜我是谁!」

text: 'Guest'. And what if I want to leave?
translation: 「客人。」那，要是我执意离开呢？

text: 'Hollow of spirit and brazen of heart,' she said. And that you would open her eyes.
translation: 「魂灵空虚,心坚如铜,」她这样说过。还说,您会睁开她的眼睛。

text: 'Hour.' You believe in these 'Hours'? These 'secret gods'?
translation: 「司辰。」你相信这些「司辰」？这些「隐秘之神」？

text:
'Human work cannot exceed the Divine, so the Sagrada Familia will be 170 metres high, 3 metres less than the mountain of Montjuic.' (Gaudí)
'I think the Anarchists showed bad taste in not blowing it up when they had the chance.' (Orwell)
translation:
“凡人的建筑不能超越神圣的创造，因此圣家族大教堂的高度将是170米，比蒙特惠奇山矮3米。”（高迪）
“我认为无政府主义者当时有机会炸掉它却没动手，实在品味不佳。”（奥威尔）

text:
'I knew a man who captured moths in a bell-jar. On nights like this, he would release them one by one to die in the candle.'

 Moth is the wild and perilous  [[Principle]] of chaos and yearning. Are its [[Hours]] [[Uncounted]], or only altered? Moth is not to be expected.
translation:
「我认识一个人,把飞蛾捉进钟形罐。在这样的夜晚,他会把它们一只一只放出来,任其死在烛火里。」

蛾是混沌与渴望的[[准则]],狂野而危险。它的[[司辰]]们已[[除名]],抑或只是改变了?蛾不可预料。

text: 'I never knew the old Vienna before the war with its Strauss music, its glamour and easy charm. Constantinople suited me better. I really got to know it in the classic period of the black market. We'd run anything if people wanted it enough...' (Greene)
translation: “我从未了解过战前那古老的维也纳——那里有施特劳斯的音乐、迷人的魅力与安逸的氛围。君士坦丁堡更适合我。我真正了解的是它鼎盛时期的黑市风貌。只要人们足够想要，并且有钱支付，我们就会走私任何东西……”（格林）

text: 'I'll see you next decade.'
translation: 「我们十年后再见。」

text: 'If it were possible to do away with dreaming altogether - if only it were possible - '
translation: “如果可以彻底消除做梦——要是真的可以就好了——”

text: 'In loving one now dead, we arrive pure at the glaciers of memory. We are fortified for life...'
translation: 「“爱一个如今已死的人,我们便能纯净地抵达回忆的冰川。我们由此为一生筑起壁垒……”」

text: 'In the name of the [[Beach-Crow]], who opens the earth, who sees what is lost...'
translation: “以[[滩鸦]]之名——祂开启大地，祂看见失落之物……”

text: 'In the name of the [[Ivory Dove]], who cannot be deceived, who calls each of the Dead by name...'
translation: “以[[骨白鸽]]之名——祂不受欺瞒，祂逐一唤出每一位死者之名……”

text: 'In the secrecy of the polling booth, Heaven sees you -  the Advisor doesn't.' The Eternal City has chosen Corona, not Gleam... for now.
translation: 「在投票间的隐秘之中,天堂看得见你——顾问却看不见。」永恒之城选择了冕,而非烁……至少目前如此。

text: 'Incorporate drink...'
translation: 「集团的饮料……」

text: 'It is better to be both loved and feared.'
translation: 『既被爱又被畏惧，才是更好的。』

text: 'It is better to be feared than loved, if you cannot be both.'
translation: 『若不能两者兼得，被畏惧好过被爱。』

text: 'Land of Hope and Glory.'
translation: 《希望与荣光之地》。

text: 'Liberty, Equality, Fraternity'. The Third Republic fell to the [[Enemy]] in 1940. When the war ended, the Fourth Republic rose from its ashes... but the south of France remains in the manly grasp of the [[State]].
translation: “自由、平等、博爱”。第三共和国于1940年沦陷于[[敌人]]之手。战争结束后，第四共和国从它的废墟中崛起……但法国南部仍牢牢掌控在[[邦国]]手中。

text: 'London, whose grubby bosom is the repository of so many odd secrets. Discreet, incurious and all-enfolding London.' (Sayers)
translation: 伦敦，它那肮脏的胸膛里藏着如此之多的离奇秘密。谨慎、漠不关心而又包容万象——这就是伦敦。（塞耶斯）

text: 'Mademoiselle'?
translation: 「小姐」？

text: 'My duty is to heal my patients. But my methods are my own'
translation: “我的职责是治愈我的病人。但我的治疗方法可是我自创的”

text: 'My friend.' We were never really introduced.
translation: 「我的朋友。」我们其实从未正式结识。

text: 'No thing in or beneath Heaven hath only one Nature, and no thing that hath two Natures may keep one from joining with another; therefore I say unto you, that even the [[Wolf Divided]] is forgotten not by the [[Sun]].'
translation: '天上地下,无物只具一性;凡具两性之物,不能阻其一与另一相合;因此我告诉你们:即便是[[裂分之狼]],也不为[[太阳]]所遗忘。'

text: 'No',' Picasso said, 'you did'.
translation: “不,”毕加索说,“是你们画的。”

text:
'O sages standing in God's holy fire 
As in the gold mosaic of a wall,
Come from the holy fire, perne in a gyre,
And be the singing-masters of my soul.'
- Yeats


How do we feel about hierarchy? About consistency? About splendour? Think about perfection. All the [[Hours]] touch Eternity, but no Hour has embraced it, because In Eternity, all [[Histories]] are flattened to a single truth, forever.
translation:
「啊,圣贤们,伫立于上帝的神圣之火中,
如金色壁面上的镶嵌画,
自圣火中降临,盘旋入旋涡,
做我灵魂的歌唱之师。」
——叶芝


我们如何看待层级?如何看待始终如一?如何看待辉煌?想想完美吧。所有[[司辰]]都触及永恒,却没有一位司辰拥抱过它,因为在永恒之中,一切[[历史]]都被压平为唯一的真理,直至永远。

text:
'Only a million people can help a million people. But one person can help one person.'

A [[Passion]].

[Gentle or empathetic conversation choices often count as Compassionate.]
translation:
『一百万人只能由一百万人来帮助。但一个人可以帮助一个人。』

一种[[激情]]。

[温和或富有同理心的对话选择通常属于「悲悯」。]

text: 'Passion' - intuition, the hidden rivers which flow beneath the soul.
translation: “激情”——直觉，那些奔流于灵魂之下的隐秘河流。

text: 'Posters for poetry, newspapers for prose'
translation: “诗歌海报，散文报刊”

text: 'Reincorporation is essentially impossible', [[Stanislav]] warned me. It was so unpleasant that I found myself wishing it was entirely impossible.
translation: 『[[复归]]在本质上是不可能的』，[[斯坦尼斯拉夫]]警告我。那过程难受得让我几乎盼望它彻底不可能。

text:
'Rescue' lets you use your [[Aspect Pool]] to snatch success from the jaws of failure.

Spending pips exhausts them, so you can't rescue every success -but pips refresh whenever you act with a matching [[Passion]].

It's easier to rescue a near miss than a bad failure!
translation:
「挽回」让你动用[[性相池]]，从失败的牙缝里夺回成功。

花掉点数，点数便会耗尽，所以你无法挽回每一次成功——但只要以相符的[[激情]]行事，点数就会恢复。

挽回一次差之毫厘的失败，总比挽回一次惨败容易！

text: 'Rodia...'
translation: 「罗迪娅……」

text: 'Rose'? 'Pomegranate'?
translation: 「玫瑰」?「石榴」?

text: 'Serena Blackwood' surely can't be her original name. But I never asked. I didn't want to reopen any old wounds.
translation: 「塞蕾娜·布莱克伍德」想必不是她的本名。但我从未问过。我不愿再揭开任何旧伤。

text: 'She said... you would open her eyes.' But the saint's eyes in the window are open. What did Jaume mean?
translation: 「“她说……你会睁开她的眼睛。”可彩窗里,圣徒的眼睛是睁着的。若梅是什么意思?」

text: 'Silence is silver. Speech is a wound.'
translation: 「沉默是银,言语是伤。」

text: 'Silence is silver.'
translation: “沉默是金。”

text:
'So grand, so solemn, so vast! And yet so delicate, so airy, so graceful!' (Twain)
'The Cathedral is an awful failure...everything is vile in it.' (Wilde)
translation:
“如此雄伟，如此庄严，如此伟大！而又如此精致，如此空灵，如此优雅！”（马克·吐温）
“这座大教堂是个可怕的失败……里面的一切都糟糕透顶。”（王尔德）

text:
'Socrates,, having walked about, when he said that his legs were growing heavy, lay down on his back... he said that when the poison reached his heart, he would leave us.'

In Europe, since the Wars, there's no shortage of deaths, but this is among the gentler ones.
translation:
『苏格拉底，走动一番之后，说他的双腿渐渐沉重，便仰面躺下……他说，当毒药抵达心脏时，他就要离开我们了。』

战争以来的欧洲从不缺少死亡，但这算是其中比较温和的一种。

text: 'Speech is a shadow of truth; but by our shadows we are discovered.'
translation: 「言语是真理的影子;而我们,正是凭自己的影子被人认出。」

text: 'Spencer Hobson.'
translation: 『斯宾塞·霍布森。』

text: 'Spencer Hobson: multiple entries Germany, US Zone of Occupation'. A single sheet of paper, enlivened with the flaming-sword stamp.
translation: 「斯宾塞·霍布森：可多次入境德国美国占领区」。一张单页纸，加盖着那枚火剑印章，显得神气活现。

text: 'Spencer Hobson: multiple entries Italian Republic, Free Territory of Trieste'. A single sheet of paper, enlivened with the flaming-sword stamp of Supreme Headquarters Allied Expeditionary Force.
translation: 「斯宾塞·霍布森：可多次入境意大利共和国、的里雅斯特自由区」。一张单页纸，加盖着盟军远征军最高司令部的火剑印章，显得神气活现。

text: 'Spencer...'
translation: 「斯宾塞……」

text: 'Sylvain Huissier'. But hush! I'm under cover.
translation: 『西尔万·韦西耶』。可别声张！我在执行秘密任务。

text: 'Sylvain...
translation: 「西尔万……」

text: 'The Church,' once wrote the magus Julian Coseley, 'makes sinners of saints and saints of dogs.' He had a point.
translation: 「“教会,”术士朱利安·科斯利曾写道,“把圣徒变成罪人,把狗变成圣徒。”他说得在理。」

text: 'The City of Light', they called it, before the war
translation: 战前,人们称它「光之城」

text: 'The Light of the World.' Holman Hunt's controversial but radiant depiction of the Shepherd-Illuminate as the [[Watchman]]'s avatar.
translation: 「世界之光。」霍尔曼·亨特那幅备受争议却光辉夺目的画作，将启明之牧者描绘为[[守夜人]]的化身。

text: 'The Pilgrim Rose - S Hobson.'
translation: '朝圣玫瑰——斯·霍布森。'

text: 'The Pilgrim Rose.'
translation: 「“朝圣玫瑰”。」

text: 'The Serenity of the Black [[Wood]]' is an odd allegory about the [[Vagabond]] leading travellers part-way through a wood before she abandons them. That feels relevant
translation: 《黑[[木材]]之静》是一则古怪的寓言:[[浪游旅人]]领着旅人穿过林中一程,然后弃他们而去。这似乎与当下有些相干。

text: 'The Sheaf'
translation: 《禾捆报》

text: 'The Thunderskin.'
translation: 「轰雷之皮。」

text:
'The Wood lies outside the walls of the [[Mansus]]. As any student of Histories knows, the Mansus has no walls.'

Christopher said that - Christopher Illopoly. He was always a little glib. But it does capture something about the Wood.
translation:
「木材位于[[漫宿]]的墙垣之外。凡研习历史者皆知，漫宿并无墙垣。」

这话是克里斯托弗说的——克里斯托弗·伊洛波利。他向来有几分油滑。不过，这话确实抓住了木材的某种特质。

text:
'The art that alters' - alchemy, pyrotechnics, metallurgy.

One of the [[Bright Arts]], used at Hearths and in Holy Places. Ithastry can be used for any alchemy recipe, although at a slightly higher difficulty level than more specialist skills.
translation:
'改变之艺'——炼金、烟火、冶金。

属[[光之技艺]]之一,用于炉边与圣洁之地。盗火术可用于任何炼金配方,尽管难度略高于更专门化的技艺。

text: 'The best-dressed man in the Bureau', they used to call me. I hardly dared look in the toilet mirror.
translation: 「防剿局里穿着最考究的人,」他们从前这样叫我。如今我几乎不敢看洗手间里的镜子。

text: 'The black market is a CRIME'
translation: 「黑市是犯罪」

text: 'The gate to its temenos is a beast-image in the hidden chamber of the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui...'
translation: “通往其圣域的门扉,是今日疗养院密室中的一尊兽像……”

text:
'The green wealth in the world's veins, the tiny price of the old redder lower Sun, the bursting Grail-joy: all these are blood.'

Some rites of the [[Arts Unconsidered]] require the shedding of blood with an instrument that has never before tasted blood. In another age, this is one reason that adepts continued to use flint rather than iron.
translation:
「世界脉络中的绿色财富,旧日那位更红、更低的太阳的微薄代价,迸发的杯之欢愉:这些都是血。」

[[未识技艺]]的某些仪式,须用一件从未尝过血的器具来放血。在另一个年代,这正是修士们始终用燧石而不用铁器的原因之一。

text:
'The hands and space of hyacinth / Paling in the confines of the Ghetto /  Almost do not exist for the quiet man / Who dreams a shining labyrinth.'
(Borges, 'Spinoza')
translation:
“双手与风信子蔚蓝的天空
/在犹太区的边际褪成朦胧
/对于这沉静的人仿佛不存在
/他正梦见一座明亮的迷宫。”
（博尔赫斯，《斯宾诺莎》）

text: 'The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be undivided, thy whole body shall be full of light'.
translation: 「眼睛就是身体的灯:所以,你的眼睛若合一,全身就充满光。」

text: 'The roots go deep. The knots remain.'
translation: 「根须深扎，结子难解。」

text: 'The whole night listened to the flute of Nectaire. Already the evening star was rising above the paling horizon.' (Anatole France)
translation: “黑夜聆听着内克泰尔的笛声。昏星已然升起，悬在泛白的地平线上方。”（阿纳托尔·法朗士）

text: 'There's no such thing as bad weather - only bad clothes'. In this outfit, I'm Snug.
translation: 「世上没有坏天气,只有坏衣服。」穿着这身行头,我感觉暖融融的。

text: 'They do their murdering - wrapped in the colours of OUR FLAG!'
translation: 「他们杀人——裹着我们国旗的颜色！」

text: 'This establishment affirms and can prove that it HAS NEVER BEEN OPEN'.
translation: '本店郑重声明,并可以证明:本店从未营业'。

text:
'Tho much abides... much is taken.'

A [[Passion]].

[Choices which acknowledge regret are Sorrowful. So, usually, is a choice to remain silent.]
translation:
『虽仍有许多留存……更多已被夺去。』

一种[[激情]]。

[承认遗憾的选择属于「悲伤」。通常，选择沉默也是。]

text: 'To Live – To each following his needs'. It has a certain appeal.
translation: “生活——各取所需。”这个理念确有其吸引力。

text: 'To Work  – From each following his strengths.' I found it inspiring, sometimes.
translation: “劳动——各尽所能。”有时我确实觉得它振奋人心。

text:
'Travelling at night is neither faster nor safer. That's why we do it.' - Christopher Illopoly

Knowledge of the ways and byways of the transmundane. One of the [[Night Arts]], usable at Thresholds and Wounds.
translation:
'夜行既不更快,也不更安全。正因如此,我们才夜行。'——克里斯托弗·伊洛波利

关于界外之境的通途与僻径的学问。属[[夜之技艺]]之一,可用于门关与受创之地。

text: 'Turn on the dark, I'm afraid of the light'
translation: “让黑暗降临，我害怕光。”

text: 'Vichy water!' crows the nearest card-player.
translation: 「维希水！」最近的那位牌客得意地嚷道。

text: 'Warsaw can no more be Tartar than Venice can be Teuton. Kings lose their pains and their honor in the attempt to make them so.'(Hugo)
translation: “华沙不会永远属于鞑靼人，正如威尼斯不会永远属于条顿人。君王们枉费心机，只是徒然污损了自己的声誉。”（雨果）

text: 'What Fresh Hell Is This'
translation: 「这又是什么新地狱」

text:
'Whatever is ephemeral is only a metaphor' - Goethe

[Whenever you travel, each stack of Ephemeral items will lose one item]
translation:
「一切易逝之物,不过是譬喻」——歌德

[每次旅行时,每叠易逝之物都会失去一件。]

text: 'Why?' When did I ever care about 'why'?
translation: 「为什么」？我几时在乎过「为什么」？

text: 'Work, Family, Homeland'. When the French Third [[Republic]] fell, the rump government in the south joined forces with the [[Enemy]], preserving a kind of independence as l'État français. As the [[Enemy]] retreated, the State switched sides and joined the [[Allies]]. So where does this leave us now? With De Gaulle and [[Darlan]] rattling sabers across a new-carved border between a rump Fourth Republic and an authoritarian, para-fascist State.
translation: “劳动、家庭、祖国”。当[[共和国]]陷落后，南方残余政府与[[敌人]]结盟，以l'État français（法兰西邦国）的名义保留某种独立。随着[[敌人]]撤退，邦国又转而加入[[盟军]]，再次试图维持独立。那么如今这局面又将我们置于何处？ 戴高乐与[[达尔朗]]在新划定的边界两侧剑拔弩张，一边是残缺的第四共和国，一边是威权而准法西斯的邦国。

text: 'Worm of Worms: My Portrait', Julian Coseley, 1924 (oil, panel)
translation: 《蠕虫中的蠕虫：我的肖像》，朱利安·科赛利，1924年（油画，木板）

text: 'You can get quite a nice sandwich on the black market' was perhaps not the intended reading.
translation: 「你可以在黑市上买到一块相当不错的三明治」大概不是这句话的本意。

text: 'You don't know me. But you'll remember me.'
translation: 「你不认识我。但你会记住我。」

text: 'You people'?
translation: 「你们这些人」？

text: 'Your Candleflame'? 'Let Me Be Forgotten?'
translation: 「你的烛焰」?「让我被遗忘」?

text: 'Your outer self'. We will talk more about that later. But for now, tell me the dream.
translation: 「你的外在自我。」这个我们稍后再详谈。眼下，先讲那个梦。

text: '[[Elegiast]].' I am not especially familiar with these esoteric doctrines.
translation: 「[[悼歌诗人]]。」我对这些秘传教义并不特别熟悉。

text: '[[Henad]]', is it. No, you've lost me. Father.
translation: “[[太一]]”，是吧。不，你把我绕晕了。神父大人。

text: 'all we have left is the place the attachment to the place / we still rule over the ruins of temples spectres of gardens and houses /if we lose the ruins nothing will be left' (Herbert)
translation: “我们剩的只有这土地，对这土地的眷恋 / 我们仍统治着神庙的废墟，花园与房屋的幽灵/若连这废墟也失去，我们便一无所有”（赫伯特）

text: 'le mot de Cambronne' - I'm being flexible
translation: “康布罗纳的那个词” - 我会灵活处理

translation: (迷人的小东西。)

translation: (方头。)

text: (I thought I'd locked the door. That's odd. But never mind.)
translation: (我以为我锁了门。真奇怪。不过,算了。)

text: (I wrote five of these things. Pseudonymously. They sold much better than my real work.)
translation: (这样的东西,我写过五本。用的是笔名。它们比我署真名的作品卖得好多了。)

text: (I'm a dog person, really.)
translation: (其实我是爱狗之人。)

text: (Ididn'twanttoseeyourpapersanyway.)
translation: （反正我也不想看你的证件。）

translation: (其实它们还出过法语和德语译本。我忘了——法德两国的出版商,是挂在霍布森名下出版的。)

translation: (没有困住的生灵,黑夜回荡着。)

translation: (哦不。)

translation: （这家伙口袋里装着海胆。）

translation: (我唯一出版过的剧本。伊洛波利使了些手段。)

text: (They let this thing run loose? Well, if I don't get too close, it probably can't attack.)
translation: (他们让这东西到处乱跑?好吧,只要我别靠太近,它大概伤不了我。)

translation: (确实会。我轻率地、毫不隐晦地写了隐世。首演之夜,[[防剿局]]查封了演出。我侥幸没进监狱。)

text: ... I don't know. It's unknowable. So I don't know.
translation: ……我不知道。它是不可知的。所以我不知道。

text: ... again and again over the years. The isle remained a place of healing and learning.
translation: ……这些年来,一次又一次。这座岛始终是疗愈与学问之地。

text: ... and a packet of Bonanza cigarettes. The dollars will be accepted everywhere in Western Europe. The cigarettes, everywhere there's a black market.
translation: ……还有一包博南萨香烟。美元在西欧各地通用。香烟,则凡有黑市之处皆可通行。

text: ... and then she clears it from her face with the casual briskness of a woman sweeping a curtain closed.
translation: ……然后她将这笑容从脸上抹去，动作随意而利落，如同一位妇人顺手拉上窗帘。

text: ... but lost.
translation: ……却已失落。

text: ...I don't recall. It can be difficult to understand writing in dreams.
translation: ……我不记得了。梦中的文字本就难以辨认。

text: ...Jean-Bernard is right. The Stars are wrong.
translation: ……让-贝尔纳说得对。群星出了差错。

text: ...Philomèle is right. The blood on the Sun is the blood of the secret gods.
translation: ……菲洛梅尔说得对。太阳上的血，是隐秘诸神的血。

text: ...achieve.
translation: ……成之。

text: ...actually, never mind.
translation: ……罢了,当我没说。

text: ...adepts collect reputations.
translation: ……修士收集名声。

text: ...and I can't stand it; and I can help.
translation: ……而我无法袖手旁观；而我力所能及。

text: ...and every moment we spend to relieve it is a moment spent well.
translation: ……而我们为缓解它付出的每一刻，都算没有虚度。

text: ...and there probably always will be.
translation: ……而且以后大概也还会有。

text: ...and you're trapped in a scrine, here in the Wake, because someone back in the Mansus has destroyed your scrineway. No fulgent would risk staying this long in a scrine of something as impermanent as ice.
translation: ……而你被困在醒界的一座圣龛里,因为漫宿之中,有人毁掉了你的龛道。没有哪个辉耀者,会冒险在一座以冰这种无常之物制成的圣龛里,逗留这么久。

text: ...anything by Spencer Hobson?
translation: 「……有没有斯宾塞·霍布森写的书?」

text: ...as you say.
translation: ……就依您所言。

text: ...bah.

text: "But surely it would have been a pity not to have seen the trees along this road, really exaggerated in their beauty... —Never to have studied history in the weak calligraphy of songbirds' cages." - Elizabeth Bishop, 'Questions of Travel' Visit a travel zone - at a station - to move to a neighbouring city. Things to bear in mind: - Travelling is a good way to shed [[Traces]]. - Traces remain on the route you used, but fade as I travel further. - To cross national frontiers, I'll need travel documents. Acquiring them is an important part of progressing the story. - A few inaccessible-seeming destinations can be reached by other means.

text: "And the players were robed and their faces veiled, and the robes and veils were alike, and their names were Fate and Chance." - Lord Dunsany, Time and the Gods What's random, what's fair? If you roll a ten-sided die a hundred times and get a 1 every time, is that fair? Yes, says Chance; no, says Fate (or the other way around). You can roll a die a hundred times and get the same result every time. So Travelling doesn't use dice - it draws tokens, each numbered 1 to 10, from a bag. (Bone tokens, says one player; no, silver, says the other.) When the bag is empty, we put the tokens back in and shake the bag. There's more than one tile with each number, so you can get the same number a few times in a row. But your luck will always turn. "Then said Fate to Chance: "Let us play our old game again." And they played it again together, using the gods as pieces, as they had played it oft before. So that those things which have been shall all be again..." When you reload after a save, we always put all the tokens back in and shake it. This means, bluntly, that you can save-scum. It also means that if you keep reloading, everything will be a little more random. We might add a config switch to turn that off.
translation: 「棋手们身披长袍,面覆纱巾,长袍与纱巾别无二致,他们的名字,是命运与机缘。」——邓萨尼勋爵,《时间与众神》 什么是随机,什么是公平?你若把一枚十面骰掷上一百次,每次都掷出 1,这算公平吗?机缘说,公平;命运说,不(或者恰好相反)。 你确实可能连掷一百次骰子,而每次结果都一样。所以Travelling不用骰子——它从布袋里抽取筹码,每枚编号 1 至 10。(骨质筹码,一位玩家说;不,银质的,另一位说。)布袋空时,我们便把筹码放回去,摇一摇布袋。每个数字都不止一枚筹码,所以你有可能接连几次抽到同一个数字。但你的运气终会流转。 「命运于是对机缘说:『让我们再玩一次那旧日的游戏吧。』于是他们重又一同对弈,以诸神为棋子,一如从前无数次那样。于是,凡曾经存在过的事物,都将再度存在……」 每当你读取存档,我们总会把全部筹码放回去,再摇一摇。直白地说,这意味着你可以读档投机。这也意味着,如果你一直读档,一切都会变得更随机一些。我们或许会加一个配置开关,将其关闭。

text: 'One has no talent. I have no talent. It's just a question of working, of being willing to put in the time.' - Graham Greene Every Skill is linked to three Aspects. This tells you something about the Skill and the world. It also allows you to use matching points from your [[Aspect Pool]] to get a better outcome when use of a Skill goes badly. Passing a Skill check will give you matching [[Experiences]]. Failing a Skill check gives you more experiences - but also a matching [[Trouble]]. You can improve Skills with those [[Experiences]]. A virtuous circle, though not a perfect one.

Agio, the fee charged for exchanging currency. Wonderfully, it's derived from the italian aggio, meaning 'comfort' or 'ease'. The merchant is charging a fee for your comfort and ease. Whenever you pay in a non-native currency, a merchant will charge you agio - about fifteen per cent, but they'll round down.

text: The Carapace Cross is gone. Into earth; into flesh; and the travelling-kinds, beyond wave and sky. They are very few now under the earth, and the Cross-in-flesh are us - some of us, at least... The hybridity which we called the 'Carapace Cross' was gone, long and far. Their nature survived only in some bloodlines, and perhaps in the darkness beyond the sky. But since the wars...
translation: 介壳种已然离去，隐没于大地；隐没于血肉；而远行诸族，则越过了波涛与天空。大地之下现在已经鲜有它们的踪影，而我们是隐于血肉中的介壳种——至少我们中的一些如此…… 我们称之为“介壳种”的混种生物已然离去，长久而悠远。他们的本性只在少数血脉中幸存，也许还有些幸存于天外的黑暗里。但自从那场战争之后……

text: The Church denies that the Forge of Days split the Sun. Most adepts reject their denial. Converts two Lantern Memories to one Forge Memory, with an existing Winter Memory as a catalyst.
translation: 教会否认白日铸炉劈裂了太阳。多数修士都不信教会的否认。 将两条灯之回忆转化为一条铸之回忆,以一条已有的冬之回忆作为催化。

text: The Sheaf, from today. An excellent State paper.
translation: 「禾捆报,今天的。一份极好的邦国报纸。」

text: This is how such a cat would prefer to be touched.
translation: 这样才是这种猫喜欢的摸法。

text: This one changes the date... this switches to an unorthodox numbering schema... and this sets an alarm. Which might be useful.
translation: 这个按钮改日期……这个切换到一种非正统的计数法……而这个设闹钟。说不定用得上。

text: Vive les Américains.
translation: 美国人万岁。

text: Voilà.
translation: 就是这个。

text: Worldly skills are essential in conversation, dealing with people and real situations. They don't need preparation.
translation: 世俗技艺在交谈、与人周旋和应对现实情境时不可或缺。它们无需预备。

text: Yes, darling. Tailed life with a ridged nervous highway down your backs. Fish, birds, lions, you. In Ys, a tail is a novelty.
translation: 是的,亲爱的。有尾的生命,背脊上贯着一条隆起的神经大道。鱼、鸟、狮子,还有你。在伊苏,尾巴可是新奇之物。

text: from whom nothing more can be taken; who cannot be deceived; who calls the dead by name. Sometimes called the Ivory Dove. Not the kindest of the [[Aviform]] [[Hours]], but never cruel. He's always remembered what the world forgets. [[Long]] who ascend under the Elegiast have been called 'ghouls'. This isn't very nice, but they do in fact break open graves to feast on the memories of dead flesh.
translation: 被剥夺至无可剥夺之神 不受欺骗之神 唤亡者以姓名之神 也被称为骨白鸽。他不是[[鸟形]][[司辰]]中最温和的，但他从不残忍。他总是铭记世界遗忘之物。 在悼歌诗人麾下飞升的[[长生者]]被称为“食尸鬼”。这不算是个好听的称呼，但他们确实会打破陵寝以饱食尸体中的记忆。

text: from whom we do not turn; who is exposed; whose beauty is unmatched The [[Uncounted]] [[Hour]] who once appeared in [[Church]] iconography as the White Lady, the Glass Virgin that protects mothers. Sometimes described as the Sun's night-self.
translation: 我们不得背对者; 毫无遮掩者; 美艳无可匹敌者 那位[[除名]]的[[司辰]],曾以白衣圣母、护佑母亲的玻璃贞女之姿出现在[[教会]]的图像中。有时,她被描述为太阳的夜之身。

text: he unmaketh; he unmaketh; he unmaketh. When the [[Sun]] died, the [[Hour]] called Wolf Divided was born, in agony, to rage. But the Sun has not died only once; he's risen many times. When did the Wolf Divided come into the world? Any answer is a tangle of heresies. In worse times, you could be put to the question for naming a year. Even today, this is one of the fiercest differences between the Received and Sanctioned versions of the Book of Suns.
translation: 他拆解； 他拆解； 他拆解。 [[太阳]]死时，名为裂分之狼的[[司辰]]在剧痛与狂怒中降生。但太阳并非只死过一次；他已复活了许多回。裂分之狼究竟是何时降临此世的？ 任何回答都是一团异端乱麻。在更糟的年代，你哪怕只说一个年份，都可能被拖去受刑。即便今日，这也是《太阳之书》通行本与钦定本之间最激烈的分歧之一。

text: which burns still; which is distant; which is not as it was.. The chilliest constituent of the [[Sun]]. The Sun-in-Rags, descending towards its final sunset, offered us its beautiful ending. Sometimes, as it did in the beginning, it would accept a very little of our blood. A dead [[Hour]]; dead and buried.
translation: 仍在燃烧者; 已然遥远者; 不复旧日模样者.. [[太阳]]最寒冷的部分。残阳,正坠向它最后的日落,将美丽的结局奉予我们。有时,一如最初那样,它会接受我们少许的鲜血。 一位已死的[[司辰]];死去了,也埋葬了。

text: who are pearl who cannot be touched who cannot be separated An [[Aviform]] [[Hour]] bringing together what must be together. Sometimes, trusted. The enemy of division and separation.
translation: 身为珍珠者; 不可触碰者; 不可分离者 一位[[鸟形]][[司辰]],将必须同在之物聚合一处。有时,也受人信赖。是分裂与分离之敌。

text: who bears two blades; who permits passage when passage is to be permitted; who waits at the threshold. No [[Hour]] is young, but the Horned-Axe is very old indeed. She's survived at least three wars in the [Sun].
translation: 身负双刃者; 于当放行之时放行; 守候在门槛之处。 没有哪位[[司辰]]年轻,但角斧确实年迈至极。她已在[太阳]中熬过了至少三场战争。

text: who cannot be exhausted who cannot be stayed who tells her story to the willing and the unwilling The one [[Hour]] who was excluded from the [[Mansus]] - though before the war, many adepts expected to follow her there as one of seven [[Pilgrims]], and rise above. One of the [[Aviform]] Hours - she took the shape of a laughingthrush. [[Uncounted]] now. Perhaps.
translation: 不可被耗尽 不可被留住 向甘愿者与不甘愿者讲述她的故事 她是唯一一位被逐出[[漫宿]]的[[司辰]]——尽管战前，许多修士曾期望化作七位[[巡礼者]]之一随她而入，并超升其上。她是[[鸟形]]司辰之一——化作一只笑鸫的模样。如今已[[除名]]。也许。

text: who cannot be separated who cannot be touched who are pearl [[Aviform]] [[Hour]] uniting what is at rest. Born from two wombs. The enemy of disjunction and distinction.
translation: 不可被分开 不可被触及 她们是珍珠 [[鸟形]][[司辰]]，使安息者合而为一。生于两具子宫。是分离与区分之敌。

text: who cannot be unbalanced; who quells and quiets; who comes before the Sun The [[Uncounted]] [[Hour]] who once appeared in [[Church]] iconography as the Radiant Lady, the Mater Solvens invoked when a corpse is committed to fire or earth.
translation: 不可撼动者; 镇伏且静默者; 先于太阳而来者 那位[[除名]]的[[司辰]],曾以辉耀圣母之姿出现在[[教会]]的图像中,当尸体交付火焰或大地之时,人们便向解缚圣母祈求。

text: who cannot harm you; who cannot find you; who always has what you desire. The Flowermaker, born from the sparks of delight of the [[Forge of Days]], fallen like seeds into shadowed soil. The Flowermaker offered us the glittering prizes we most desired - even when our desires were concealed from us. A dead [[Hour]]; dead and buried.
translation: 无法伤害你者; 无法寻见你者; 始终拥有你所渴求之物者。 制花人,诞生于[[白日铸炉]]的欢愉火花,如种子般落入阴影之土。制花人曾将我们最渴望的璀璨奖品奉上——即便那些渴望,对我们自己也秘而不宣。 一位已死的[[司辰]];死去了,也埋葬了。

text: who demands the dance; who cannot be stilled; who is beaten, like a drum. The Thunderskin, the Heart Relentless, the Vigilant Storm, which beat and was beaten to preserve the skin of the world. The mortal who loved the goddess; the flayed god sacrificed by its lover to itself. Without his ceaseless efforts, how long could the world have turned untorn? A dead [[Hour]]; dead and buried.
translation: 要求舞蹈者; 无法止息者; 被敲打者,如一面鼓。 轰雷之皮,不倦之心,警醒的风暴——为守护世界的皮膜而击打,亦被击打。那位爱上女神的凡人;那位被爱人剥去皮、由爱人献祭于己身的神。若没有他永不停歇的劳作,这世界又能完好地转动多久? 一位已死的[[司辰]];死去了,也埋葬了。

text: who navigates; who illuminates; who is not compassionate The [[Uncounted]] [[Hour]] who once lit the way for the willing and unwilling. He has been called the Door in the Eye. "Behold, I stand at the door, and though I do not knock, it is here I may be heard."
translation: 他引航； 他照明； 他无悲悯。 他本是[[除名]]的[[司辰]]，曾为甘愿者与不甘愿者照亮前路。他一度被称为「瞳中之门」。「看哪，我站在门前；虽不叩门，却正是在此，我方可被听见。」

text: who remakes with fire; who ends what will not change; who ends all nights
translation: 以火重塑者; 终结不变之物者; 终结所有夜晚者

text: who sees what is lost; who opens the earth; to whom belongs what is not possessed. Sometimes called the Beachcomber. Of all the [[Aviform]] [[Hours]], perhaps the most straightforward in his motivations - to unearth, and sometimes to keep, what is lost . But he's also the one of whom least is known for certain. He guards his secrets carefully, as the affair of the [[Lark]] recalls. His most acquisitive [[Name]], Crooky, likes to wear even the shapes that others abandon. [[Long]] who ascend under the Beach-Crow are misers, pirates, archaologists, philatelists, who achieved their estate by thieving treasures from their predecessors. 'Daws', they've been called, and 'grubbers'.
translation: 它看见失落之物； 它掘开大地； 不属于任何人的，皆归它所有。 有时也被称作拾滩鸦。在所有[[鸟形]][[司辰]]中，他的动机或许最直白——掘出失落之物，有时将其据为己有。但他也是人们对他的确知最少的一位。他小心守护着自己的秘密，[[百灵鸟]]那桩旧事便是明证。他最贪得的尊名克罗基，甚至喜欢披上别人抛弃的形态。 在滩鸦之下飞升的[[长生者]]，是守财奴、海盗、考古学家、集邮家，靠窃取前辈的珍宝而成就其家业。人们称他们为『寒鸦』和『掘土者』。

text: À bientôt.
translation: 回头见。

translation: <size=60%>（虚无主义者。）</size>

text: A  [[Principle]] of exploration - enlightenment - hope? Nine directions to new horizons. Here are [[Hours]] that wingèd rise.
translation: 探索的[[准则]]——启迪——希望?九个朝向新地平线的方向。此处有展翅升起的[[司辰]]。

text: A very bad book? Never mind, then.
translation: 一本非常坏的书?那就算了。

text: A very little sin. And I'm sorry that I've come to you in this sordid way. Tell me what I need to know, and we need never speak of it again.
translation: 一个非常微小的罪过。我也抱歉，以这般不光彩的方式来找你。告诉我我想知道的，我们便再也不用提起此事。

text: A Farewell to Arms
translation: 《永别了,武器》

text: A Few Minutes
translation: 几分钟

text: A Fine and Private Place
translation: 一处精致的私密所在

text: A Greek name. I half-remember the word... rose? Pomegranate? Possibly?
translation: 一个希腊名字。我依稀记得那个词……玫瑰?石榴?也许吧?

text: A Little Help
translation: 一点帮助

text: A Little Safety
translation: 一点安全

text: A Matisse? Yes; it's signed. The subject is clearly someone he desired; or at least loved. Perhaps only someone he had to follow?
translation: 一幅马蒂斯?是的,上面有签名。画中人显然是他渴望过的什么人;至少,是他爱过的。也许,只是他不得不追随的什么人?

text: A Midnight Mark can [[Quell]] or [[Wither]] - unlocking conversation choices that require those Aspects. It'll also give a bonus to Skills when placed in an Active slot. Be careful - whatever you do with it, it's a one-use item.
translation: 午夜印记可以[[镇伏]]或[[凋零]]——解锁需要这些性相的对话选项。放入活跃栏位时,它还会为技艺提供加成。小心——无论你拿它做什么,它都是一次性物品。

text: A Mountain Lake?
translation: 山中之湖？

text: A NO PARKING sign directly between two parked cars. Darlan's grip is not irresistible.
translation: 一块「禁止停车」标牌，正夹在两辆停着的车之间。达尔朗的掌控并非无懈可击。

text: A Plan in the Journal has hints on how to do this.
translation: 日记里的计划,有关于如何做到的提示。

text:
A SPINE-CHILLING tale of a RENEGADE PRIEST whose KNIFE IS THIRSTY FOR INNOCENT BLOOD.

I wrote this under the name 'Meredith Lux', but here is it under the name 'Spencer Hobson'. Spine-chilling is right. It's painful even to look at the cover. But at least as long as I have it, there's one fewer copy in circulation.
translation:
一个令人脊背发凉的恐怖故事：一位背教神父，他的刀渴望无辜者的鲜血。

这本书是我用「梅雷迪斯·勒克斯」这个笔名写的，可如今它却署着「斯宾塞·霍布森」的名字。脊背发凉，一点没错。光是看封面都令人难受。不过，只要这本书还在我手里，市面上就少一本流传。

text: A Second Edition
translation: 第二版

text:
A Sign is an unusual right, condition, wound, or nature that adds pips to your [[Aspect Pool]], and perhaps has other effects.

You begin with one Sign. Hollowed out as you are, you have room for more.

It's useful to have a [[Passion]] whose [[Aspects]] matches a Sign - then acting with the [[Passion]] will refresh the Sign pips as well.
translation:
印记是一种异样的权柄、境况、创伤或天性，为你的[[性相池]]增添点数，或许还有其他效力。

你起初拥有一个印记。你已被掏空，正因如此，你还有容纳更多的余地。

让一项[[激情]]拥有与印记相符的[[性相]]是很有用的——这样顺应[[激情]]行事，也会补充印记的点数。

text: A State-sanctioned daily paper. The masthead: a wheat-sheaf gethered around the francisque axe of the state.
translation: 一份获邦国认可的日报。报头图案：一束麦捆环绕着邦国的那柄法兰西之斧。

text: A Successful Working
translation: 一次成功的炼制

text: A Wakeful Eye can [[Hallow]] or [[Unveil]] - unlocking conversation choices that require those Aspects. It'll also give a bonus to Skills when placed in an Active slot. Be careful - whatever you do with it, it's a one-use item.
translation: 警醒之眼可以[[祝圣]]或[[揭示]]——解锁需要对应性相的对话选项。放入活跃栏位时,它还会为技艺提供加成。当心——无论你拿它做什么,这都是件一次性物品。

text: A Witch's Knot can [[Bewitch]] or [[Entwine]] - unlocking conversation choices that require those Aspects. It'll also give a bonus to Skills when placed in an Active slot. Be careful - whatever you do with it, it's a one-use item.
translation: 女巫结可以[[蛊惑]]或[[缠绕]]——解锁需要这些性相的对话选项。放入活跃栏位时,它还会为技艺提供加成。小心——无论你拿它做什么,它都是一次性物品。

text:
A betraying clue.

As Traces accumulate, as my name gets around, I'm more likely to be recognised. Sometimes this might be good. I won't count on it being good.

[Spencer can gain Traces from truthfully sharing personal information, interacting with the authorities, or simply staying in one place too long. Sleeping in the same place for one night is safe - every night after that adds a Trace. Traveling to a new city removes Traces, as long as you don't keep travelling the same route.]
translation:
一条泄密的线索。

随着痕迹累积,我的名声渐渐传开,我被人认出的可能也随之增加。有时这或许是好事。但我不指望它是好事。

[斯宾塞可以通过如实吐露个人信息、与当局打交道,或仅仅在同一处久留来获得痕迹。在同一处安睡一夜是安全的——此后每多一夜,都会增添一条痕迹。只要不重复走同一条路线,前往一座新城市就会清除痕迹。]

text: A bit grim out here. I'm now Chilly.
translation: 这外面有点阴冷。我现在发冷了。

text: A black-and-gold fountain pen monogrammed 'L.A.'
translation: 一支黑金相间的钢笔，压着 'L.A.' 的花押。

text: A black-enamelled hip flask of extremely modest dimensions - just enough to hold a small nip of spirits, but reassuringly inconspicuous, perhaps even to a body-search. 'Flat man', the German term means.
translation: 一只黑色珐琅的扁酒壶，尺寸极其克制——刚好容得下一小口烈酒，却小得令人安心，或许连搜身都能瞒过。德语词的意思是“扁平的人”。

text: A blissful period of entirely nothing. The rail-grime, the soot and sweat, is gone.
translation: 一段全然放空的幸福时光。旅途的尘垢、煤烟与汗渍，尽数洗去。

text: A bright future.
translation: 光明的未来。

text: A bright memory stirs...
translation: 一段鲜亮的回忆被唤醒……

text: A bright thing... a holy thing... a thing of vivid colour...
translation: 明亮之物……神圣之物……色彩鲜活之物……

text: A bright token inhabited by a sharp spirit. Never allow anyone to look directly at it, or its power will instantly depart.
translation: 一件明亮的器物，内住着一位锐利的精灵。绝不可让任何人直视它，否则它的力量会立刻离去。

text: A bright token vitrified to utmost purity.
translation: 一件玻璃化至极致纯净的明亮器物。

text: A brilliant spray of vivid red.
translation: 一蓬绚烂的鲜红。

text: A bulky manila envelope bulges an inside pocket. Time to open it.
translation: 一只厚实的牛皮纸信封把内袋撑得鼓鼓囊囊。该打开它了。

text: A bulky, sardonic woman with a jittery habit of dropping her eyes.
translation: 一个身材高大，言语讥讽的女人，会习惯性地垂下眼帘，目光躲闪。

text: A burly gentleman in orderly's whites.
translation: 一位体格魁梧的绅士，穿着护工的白色制服。

text: A busy Hour, then, these last ten years.
translation: 那么，这十年来，这位司辰想必繁忙得很。

text: A butterfly!
translation: 一只蝴蝶!

text: A cat of striking size and vivid presence. Hefty, but wary.
translation: 一只体型惊人，存在感强烈的猫。壮硕，但十分警惕。

text: A catechism, M. Hobson?
translation: 霍布森先生，你是在背教理问答吗？

text: A charming young woman with, I dare say, unsuspected depths.
translation: 一位迷人的年轻女子,我敢说,藏着出人意料的深邃。

text: A cheering rush of hot water! I remembered to put the plug in, just in time.
translation: 热水欢腾地奔涌而出！我赶在最后时刻想起塞上了塞子。

text: A cheering rush of hot water, and the air begins to cloud with steam.
translation: 热水欢腾奔涌，空气渐渐笼上蒸汽。

text: A chilly soul. But she has no reputation for cruelty, either.
translation: 一个冷淡的灵魂。但她也并无残暴之名。

text: A chilly stream of clear water competes against the rain. It's losing.
translation: 一道冰凉清澈的水流与雨水较劲。它正在输。

text:
A choice with a [[Skill]] icon needs a skill check. An invisible die is rolled*, added to your [[Skill]] level, and compared to the difficulty level of the check. The choice will give you your basic chance of success; hover your cursor for more details.

*technically, it's actually an invisible token being drawn from an [[invisible bag]].
translation:
带[[技艺]]图标的选项需要一次技艺检定。会掷出一枚隐形骰子*，加到你的[[技艺]]等级上，再与检定的难度一较高下。选项会告诉你基本的成功几率；将光标悬停，可查看详情。

*严格说来，其实是从[[隐形布袋]]里摸出一枚看不见的代币。

text: A circular silver-gilt box, adorned with an exquisitely modelled dove, also silver-gilt. A story associates it with St Galileo. It held something holy or otherwise powerful for long enough to acquire a little power of its own.
translation: 一只圆形镀金银盒，饰着一只同样镀金、做工精美的鸽子。有个传说将它和圣伽利略联系在一起。它盛放某种神圣或其他有力的东西已经够久，自身也攒下了一点力量。

text:
A clever practitioner might craft a [[Midnight Mark]] with Nyctodromy. A subtle one might use Hushery; a ruthless one, Skolekosophy.

For those different approaches, you'll work in different places. Nyctodromy can be used at a Wound or Threshold, but not at a Shadowed Place. Hushery can be used at a Shadowed or Quiet Place, but not at a Wound. And so on. This is why you find the most sinister adepts in graveyards, and the least fun ones in churches.
translation:
聪明的修士或许会用夜游术炼出一枚[[午夜印记]]。心思细腻的会用静默术；心狠手辣的，则会用蠕虫学。

不同的门路，要在不同的地方施展。夜游术可用于受创之处或门槛，但不能用于阴影之地。静默术可用于阴影之地或宁静之地，但不能用于受创之处。诸如此类。正因如此，最阴森的修士都在墓园里，最无趣的都在教堂中。

text: A clot of wood, leaves and feathers that sometimes used to draw the attention of minor Names like Knotwingknot.
translation: 一团结着木、叶与羽的乱块,昔时偶尔会引来诺特温克诺特这类次要尊名的注目。

text: A cloud of steam; and then nothing obvious has changed.
translation: 一团蒸汽升起;然后,并没有什么明显的变化。

text: A complicated lesson. The [[Wolf Divided]] - the Hour of rage and pain - incarnate in a wounded dog. A great kindness turned to horror. Over the years, the story has sown a whole crop of heretics.
translation: 复杂的教训。[[裂分之狼]]——愤怒与痛苦之[[司辰]]——化身于一条受伤的狗。一桩天大的善举,转成了恐怖。这些年来,这个故事播下了整整一茬异端。

text: A complicated memory stirs...
translation: 一段复杂的回忆泛起……

text: A controversial passage in... I forget whether it was the Received or Sanctioned Version, and the binding is plain, without clues.
translation: 一段颇有争议的段落出自……我记不清是通行版还是钦定版,书封朴素,全无线索。

text: A cough from the doctor.
translation: 医生轻咳一声。

text: A courteous dream, isn't it? I -
translation: 真是一场彬彬有礼的梦，不是吗？我——

text: A covenant of travel in silence. 'Twilight and evening bell / And after that the dark!'
translation: 一份于静默中行旅的盟约。「薄暮与晚钟,/而后便是黑暗!」

text:
A cracked mirror, not discarded but kept here,
in this chamber of concealed business.
translation: 一面破裂的镜子,没有丢弃,而是收在这间藏着不可告人之事的密室里。

text: A cramped page of Cyrillic text and overlaid stamps, all in aniline purple of many shades from faded to fresh, and headed with a single silver Star. Most of the text is legible with careful attention to detail, but one layer artfully obscures the next, so that it's almost impossible to trace the detail back to the beginning.
translation: 一页挤满西里尔字母文字、叠满层层印章的纸，一律是深浅不一的苯胺紫，从褪色到簇新，页首以一颗银星为冠。用心细看，大部分文字尚可辨认，但一层巧妙地掩着下一层，几乎不可能将细节一路回溯到源头。

text: A dark and syrupy liquor favoured in unnamed forest villages.
translation: 一种深色黏稠的烈酒，在无名的林间村落里备受青睐。

text: A deadening chill; an expectation of silence; the apprehension of frost.
translation: 令人死寂的寒意；对寂静的期许；对霜冻的预感。

text: A defiler of - well, tell her she's a collaborationist old viper, and if she'd ever paid her husband any attention -
translation: 勾引有妇之夫——哼,那就替我告诉她,她是条附逆的老毒蛇,要是她当年肯多留意自己的丈夫——

text: A demurely risqué choice for a twentieth-century sanitarium.
translation: 对一座二十世纪的疗养院而言,这是个含蓄而大胆的选择。

text: A difficult term to define, where the [[Cross]]-nature manifests. Perhaps better to say that he will advance.
translation: 一个难以定义的说法,尤其当[[介壳种]]本性显现时。或许更妥当的说法是,他将继续前行。

text: A distant memory stirs...
translation: 一段遥远的回忆被唤醒……

text: A double scourge?
translation: 双重灾祸?

text: A dove. There is an Hour named Elegiast. The Ivory Dove, he's called.
translation: 一只鸽子。有位司辰名为悼歌诗人。人称骨白鸽。

text: A dream about where Nina's gone.
translation: 一场关于尼娜去向的梦。

text: A dream of my past troubles me. I'll feel better if I can talk it out.
translation: 一个关于过往的梦境困扰着我。若能有人倾诉，我的感觉将会好些。

text: A dreamily smiling, dreamily humming woman in horn-rimmed glasses. Delicious scents waft from the kitchen behind her: ham, onions.
translation: 一位戴着玳瑁框眼镜的女子,笑意迷离,哼着歌。她身后厨房里飘来诱人的香气:火腿,洋葱。

text: A droning tone, like a sermonious and didactic bee, drags me from muddled dreams. My alarm has woken me.
translation: 一阵低沉的嗡嗡声——如同一只爱说教、好训人的蜜蜂——把我从纷乱的梦中拖了出来。是闹钟把我叫醒了。

text: A drop on each eyelid, in each ear, on the tip of the tongue. Sprinkle the rest around the room.
translation: 每只眼皮上一滴，每只耳朵里一滴，舌尖上一滴。剩下的洒在房间各处。

text: A duchess, I hear. Or a marchioness?
translation: 我听说，是位公爵夫人。还是侯爵夫人？

text: A few minutes have passed.
translation: 几分钟已经过去。

text: A few minutes with blade, cream, and hot water, before I feel both cleaner and sharper.
translation: 与刀片、剃须膏和热水相伴几分钟，我便觉得既洁净，又利落。

text: A figurine: a woman in a long, bodiced dress.
translation: 一尊小雕像:一位身着束腰长裙的女子。

text: A flash of unexpected colour above the post office - flags rippling lazily in the dank air of the valley.
translation: 邮局上方掠过一抹出人意料的色彩——旗帜在谷地阴湿的空气中懒洋洋地翻卷。

text: A flicker of emotion? But she's so hard to read.
translation: 一丝动容？然而她深不可测。

text: A flimsy slip of paper - a calendrier with details of a travelling carnival - slides out from between the pages of the LAGASSE notebook...
translation: 一张轻薄的纸片——一份载着巡回马戏团详情的日历——从“拉加斯”笔记本的书页间滑落……

text: A foreigner, so.
translation: 这么说，是个外国人。

text: A friend of mine - a southern woman - used to dance at the Ecdysis Club in London. When her heart was broken, she set out to revenge herself. She told me that she had buried a songbird's heart at the dark of a moon, to call for the red help she wanted.
translation: 我的一位朋友——南方女子——曾在伦敦的蜕皮俱乐部跳舞。心碎之后,她决意报复。她告诉我,她在月暗之夜埋下一只歌鸟的心,以召来她想要的红色援手。

text: A garrulous, cheery messenger from another age.
translation: 一位来自另一个时代的信使，喋喋不休而开朗。

text: A general clinking of glasses.
translation: 一片碰杯声。

text: A gentleman does not go out into the street while wearing his dressing-gown unless the house is on fire. Even a dressing-gown as elegant as this dressing-gown.
translation: 一位绅士不会穿着晨衣上街,除非房子着了火。即便是这样一件优雅的晨衣,也不例外。

text: A genuine Incorporate cigarette. This far from the US, a dollar might get you ten cigarettes on the black market. In Europe, it's almost a [[currency]].
translation: 一支货真价实的集团香烟。在离美国这么远的地方，一美元在黑市上也许能换来十支香烟。在欧洲，它几乎就是一种[[货币]]。

text: A glass of red.
translation: 来一杯红的。

text: A glass of white.
translation: 来一杯白的。

text: A glowering man in glowering middle age, nicely filling out an ornate military uniform.
translation: 一个阴沉着脸的男人，正值阴沉的盛年，把一身华丽的军装撑得刚刚好。

text: A golden and novel [[Principle]] which brings both visionary wisdom and material prosperity.
translation: 一条崭新而金灿的[[准则]]，既带来洞见的智慧，也带来物质的繁荣。

text: A good lesson. If you're going to die, die right.
translation: 好教训。如果终究要死,就死得其所。

text: A good place for the Arts Unconsidered.
translation: 施展未识技艺的好地方。

text: A great many years from now!
translation: 那还要再过上许多许多年!

text: A greeting and a parting in the tongue of Lagash; and the name of a spirit.
translation: 拉格什之语中的一声问候,与一声道别;也是一位灵的名字。

text: A half-guessed memory sparkles infuriatingly at the brain-lobe tip, and is gone. I can't work out what this is.
translation: 一种隐约可辨的记忆在脑叶尖端恼人地闪烁,随即消失。我认不出这是什么。

text: A hand-made petrol-fueled lighter, painstakingly hammered out of a spent shell-casing. I had one rather like this, back in my Dorsetshire Regiment days. I threw it away after it took my eyebrows off. This one doesn't look much safer, but its provenance lends it power. And the maker thoughtfully lined the fuel chamber with wadded asbestos so it's less likely to explode.
translation: 一只手工打造的汽油打火机，由一枚用过的弹壳一丝不苟地锤制而成。多塞特团服役那会儿，我也有过一只跟它差不多的。它燎掉我的眉毛之后，我把它扔了。这一只看起来并不比那只安全多少，但它的来历赋予了它力量。而且制作者想得周到，在燃料舱里衬了填实的石棉，所以它不大可能爆炸。

text: A hand-picked bunch, loosely tied with string.
translation: 一束手摘的玫瑰，用细绳松松扎着。

text: A hand-picked spray of eglantine.
translation: 一枝手摘的犬蔷薇。

text: A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. My heart goes first one way, then another. It is not to be relied on.
translation: 一种心脏状况。我离开世界期间，在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。我的心一会儿朝这边，一会儿朝那边，根本靠不住。

text: A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. My heart is achingly alive to unexpected directions; but it keeps me warm at night.
translation: 一种心疾。是我离家期间在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。我的心对意想不到的方向怀着痛楚般的敏锐;但它在夜里让我保持温暖。

text: A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. My heart is heavy, but it always keeps me warm at night.
translation: 一种心脏状况。我离开世界期间，在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。我的心很沉重，但夜里总会让我保持温暖。

text: A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. My heart is like a window banging in the storm - restless, undedicated, unconfinable.
translation: 一种心疾。是我离家期间在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。我的心像风暴中砰砰作响的窗——躁动,无定,难拘束。

text: A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. My heart is sullen, furious, though it keeps me warm at night.
translation: 一种心疾。是我离家期间在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。我的心阴沉而暴怒,尽管它在夜里让我保持温暖。

text: A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. My heart thunders with reckless bravery; but it keeps me warm at night.
translation: 一种心疾。是我离家期间在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。我的心因鲁莽的勇猛而轰鸣;但它在夜里让我保持温暖。

text: A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. My heart trembles with half-guessed desires, but it keeps me warm at night.
translation: 一种心脏状况。我离开世界期间，在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。我的心因半猜中的欲望而颤抖，但夜里它会让我保持温暖。

text: A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. My heart yearns to rise. Sometimes I think it might leave me behind.
translation: 一种心疾。是我离家期间在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。我的心渴望升起。有时我觉得,它也许会抛下我独自离去。

text: A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. Sometimes my heart falters. Sometimes I feel the sting of its tender opening.
translation: 一种心疾。是我离家期间在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。有时我的心会踌躇。有时,我感觉到它温柔开合时的那一缕刺痛。

text: A hidden door! Not locked in any way that might matter.
translation: 一扇暗门！门上没有任何值得一提的锁。

text: A hint of a reaction from Nina?
translation: 宁娜有任何反应迹象吗？

text: A horrible tangle of potential Worms or Worm-traces, modelled after the scars left in a host's soul.
translation: 一团可怖的纠缠，内里是潜在的蠕虫或蠕虫之迹，仿照宿主灵魂上留下的伤疤而成。

text: A house of tolerance, indeed!
translation: 果真是座宽容之家！

text: A human-height block of something brilliantly luminous, leaking light from beneath a heavy velvet drape.
translation: 一块与人同高，散发着夺目光芒的物体，正从厚重的天鹅绒帷幕下透出缕缕光线。

text: A hygrometer quivers as I open the lid. Inside, a drawer full of crisply labelled cigars. It's a humidor - a storage box designed to preserve a suitable moisture level, so that the cigars neither dry out nor grow spongy.
translation: 我打开盖子时，湿度计微微一颤。里面是一层抽屉，装满了贴有清晰标签的雪茄。这是保湿盒——一种保持适宜湿度的储存盒，让雪茄既不会干透，也不会发软。

text: A kindly Hour. It's the Elegiast who ensures the Dead are remembered.
translation: 一位仁慈的司辰。正是悼歌诗人，确保亡者为人铭记。

text: A large blond gentleman in orderly's whites blocks the hallway listening to a portable radio. He raises his eyes to regard me without enthusiasm.
translation: 一位高大的金发先生穿着护理员的白衣,堵在走廊里,听着便携收音机。他抬起眼,不带热忱地打量我。

text: A leaflet printed in dramatic white text on black background, showing the upcoming route of a travelling carnival.
translation: 一张传单，黑底白字，印得醒目张扬，展示着一个巡游嘉年华接下来的行程路线。

text: A letter from Max Mustermann to Madame Zelia, in a white envelope lettered with punctilious copperplate care.
translation: 一封马克斯·穆斯特曼写给泽莉亚夫人的信，装在一个白色信封里，信封上的字是一笔不苟的铜版体。

text: A letter from Maître Argant to Madame Zelia, folded in quarters and labelled ZIELA MY LOVE in Juliusz' barely-readable scrawl. He has adorned it with hearts, kisses, and little pictures of friendly wasps.
translation: 一封阿尔冈律师写给泽莉亚夫人的信，折成四折，尤利乌什以几乎认不出的潦草笔迹写着「吾爱泽莉亚」。他还在信上点缀了心形、亲吻记号，以及一幅幅友善黄蜂的小画。

text: A letter from Maître Argant to Madame Zelia, in a slim sky-blue envelope that smells like Argant itself.
translation: 一封阿尔冈律师写给泽莉亚夫人的信，装在一个纤薄的天蓝色信封里，信封带着阿尔冈自身的气息。

text: A list of names once used by the missing and dead, recovered to apply to the Dead of Kerisham.
translation: 一份名单，收着失踪者与亡者生前用过的名字，如今被寻回，安到凯尔伊苏姆的亡者身上。

text: A little advice. Do not raise your voice when you say these interesting things.
translation: 一点忠告。说这些有趣的事情时，别抬高嗓门。

text: A little antique coin - silver, perhaps. I pocket it hastily as Aubière returns to the vertical.
translation: 一枚小小的古币——也许是银的。趁奥比埃重新直起身，我匆匆把它揣进口袋。

text: A little antique silver coin is just too far away to snag. I settle for a fountain pen and pocket it hastily as Aubière returns to the vertical.
translation: 那枚小小的古银币太远，够不着。我退而求其次，拿了一支钢笔，趁奥比埃重新直起身时匆匆揣进兜里。

text: A little breath of winter in the air.
translation: 空气中,有一缕冬的气息。

text: A little ceramic jar, small enough to fit in the palm of the hand, light enough to ride unnoticed in a pocket.
translation: 一只小陶罐,小得恰好能放进掌心,轻得放进口袋也不会引人注意。

text: A little flecks of silvery metal bonded to black cardstock - supposedly a scrap of an actual Star. The Ministries occupation headquarters in Karlshorst issues these to political officers and senior civilians as badges of identification.
translation: 几缕银色的金属碎屑附着在黑色卡纸上——据称是一颗真星的残片。联盟设在卡尔斯霍斯特的占领军总部把这些发给政治军官与高级文职人员，作为身份徽记。

text: A little jar of honey. Amber in some lights, golden in others. [Unlike many Refreshments, honey survives travel.]
translation: 一小罐蜂蜜。在某些光线下呈琥珀色，在另一些光线下呈金色。[与许多茶点不同，蜂蜜经得起旅行。]

text: A little pause before she said that. And a little watchfulness after. Linou wanted to be sure I understood that Americans were welcome here.
translation: 说这话之前，她顿了顿。说这话之后，又带着一丝警觉。利努想让我确知：美国人在此地是受欢迎的。

text: A little tangle of night-magics and serpent-tricks.
translation: 一小团夜之魔法与蛇术的纠缠。

text: A little white ceramic jar containing a small quantity of golden ink - uzult, one of the five encausta terminalia, the Great Inks in which interpretations of [[Histories]] can be recorded by the appointed few. [This is a precious substance. Use it only at need. You can sell it, but few in all Europe will appreciate its true price.]
translation: 一只小小的白色瓷罐，内盛少量金色墨水——乌祖尔特，五种终结彩墨之一，即那“大墨”：被选定的少数人能以之记录对[[历史]]的诠释。 [这是珍稀之物。只在必要时使用。你可以卖掉它，但全欧洲没有几个人懂得它真正的价值。]

text: A little white ceramic jar from Aubière's box - the pyx, the reliquary, whatever it was.
translation: 奥比埃匣子里的一只小小的白色瓷罐——圣体盒也好，圣物匣也好，管它是什么。

text: A little.
translation: 有一点。

text: A lonely figure poles a flat boat across a lake of pistachio-green.
translation: 一个孤独的身影撑着一叶平底舟,渡过一片开心果绿的湖泊。

text: A long list of carefully constructed names, each chosen for a face on the beach, with another dozen for latecomers. It'll literally n ever make any difference to anyone except me.
translation: 一长串精心构造的名字，海滩上的每张面孔都有一个，另备了一打给后来者。除了我，它永远不会对任何人产生任何影响——字面意义上的。

text: A long rattling road from Alexandria to Antibes. Through mountain and forest and choking smoke. But here I am at last.
translation: 从亚历山大港到昂蒂布,一条漫长而颠簸的路。穿过山岭、森林与呛人的浓烟。但终于,我到了这里。

text: A lump of waxy grey.
translation: 一块蜡质的灰色疙瘩。

text: A man of culture. We play chess sometimes: I hope you might join our games.
translation: 一位有格调的人。我们偶尔下棋:希望你能来对弈几局。

text: A man who seeks a woman always wears a certain air. It's one I know, too well.
translation: 一个寻找女人的男人,总带着某种神色。那种神色,我认得,太熟了。

text: A many-storyed hospital populated by masked eccentrics. Any adept would recognise it as the [[Mansus]].
translation: 一座有许多层楼的大医院,住满了戴面具的怪人。任何修士都会认出这是[[漫宿]]。

text: A melancholy gawk of a man, but his gestures are fluid, his features expressive.
translation: 一个忧郁而腼腆的男人，但他的手势流畅，表情丰富。

text: A melancholy, friendly, crinkle of the eyes.
translation: 眼角皱起一道忧郁而友善的纹。

text: A memory uncoils...
translation: 一段回忆,缓缓舒展开来……

text: A military uniform - or something that strongly suggests such a connection. Other soldiers and ex-soldiers will approve. In 1948, very few would object.
translation: 军装——或任何强烈暗示这种联系的衣物。其他军人和退伍军人会认可。在 1948 年,几乎没有人会反对。

text: A minute. Two minutes. Three, and I can smell smoke. Four, five... and I hear shouts of alarm. A bell begins to clang. Someone's staggering to the waiting room, holding a bucket of sand. The poinçonneuse, delighted by the excitement, hurries from her post to help.
translation: 一分钟。两分钟。三分钟,我闻到了烟味。四分钟,五分钟……我听见惊慌的喊叫。铃铛开始当当作响。有人端着一桶沙,踉跄着奔向候车室。剪票员被这场骚动逗得高兴,离开岗位赶去帮忙。

text: A mirror of bright silver returns my reflection with perfect fidelity. It does show me standing in a bombed-out version of the bathroom - one wall missing, plumbing dangling from the brickwork like angled entrails - but since the Wars, one learns not to be distracted by that kind of thing.
translation: 一面亮银色的镜子忠实映出我的倒影。镜中确实映出我站在一间遭轰炸的浴室里——少了一面墙，水管自砖墙垂落，如歪斜的肠子——但战争之后，人便学会了不被这类景象分心。

text: A moment of peace beneath the swaying leaves. Then back to the world.
translation: 摇曳的枝叶之下,一瞬安宁。然后,回到这个世界。

text: A mystery, then. I've always liked them.
translation: 那么,是个谜。我一向喜欢谜。

text: A narrow-eyed, watchful woman in a crisp uniform
translation: 一位目光锐利、神情警惕的女子，身着整洁的制服。

text: A nature that something might possess. Some Aspects are grand occult [[Principles]] like Forge or Lantern. Others are more practical qualities - an outfit might be Warm or Formal. And others touch both worlds - esoteric tools have Aspects like Quell or Entwine, which unlock new choices.
translation: 某种事物可能具备的天性。有些性相是宏伟的秘学[[准则]]，如铸或灯。另一些是更实际的品质——一件行头可以是温暖或正式。还有些同时触及两个世界——秘学器物带有[[镇伏]]或[[缠绕]]之类的性相，能解锁新的选项。

text: A neatly wrapped parcel containing a new Outfit.
translation: 一份包装齐整的包裹，内有一件新行头。

text: A necklace of pearls, and tailor's needles crossed behind her head. Neither is a recognised attribute of St Reparata.
translation: 一串珍珠项链,还有交叉在她脑后的裁缝针。这两样,都不是圣雷帕拉塔公认的标志。

text: A new twist for our little exile knot! My name is Rodia; welcome to this house.
translation: 我们这流亡小圈子里来了新变化!我叫罗迪娅;欢迎来到这所房子。

text: A nice hot cup of strong black tea, softened with milk.
translation: 一杯滚烫的浓红茶，以牛奶调柔。

text: A nineteenth century relic.
translation: 一个十九世纪的遗物。

text: A number of sheep, and a smaller number of goats, have returned triumphantly from the summer pastures and won local livestock competitions.
translation: 若干绵羊,以及数目略少的山羊,已从夏季牧场凯旋,赢得了当地的牲畜比赛。

text: A panel of dark wood, daubed with the symbol of a closed eye. It resembles the door of the sanitarium living room; but it isn't actually a door, or I would be able to open it.
translation: 一块深色木板，上面涂着一个闭眼的符号。它像疗养院客厅的门；但它并不是真的门，否则我就能打开它了。

text: A panel of sturdy wood, daubed with the symbol of a cross-charged heart. It resembles the door of the sanitarium dining room; but it isn't actually a door, or I would be able to open it.
translation: 一块结实的木板，上面涂着一个缀有十字的心形符号。它像疗养院餐厅的门；但它并不是真的门，否则我就能打开它了。

text: A panel of varnished wood, daubed with the symbol of an open eye. It resembles the door of the sanitarium library; but it isn't actually a door, or I would be able to open it.
translation: 一块上了漆的木板，上面涂着一个睁眼的符号。它像疗养院图书室的门；但它并不是真的门，否则我就能打开它了。

text: A passable counterfeit in the name of François Isnard. The name is clumsily printed and difficult for a lazy official to read accurately at a casual glance. It might draw the attention of a more scrupulous official.
translation: 一本署名弗朗索瓦·伊斯纳尔的赝品，足以乱真。名字印得笨拙，懒散的官员草草一瞥很难读准。若是遇上较真的官员，恐怕会引来注意。

text: A passer-by takes shelter from the rain in the station hall. He glances casually across the station in the direction of the poinçonneuse.
translation: 一个路人走进车站大厅避雨。他漫不经心地越过车站,朝剪票员的方向瞥了一眼。

text: A patriot first, then everything besides. Against the [[Enemy]], we had no help - except, that is, the Stars and [[Ministries]]. Our idiot King had fled, but now he thinks the throne is his to claim again, with British help -
translation: 先是爱国者,然后才是其他一切。对抗[[敌人]]之时,我们得不到任何援助——除了,也就是说,群星与[[联盟]]。我们那个蠢国王早就逃了;可如今,他以为有英国人撑腰,王位又可以由他认领了——

text: A permit for Sylvain Huissier to pass through the Allied zones of occupation in Germany, supposedly issues by the Commandement en chef français en Allemagne at Baden-Baden. A reasonably convincing forgery.
translation: 一张准许西尔万·韦西耶通行德国各盟军占领区的通行证，据称由巴登-巴登的法国驻德占领军总司令部签发。算得上相当足以乱真的赝品。

text: A philosopher? In the State? No no, that would not be at all suitable.
translation: 哲学家?在这邦国里?不不,那可太不合适了。

text: A phrenology bust.
translation: 一尊颅相学半身像。

text: A pinch of transformation, intoxication, or subversion. Effective as a gift, or when used to treat food and drink.
translation: 一小撮转化、迷醉或颠覆之物。作为礼物有效,用于处理食物与饮品时同样有效。

text: A pity the [[Mansus]] is barred to us both. I would like to speak more with your heart. It is rare to share [[History]] with one of your kind. But we'll have to make do with what's left.
translation: 可惜,[[漫宿]]对我们俩,双双紧闭。我很想与你的心,再多谈谈。与你这般的人共享[[历史]],实属罕事。但我们只能将就,以余下的残迹度日。

text: A pity the [[Mansus]] is barred to us both. We could walk in the Orchard of Lights... but the War in the Sun has denied us that joy. We must take what we can from what's left.
translation: 可惜,[[漫宿]]对我们俩,双双紧闭。我们本可在辉光果园中漫步……但太阳之战,夺走了这份欢愉。我们只能从余下的残迹中,取用所能取的一切。

text: A place for practical work.
translation: 一处便于实作的地方。

text: A place of peace and healing near the Cornish village of [[Brancrug]]. One of the seven great libraries of the [[Watchman's Tree]].
translation: 康沃尔郡[[布兰库格]]村附近的一处平和疗愈之所。[[守夜人之树]]的七座伟大图书馆之一。

text: A plaque reads: JÉREMIE - HAUTE-GARONNE - 1895
translation: 铭牌上写着:热雷米 - 上加龙省 - 1895

text: A poignant, graceful jazz piece - guitar, violin, double bass? -with a driving rhythm that somehow seems stately - almost like a waltz.
translation: 一首凄美优雅的爵士——吉他、小提琴、低音提琴?——节奏强劲,却不知为何透着庄严——几乎像一首华尔兹。

text:
A pre-war passport in the name of M. Sylvain [[Huissier]]. My place of birth is given as Paris. That much is true, as far as I know, but it's not a name I often use. It can be convenient to travel as a Frenchman, but I can't legally be a citizen of both Britain and France.

It carries a consular stamp in purple aniline ink, confirming that the Fourth Republic recognises me as a citizen. Both the passport and the stamp are forgeries, but they're good ones. They'll get me across the Republic border unless I'm very unlucky.
translation:
一本战前护照，持有人为西尔万·[[韦西耶]]先生。出生地一栏写的是巴黎。就我所知，那部分属实，但这并非我常用的名字。以法国人的身份旅行有时颇为方便，可我无法合法地同时身为英国与法国的公民。

护照上有一枚紫色苯胺墨的领事印章，确认第四共和国承认我为公民。护照和印章都是伪造的，但都是上好的伪造。除非我倒霉到家，否则它们足以带我越过共和国的边境。

text:
A pre-war passport in the name of M. Sylvain [[Huissier]]. My place of birth is given as Paris. That much is true, as far as I know, but it's not a name I often use. It can be convenient to travel as a Frenchman, but I can't legally be a citizen of both Britain and France.

So the passport is a forgery - and the Republic has issued new ones anyway, leaving it invalid. Everything's changed since the Wars.
translation:
一本战前护照，持有人为西尔万·[[韦西耶]]先生。出生地一栏写的是巴黎。就我所知，那部分属实，但这并非我常用的名字。以法国人的身份旅行有时颇为方便，可我无法合法地同时身为英国与法国的公民。

所以这本护照是伪造的——何况共和国反正也换了新护照，它已经失效。自战争以来，一切都变了。

text:
A pre-war passport in the name of Mr Spencer Hobson. My place of birth is given as Kerisham, in England.

It's a real passport, but the government's changed the law, and it might not be valid much longer.
translation:
一本战前护照，持有人为斯宾塞·霍布森先生。出生地一栏写的是英格兰的凯尔伊苏姆。

这是一本真护照，但政府已经改了法律，它也许再过不久就失效了。

text: A proud declaration of the State's struggle against immortality and corruption. Chez Feliz is the latest corrupt establishment to face the axe's edge.
translation: 邦国向长生与腐败宣战的自豪宣言。费利克斯之家是最近一个面临斧刃的腐败场所。

text: A pure white square of fine linen. Cambric; named for [[Cambray]] town…
translation: 一方纯白的细亚麻布。细棉布——因[[康布雷]]城得名……

text: A rattling sound. There is something inside, the weight of a large coin. Definitely neither consecrated wafers nor dust.
translation: 里面传来咔嗒声。有东西，分量像一枚大硬币。绝非祝圣面饼，也绝非尘埃。

text: A reassuringly friendly outfit. Comforting and heartening.
translation: 一身让人安心的亲切行头。妥帖而振奋。

text: A reassuringly friendly outfit. Honest and unpretentious.
translation: 一身让人安心的亲切行头。诚实而不矫饰。

text: A reassuringly friendly outfit. Useful.
translation: 一身让人安心的亲切行头。实用。

text: A recent likeness.
translation: 一张近照。

text: A red-and-white memory stirs...
translation: 一段红白相间的回忆泛起……

text: A relic of a gentler world, our Philomèle. Give her my best.
translation: 「我们的菲洛梅尔,是那个更温柔世界留下的遗物。代我向她问好。」

text: A rich sweet hay-grass scent, very different from the choking tarriness that attends a lit cigar.
translation: 一股浓郁甘甜的干草气息，与点燃雪茄时那股呛人的焦油味截然不同。

text: A root-rite performed to protect against fascination. Traditionally, one digs beneath the roots of a yew with one's fingernails, but Moth is forgiving. Or at least distractible.
translation: 一种用于抵御入迷的根系仪式。传统做法是用指甲在紫杉根下挖掘，不过蛾很宽容。或者至少很容易分心。

text: A round of drinks for my new friends over there.
translation: 给那边我新结识的朋友们来一轮酒。

text:
A safety razor blade. In short supply since the Wars.

Notably useful for practitioners of the [[Arts Unconsidered]], who often need to shed blood with a tool that has never tasted blood.
translation:
一片安全剃须刀片。战争以来一直短缺。

对[[未识技艺]]的修行者尤其有用，他们常常需要用一件从未尝过血的工具来放血。

text: A seven-inch cigar of the highest quality, painstakingly rolled in Havana by a master torcedor, ready to be incited by fire's touch to a choking cloud of smoke. Easily worth a dollar on the black market.
translation: 一支七英寸长的顶级雪茄，由哈瓦那的卷烟大师一丝不苟地卷成，只待火焰一触，便化作一团呛人的烟雾。在黑市上轻易能值一美元。

text: A sheaf of papers detailing a sacred scenario of the commedia della Sole.
translation: 一叠纸页,详述着太阳喜剧的一出神圣剧目。

text: A shining ovoid, the colour of late summer.
translation: 一枚发光的卵形物,色泽如夏末。

text: A sigil deployed by  travelling healers and Bounds-wanderers.
translation: 行脚医者与边界漫游者所施用的符印。

text: A sign of the authority granted to the Names of the Church-sanctioned Hours, and passed on by Names to the officers of the Church.
translation: 此印记承载着一种权威——授予教会认可的司辰之尊名,再由尊名传予教会的职官。

text: A single Ministries dolya.
translation: 一枚孤零零的联盟多利亚。

text: A sleek Swedish Electrolux model. Lux indeed. There can't be many of these in Antibes. It's out of place in the humble kitchen. How did the proprietress afford it?
translation: 一台线条流畅的瑞典伊莱克斯型号。确实是 '奢' 如其名。昂蒂布城里这样的冰箱恐怕屈指可数。放在这间朴素的厨房里,实在格格不入。老板娘是怎么买得起的?

text: A smiling woman with a tendency to greenery.
translation: 一位面带微笑，正在转变为绿植的女子。

text: A soggy mess of identity cards and mulched ration books, scavenged from the Dead of Kerisham beach.
translation: 一堆湿透的身份证件与沤烂成浆的配给簿，是从凯尔伊苏姆海滩的亡者身上捡来的。

text: A stately, gleaming Citroën. The Bureau used this model, back before the War. A fine lambswool scarf lies crumpled on the passenger seat.
translation: 一辆庄重锃亮的雪铁龙。战争之前，防剿局用的就是这款车。副驾驶座上，一条上好的羔羊毛围巾皱巴巴地堆着。

text: A stern-faced, handsome woman with cropped hair. Her eyes are wide open, blank white.
translation: 一位面容严肃、留着短发的俊美女子。她双眼圆睁，目光空洞。

text: A strong state discourages frivolous chatter.
translation: 强大的国家会遏止轻浮的闲言碎语。

text: A sweet dish named (of course) to celebrate Offenbach's 1865 operetta La belle Hélène.
translation: 一道甜点，自然是为庆祝奥芬巴赫 1865 年的轻歌剧美丽的海伦而命名。

text: A thousand francisques.
translation: 一千枚法兰西斧币。

text: A tin medallion commemorating the wolf-headed patron of travelers, storms, and strength - an unfailingly popular and notoriously unsophisticated saint.
translation: 一枚锡质纪念章，纪念那位狼首的旅人、风暴与力量之主保——一位始终广受欢迎、出了名粗陋的圣人。

text: A tiny cup of fierce black coffee beneath a whipped cream quiff.
translation: 一小杯浓烈的黑咖啡，顶着一撮翘起的奶油尖。

text: A token invested with heavenly power, in defiance of Corona's claims of solar seignorage. Used for Bright Arts crafting recipes.
translation: 一件注入了天界力量的凭证，公然违抗冕对太阳铸币权的主张。用于光之技艺的炼制配方。

text: A token invested with unearthly power, in defiance of Gleam's claims of cosmic prerogative. Used for Night Arts crafting.
translation: 一件注入了非尘世力量的凭证，公然违抗烁对宇宙特权的主张。用于夜之技艺的炼制。

text: A token of the fundamental necessity that underlies the world. A Ministries dolya will work - but it's also possible to craft such a token. [Since the Wars, the currency of Gleam is used for the Night Arts - but you can create a Mark of Necessity as a substitute.]
translation: 一枚支撑世界之根本必需的凭证。一张联盟的多利亚可用——但也可以炼制出这样的凭证。 [大战之后,烁的货币用于夜之技艺——但你可以制作一枚必需之印迹作为替代。]

text:
A token of the old order of Heaven - or of [[Corona]], which claims to be its inheritor.  An Incorporate dollar is the easiest option, but there are ways to craft a token in the absence of greenbacks.

[Since the Wars, the currency of Corona is used for the Bright Arts - but you can create an Eye of Authority as a substitute.]
translation:
旧天堂秩序的凭证——或属于自称其继承者的[[冕]]。一张集团美元是最省事的选项,但即使没有美钞,也有办法制出这样的凭证。

[大战之后,冕的货币用于光之技艺——但你可以制作一枚权威之眼作为替代。]

text: A touchstone and talisman, worn as a good-luck piece until its owner became too closely acquainted with a howitzer shell at Remagen. The amulet survived the experience, so perhaps it assures its own good luck.
translation: 一枚试金石兼护身符，被当作辟邪吉物佩戴，直到它的主人在雷马根与一枚榴弹炮弹过于亲近。护符挺过了那场经历，所以也许它护佑的是自己的好运。

text: A trace of something that died tainted and returned corrupt.
translation: 某种污秽而亡、腐坏而归之物留下的痕迹。

text: A ubiquitous and generic sort of name. Léon sneezes sceptically.
translation: 一个随处可见、普通得不能再普通的名字。莱昂将信将疑地打了个喷嚏。

text: A very old friend. It's been a long time.
translation: 一位很老很老的朋友。已经很久很久了。

text: A very old woman in antique clothing. Her eyes are closed, her face is peaceful.
translation: 一位穿搭老派的老妇人。她的双目紧闭，她的面容安详。

text: A vessel to carry the consecrated Host - to those too ill to attend church.
translation: 一个器皿,盛装祝圣过的圣体——送予那些病重得无法去教堂的人。

text: A vivacious, self-possessed woman on the borders of a certain age.
translation: 一位生气勃勃、从容自若的女性，正处于不再年轻的边缘。

text: A votive figure of the Sisterhood of the Triple Knot. I've only seen these in cave-shrines - beneath Meknes, beneath Alexandria, beneath [[Brancrug]].
translation: 三重结姐妹会的还愿像。我只在洞穴圣祠中见过这些——在梅克内斯之下,在亚历山大港之下,在[[布兰库格]]之下。

text: A warm red-purple tone on an open weave, like a smile across the lip of a raised wine glass.
translation: 疏织布上一抹暖调的红紫，像高擎酒杯时掠过杯沿的微笑。

text: A wave of panic washes over me. What if the door has somehow stuck? What if I can't get out?
translation: 一阵恐慌如潮水漫过我。万一门卡住了呢？万一我出不去呢？

text: A wealthy mediaeval centre of learning, but a surprisingly obscure one - despite its notorious 'vivid book', its prophets and healers in exile, its Twin-visions, its allegedly poisonous nuns - right up until its dissolution. [[Hush House]] now occupies the old Abbey's site.
translation: 一座富庶的中世纪学问中心,却出奇地籍籍无名——尽管有那本声名狼藉的「鲜活之书」、流亡在外的先知与医者、它的双生幻象、据说身怀剧毒的修女们——直到它被解散为止。[[噤声居屋]]如今便占据了这座旧修道院的所在。

text: A web of subtle work to encourage peace, healing and a slow knitting-together of possibilities.
translation: 一张精巧织就的网，用以促成安宁、愈合，以及种种可能性的缓慢织合。

text: A welcome warmth. I'm no longer Chilly.
translation: 令人欣喜的暖意。我不再发冷了。

text: A welcome warmth. I'm no longer Shivering.
translation: 令人欣喜的暖意。我不再瑟瑟发抖了。

text: A well-used Rosières gas cooker in chipped cream enamel.
translation: 一台久经使用的罗西耶尔煤气灶,奶白色搪瓷上磕出了豁口。

text: A wiry, handsome man. His eyes are hidden behind smoked-glass goggles, rather like something an arc-welder might wear.
translation: 一个精瘦英俊的男人。双眼藏在烟熏玻璃护目镜后面,像极了电焊工戴的那种东西。

text: A woman in blue. Martyr's palm, saint's halo; dark eyes, sea beneath stars; crossed needles behind her head, and a necklace of pearls.
translation: 一个着蓝衣的女人。殉道者的棕榈,圣徒的光环;深邃的眼,星辰之下的海;脑后交叉的缝衣针,颈间一串珍珠。

text: A woman in green. In this part of the world, they would say she is 'between two ages.' Her eyes are steady; perhaps a little cynical; not obviously unkind.
translation: 一位身着绿衣的女人。在这一带,人们会说她「介于两个年纪之间」。她的目光沉静;或许有几分世故;但并不明显刻薄。

text: A wonderfully versatile dish favoured for breakfast by the sons of the lark, for supper by the daughters of the owl, and as a cold midnight snack by the children of the crow.
translation: 一种妙不可言的百搭菜肴：百灵鸟的儿子们爱用它作早餐，猫头鹰的女儿们爱用它作晚餐，乌鸦的孩子们则把它当作深夜的冷食。

text: A word I've never liked. Do the right thing and stop talking about it.
translation: 一个我向来不喜欢的词。做对的事，别再空谈它。

text: A wounded greyhound wrestles with serpents, eyes blazing.

text:
An Active Item gives a [[Skill]] modifier when you have it ready to use. You can keep up to four Items Active, but the modifiers won't sum - only the best one applies. Four hammers are not more effective than one hammer.

Some items are cumbersome, dangerous, or embarrassing, and apply negative modifiers. The good news is that, because the best modifier always applies, any bonus will cancel out any number of penalties. So if an item gives an negative modifier to a [[Skill]], any positive modifier will counteract all negatives.
translation:
当你把一件已激活物品备好待用时，它会为[[技艺]]提供修正。你最多可保持四件物品处于激活状态，但修正不会叠加——只取最优者。四把锤子不会比一把锤子更有效。

有些物品笨重、危险或令人难堪，会带来负面修正。好消息是，由于始终只取最优修正，任何一项加成都能抵消任意数量的惩罚。所以，如果一件物品给[[技艺]]带来负面修正，任何正面修正都能抵消全部负面。

text:
An empty room - Nina's old room -
mine, now. I'm getting closer.
translation:
一间空荡荡的房间——尼娜从前的房间——
如今是我的了。我越来越近了。

text: An extraordinary dash of frost-streak elegance
translation: 一抹优雅得异乎寻常的霜痕。

text: An honour to make your acquaintance, sir. But you have the advantage of me.
translation: 有幸与您相识,先生。只是,您认得我,我却还不认得您。

text: An imposing but quiet man. He moves deliberately and speaks with care.
translation: 一个仪表堂堂但沉默寡言的男人。行动深思熟虑，说话格外谨慎。

text: An impossibly thin, paradoxically heatless geometric segment of contained fire.
translation: 一截细得不可思议、悖论般毫无热力的几何线段,其中困着一团火。

text: An ingredient needs to have all the [[Aspects]] specified below the slot. The picker shows everything from your Inventory that will fit..
