text: An insouciant young man of astonishing physical beauty.
translation: 一位无忧无虑的年轻人，容貌俊美得难以置信。

text: An intricate, beautiful pattern that's just brash enough to remain tasteful.
translation: 一个繁复美丽的图案，恰好张扬到依旧不失雅致。

text: An obscure blue-silver presence in Caen.
translation: 在卡昂有一个不起眼的蓝银色存在。

text: An ocean of ruins. Saith the Enemy: The city must completely disappear from the surface of the earth and serve only as a transport station. No stone can remain standing. But now saith the architects in the smashed ruins: The entire nation builds its capital.
translation: 一片废墟的海洋。敌人如是说:这座城市必须从地表彻底消失,只用作一座运输站。任何石头都不得矗立。但如今,在粉碎的废墟中,建筑师们如是说:整个民族正在建造自己的首都。

text: An opportunity for generosity.
translation: 一个表达慷慨的机会。

text: An optimist would say: Europe's still healing. Others would say: Europe's taking its time to die.
translation: 乐观者会说：欧洲仍在愈合。另一些人会说：欧洲正慢条斯理地走向死亡。

text: An order for a dark jacket and trousers, made to measure. [The package will appear in your inventory after you travel to another city.]

text: An order for a knitted vest, shirt and tie, practical and respectable, made to measure. [The package will appear in your inventory after you travel to another city.]

text: An unresolved thread, [q=alias.formal.fr]. We saw each other last in Paris, when you had but recently completed your service with the Légion du Seuil. You gave me your uniform to tend and mend. You also ordered a new suit of clothes.
translation: 一桩悬而未决的线头,[q=alias.formal.fr]。我们最后一次见面是在巴黎,那时您刚从门关军团服役归来。您把制服交给我浆洗缝补,还订了一套新西装。

text: An unusual device displaying the current time in black glyphs on white tiles. As I watch, the two smaller tiles at the end flip regularly, updating the time display to the precise second.
translation: 一件不寻常的装置，白色字片上的黑色符号显示着当前时间。我注视之际，末端两枚较小的字片规律翻动，把时间显示精确更新到秒。

text: An unwise play I wrote in London in the twenties. That was the first time I ever ran across the [[Bureau]]. They shut down the production on opening night and pulped every copy.... or, it turns out, almost every copy.
translation: 二十年代我在伦敦写的一部不智之作。那是我头一回遇上[[防剿局]]。他们首演之夜就叫停了演出，把每一册存本都化成了纸浆……或者说，如后来所见的，几乎每一册。

text: And I am Philomèle.
translation: 而我，是菲洛梅尔。

text: And I should remember, first, that the Sister-and-Witch brings together what she can... and that she's the enemy of severance and disjunction.
translation: 而我首先该记住的是:双生巫女会把一切可以聚合的聚合起来……而她,正是分离与割裂之敌。

text: And I'm here, as I promised. I can't take your hand. Sinombre has passed beyond flesh. But now turn to my light and consider my voice, and we'll see what will open to you...
translation: 而我如约来了。我无法握住你的手——西诺姆布尔已超脱肉身。但现在，转向我的光，凝听我的声音，看看有什么会为你开启……

text: And I'm in the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui.
translation: 而我身在今日疗养院。

text: And I'm sorry, Leopold.
translation: 还有,对不起,莱奥波德。

text: And a razor blade. Useful things, razor blades.
translation: 还有一片剃刀刀片。刀片,是实用的东西。

text: And after consideration... I refuse it still.
translation: 再三考虑之后……我仍然拒绝。

text: And below the House - below the House -
translation: 而居屋之下——居屋之下——

text: And do not mention the name of Milicien Léon.
translation: 也别提民兵莱昂的名字。

text: And he's gone, hands in his pockets, whistling, mood instantly buoyant again.
translation: 而他已走远了,双手插在兜里,吹着口哨,情绪转眼又高涨起来。

text: And here come the authorities! Look sharp, you old bastards, our carrots are cooked now.
translation: 当局来了！打起精神来，老东西们，这下我们的胡萝卜熟了。

text: And now I look my best.
translation: 而此刻，我容光焕发。

text: And now is my moment.
translation: 而此刻就是我的时机。

text: And now, she looks only tired.
translation: 而此刻，她脸上只余疲惫。

text: And on the other side of town?
translation: 那城的另一边呢？

text: And she calls me a nihilist.
translation: 她倒管我叫虚无主义者。

text: And so neither can we know if I'm right, eh? But, thank you.
translation: 那么，我们同样无从知道我是否正确了，嗯？不过，谢谢你。

text: And so we're finished. Learn your lesson: don't trifle with Spencer Hobson.
translation: 那么，我们就此结束。记住教训：别招惹斯宾塞·霍布森。

text: And so! We shot them! On the spot!
translation: 于是！我们就把他们毙了！当场毙的！

text: And so, I pray before the saint.
translation: 所以,我便在圣人面前祈祷。

text: And something for monsieur. [Linou adds a drink to the tray, and turns away.]
translation: 再给先生来一杯。[利努往托盘上添了一杯，转身走开。]

text: And that, Guinefort, is why before you risk any good deeds, you always make sure you know who'll get the credit.
translation: 而这,吉内福尔,正是为什么在你冒险行善之前,总要先弄清楚:功劳会落在谁头上。

text: And the... I see. Well, so be it. I am a realist.
translation: 还有那……我明白了。好吧，也只能如此了。我是个现实主义者。

text: And then she's lost in her thoughts, lips moving slightly.
translation: 然后她便沉入自己的思绪，嘴唇微微翕动。

text: And then you disappeared, M. Hobson. Where did you go?
translation: 而后您便消失了,霍布森先生。您去了何处？

text: And there is only a very little pain.
translation: 而且只有一点点疼痛。

text: And this is my third!
translation: 这已经是我的第三杯了！

text: And tucked away at the back... a tin of coffee. Three-quarters full.
translation: 而在最里面……藏着一听咖啡。还剩四分之三。

text: And what are your feelings on travelling third class, Vincent?
translation: 文森特,你对坐三等座旅行有何感想?

text: And what of that?
translation: 那这个呢？

text: And what?
translation: 还有什么?

text: And when the information is not accurate? I have two names to give my superiors. So beware! Milice Léon has learnt to sniff out lies.
translation: 要是情报不准确呢？那我就有两个名字可以交给上级。所以小心！民兵莱昂已经学会闻出谎言的味道了。

text: And yet, I dream of her.
translation: 然而，我梦见了她。

text: And you, Dr Aubière. I hope we will meet again.
translation: 你也保重,奥比埃医生。希望咱们后会有期。

text:
Antibes, Alpes-Maritimes. November 1948; at least as far as anyone can tell any more.

	Twelve years ago, in Cracow, the Worms hollowed me out. For the next three years they steered me all round Europe, until at last I got away to a place where there was a kind of help... the Worms are gone now, but I've only begun to fill up the spaces they left.

	I was back with the Bureau again when the Worms took me. But I still think of myself, above all, as...
translation:
昂蒂布，滨海阿尔卑斯省。1948 年 11 月；至少就如今而言，没人能说清更多了。

	十二年前，在克拉科夫，蠕虫把我蛀空。此后三年，它们操纵我辗转欧洲各地，直到我终于逃到一处能寻得某种帮助的地方……如今蠕虫已经消失，但我才刚刚开始填补它们留下的空洞。

	蠕虫带走我时，我又回到了防剿局。但我依然首先把自己看作……

translation: 阿里斯蒂德挥舞着一只黑色天鹅绒舞鞋。菲洛梅尔慵懒地扭动左脚赤裸的脚趾。

text: Aristide, examining the bowl of his pipe for informers. Leopold, fascinated by the moths which flutter in to sip from his glass. Jean-Bernard, doggedly carving a quatrain into the flank of a candle. Philomèle is laughing into Jean-Bernard's shoulder, her hair coming loose... but then she begins to cough. It takes a long time for the coughing to subside. She's grown pale. That might be a spot of blood on her collar, but the cloth is too dark for me to be certain.
translation: 阿里斯蒂德端详着烟斗的斗钵，像在寻找告密者。利奥波德着迷地看着扑进杯中啜饮的飞蛾。让-贝尔纳固执地在蜡烛侧面刻一首四行诗。菲洛梅尔靠着让-贝尔纳的肩膀笑，头发散开……可接着，她开始咳嗽。咳嗽过了很久才平息。她变得苍白。她的衣领上或许有一点血迹，但衣料颜色太深，我无法确定。

text: Aristide, halfway through a draw on his pipe, cough-splutters with delight.
translation: 阿里斯蒂德正吸着烟斗，乐得连咳带呛，把烟都喷了出来。

text: Aristide, merry; Leopold, wary; Jean-Bernard, wistful; Philomèle, wry.

text:
Chez Bricktop: Coca-Cola and the Quintette du Hot Club like the world's heart pumping, Bricktop in her boa. I should have been in London, studying, but my medical training was a busted flush by then. I'd long lost patience with the [[Bureau]]'s limits on the arts of preservation. The Bureau had lost patience with me. And it was the Bureau that was paying my fees and my rent.

So I was in Paris for the New Year, with Christopher and Teresa. Christopher never liked jazz, and Teresa still wasn't used to wearing flesh again - she wore dark glasses even at night - and none of us really danced. But we danced that night.
translation:
在布里克托普夜总会：可口可乐与热力俱乐部五重奏的乐声宛如世界的心脏在搏动，布里克托普身披华丽的围巾，光彩照人。按理说，我本该待在伦敦继续深造。但那时，我的医学前程早已化为泡影。我早就受够了防剿局对保存术施加的种种限制，而防剿局也早已受够了我。可偏偏支付我学费和房租的正是防剿局。

就这样，我和克里斯托弗、特蕾莎一起在巴黎度过了新年。克里斯托弗从来不喜欢爵士乐；特蕾莎也还没有重新习惯披上血肉之躯——她甚至在夜里也戴着墨镜；我们三个人其实都不会跳舞。但那晚我们跳了舞。

text:
Driving qualities that help you decide your goals. You start with one - you can develop another two.

Increase your Passions with [[Experiences]], and they'll add more pips to your [[Aspect Pool]]. Whenever you act with a Passion, it'll refresh a pip of every relevant [[Aspect]] in your Pool. To put it simply: increasing your Passions, and acting with them, helps you pass checks on skills which match the Passion.

But people change. That's called character development; trauma; disillusionment; experience.

So if your actions recently have drifted another way, you can spend your [[Experiences]] to evolve one Passion into another when you level it up.
translation:
驱动你决定目标的特质。你起初有一种——还可以再养成两种。

用[[经验]]提升你的[[激情]]，它们会为你的[[性相池]]增添更多点数。每当你顺应一项激情行事，它便会为你池中每一项相关的[[性相]]补充一点。简单来说：提升你的激情并顺应它们行事，有助于你通过与之相符的技艺检定。

但人是会变的。那叫作性格成长；创伤；幻灭；阅历。

所以，如果你近来的行事已偏向另一条路，你可以在升级时花费[[经验]]，把一项激情转化为另一项。

text:
Europe awaits --- Mimata, where the red nuns look down on the beasts of the town --- Caen, where the New King's catafalque smoulders --- Mahaggony, under its amber --- Berlin red-litten --- Prague, Cross-hived, with its stairway ever down --- and at last, your final destination.

You are the one who passes every door. CONJURE your new self. CONFESS your schemes. And just when they think they have the measure of you --- DISAPPEAR.

[Think someone else might enjoy this? Send them the link so they can wishlist it, or try the demo.]

欧洲在前方等候——米玛塔,红衣修女俯瞰镇中群兽之地——卡昂,新王的灵柩台仍在阴燃——马哈戈尼,琥珀之下——柏林,红灯映照——布拉格,蜂巢密布,阶梯永远向下——最后,是你最终的归宿。

你是穿过每一扇门的那个人。召唤你的新自我。坦白你的图谋。而当他们自以为摸清了你的深浅之时——消失。

text:
I am on a street corner
Where I shouldn’t be.
Alone and coatless
I have gone out to look
For a black dog who answers to my whistle.
I have a kind of Halloween mask
Which I am afraid to put on.

我站在一个街角
一个我不该在的地方。
孤身一人,没穿外套
我出门来寻找
一条应我口哨声而来的黑狗。
我有一张万圣节面具
却害怕戴上它。

translation: 正是。我离不开我的丘吉尔型雪茄。虽说雪茄烟雾与我的另一重本性并不完全相合,我或许终究要被迫舍弃这点小小的乐趣。

text: I apologise for my flippancy, Mr Strathcoyne.
translation: 我为自己的轻浮致歉,斯特拉斯科因先生。

text: I apologise most sincerely, M. Hobson. I have reconsidered. I think it would be therapeutically unhelpful for me to tell you where to find Mlle Lagasse.
translation: 我万分真诚地向你道歉，霍布森先生。我重新考虑过了。我想，告诉你拉加斯小姐的去处，对你的治疗并无好处。

text: I apologise, [q=alias.formal], for these savages. If they had better manners, they'd introduce themselves.
translation: 我为这些粗人向您道歉，[q=alias.formal]。他们若懂礼数，就该自我介绍。

text: I apologise, madame. I am clumsy.
translation: 请见谅，夫人。我笨手笨脚。

text: I apologise. I couldn't afford to lose. I didn't want to admit how limited my funds were.
translation: 我道歉。我输不起。我不愿承认自己的钱有多有限。

text: I appreciate that. I will not always be frank with you, you know. But I will always try.
translation: 我领这份情。你知道,我不会总是对你开诚布公。但我会一直尽力。

text: I appreciate your generosity. And your courage.
translation: 多谢您的慷慨。也多谢您的勇气。

text: I begin to realise that my bonhomie is landing as sycophancy. None of them are stupid. Leopold in particular is watchful. Even Aristide is not so drunk as he likes to pretend.
translation: 我开始意识到，我的热络在他们眼中成了谄媚。他们谁都不傻。利奥波德尤其警觉。就连阿里斯蒂德，也没有他装出的那么醉。

text: I believe Fate won.
translation: 我相信是命运赢了。

text: I believe I said exactly that, yes. Is there... something to discuss?
translation: 我想,我说的正是这句话,是的。有什么……要谈的吗?

text: I believe this concludes our business.
translation: 我想，我们的账目就此两清。

text: I bless you by that which is pearl; by that which is not touched; by the Two which are One.
translation: 我以珍珠之名祝福您;以不可触及之物之名;以合一的两位之名。

text: I blighted Philomèle, completing Zèlia's revenge. I should return to the park and collect my payment.
translation: 我已使菲洛梅尔凋零,完成了泽莉亚的复仇。我该回到公园,收取报酬了。

text: I briefly aspired to join the ranks of the Forge-long. But I learnt how brutally they crushed their competition.
translation: 我曾一度渴望加入铸之长生者的行列。但我得知了他们碾压竞争者时有多残酷。

text: I briefly aspired to join the ranks of the Lantern-long, until I learnt that they devoured minds as part of their ascension.
translation: 我曾一度渴望加入灯之长生者的行列，直到我得知，他们飞升的一部分便是吞噬心智。

text: I buried the heart. I have been waiting. Four hundred francisques for your trabai.
translation: 我埋了那颗心。我一直在等。你的差事,值四百枚法兰西斧币。

text: I called her when I came down here from Paris. She let me know where to pick up the keys. Told me to keep an eye on the place.
translation: 我从巴黎下来的时候给她打了电话。她告诉我去哪儿拿钥匙。让我照看着这地方。

text: I came to Antibes for a reason. I can't leave yet.
translation: 我来昂蒂布是有原因的。我还不能走。

text: I came to Antibes for a reason. I won't leave yet.
translation: 我来昂蒂布是有原因的。现在还不到离开的时候。

text: I can always get out. (But once I couldn't, whispers the night.)
translation: 我总能出得去。（但有那么一次我出不去，夜色低声说。）

text: I can craft Labrikon with an Unworldly skill, enabling entry to Aubière's dream. Or I can still make an arrangement with Sinombre, if I prefer.
translation: 我可以用一项超凡技艺炼制拉布里孔,从而进入奥比埃的梦境。或者,倘若我更愿意,仍可与西诺姆布尔谈成一笔交易。

text: I can imagine.
translation: 我想象得到。

text: I can imagine...
translation: 可以想见……

text: I can keep it for myself or render  it to someone else - once I've achieved it.
translation: 我可以自己留着它，也可以交给别人——只要我完成了它。

text: I can keep it for myself or render it to someone else - once I've achieved it.
translation: 我可以自己留着它，也可以交给别人——只要我完成了它。

text:
I can project an air of authority and respectability. Something I learnt in my time as a priest and as a medic.

[A [[Worldly Skill]].]
translation:
我能摆出权威而体面的派头。这是我当神父与行医时学到的东西。

[一项[[世俗技艺]]。]

text: I can't be bothered with all this. I'll leave the bed half-made.
translation: 我可没心思做这些。床就让它铺到一半吧。

text: I can't be certain, but this looks very like a bust that stood in a tower room in [[Hush House]]. I remember it because the joke was that it was a real skull, waxed. One day I quietly checked that it wasn't.
translation: 我不敢肯定,但这尊半身像与曾在[[噤声居屋]]一间塔楼房间里立着的那尊十分相似。我之所以记得它,是因为当时有个玩笑,说那是颗打了蜡的真头骨。有一天,我悄悄验证过,并非如此。

text: I can't forget the injustice of what was done to me.
translation: 我无法忘记自己所遭受的不公。

text: I can't get into bed - I'm still fully dressed. [In a room of your own, you can change clothes at any time. To sleep, change to your dressing gown.]
translation: 我没法上床——衣服还没换呢。[在自己房间里，你可以随时更换衣服。要睡觉，先换上睡袍。]

text: I can't quite recall when I first heard the tale...
translation: 我记不太清,第一次听到这个故事是在什么时候……

text: I change my clothes less frequently than I change my skin, more frequently than I change my mind.
translation: 我换衣服不如换皮勤快，但比换主意勤快。

text: I cough halfway through my invocation. Damn it.
translation: 祷文念到一半，我咳了出来。该死。

text: I could be in a camp. Or lost to flowers. Or foundered in a pit of bones. [She gestures with her cigarette.] And so I think, this place is not so bad. Here's my advice. Be the good doctor's guest; and be my company in the sun.
translation: 我本可能待在营地里。或迷失于繁花。或沉没于骸骨之坑。[她拿香烟比了个手势。] 所以我想,这地方还不算太糟。这是我的忠告:当好医生的座上宾,也做我日光下的伴侣。

text: I could come back here later, if I need a shave.
translation: 以后若需刮脸，我还可以回到这里。

text: I could just co-operate with the man, as he suggested, and hope to win him round eventually.
translation: 我也可以按他的提议，同这人合作，指望最终能把他争取过来。

text: I could never quite forget what happened at [[Gladwyn Lake]].
translation: 我可能永远无法忘记在[[格拉德温湖]]发生的事。

text: I could only afford third class. Slatted seats and bellowing soldiers. I didn't get much sleep.
translation: 我只坐得起三等车厢。条板座椅,粗声大气的士兵。我没睡上多少觉。

text: I could use a bath.
translation: 我需要洗个澡。

text: I could use a cigarette.
translation: 我需要来支烟。

text: I could use a coffee.
translation: 我需要来杯咖啡。

text: I could use a shave.
translation: 我需要刮刮胡子。

text: I could use an opportunity to smarten up.
translation: 我需要个机会，把自己拾掇利落。

text: I could use my Unworldly skills to enter Aubière's dream and learn his secret. [Use Nyctodromy, Ithastry or Bosk to craft Labrikon, and take it to bed.]
translation: 我可以用非尘世技艺进入奥比埃的梦境,探知他的秘密。[用夜游术、盗火术或丛林学炼制拉布里孔,然后带着它入睡。]

text: I couldn't take it seriously any more. One little exorcist's assistant at the seiral terminus, chasing spirits round like butterflies.
translation: 我再也没法把它当回事了。一个赛拉末梢的小小驱魔师助手，追着灵体，像追蝴蝶一样。

text: I dare not contradict madame la marquise.
translation: 我可不敢反驳侯爵夫人阁下。

text: I deceived Zèlia into believing that I'd enacted her revenge on Philomèle. She seemed satisfied - though also a little confused about exactly whom she had been revenged upon. In any case, she paid me.
translation: 我骗泽莉亚相信,我已替她向菲洛梅尔报了仇。她似乎很满意——尽管也有点糊涂,自己究竟向谁报了仇。无论如何,她付了钱。

text: I declined to help her.
translation: 我拒绝帮助她。

text: I declined, once I'd heard more about it.
translation: 听完详情之后,我便拒绝了。

text: I declined. Not my thing.
translation: 我拒绝了。此事非我所长。

text: I did not enjoy it. We will speak of it no more.
translation: 我并不喜欢那样。此事我们不再提起。

text: I didn't know. But I'm not surprised. So the exorcisms. They didn't work?
translation: 我不知道。但我并不意外。那么那些驱魔仪式呢？没有用？

text: I didn't see her throwing any rocks.
translation: 我没见她砸什么石头。

text: I do not offer credit to strangers, monsieur. Be quick, or I will speak to my friends.
translation: 我不向陌生人赊账，先生。快去快回，不然我就要同我的朋友们说说了。

text: I do understand that. And I can only repeat my apology.
translation: 我确实明白。而我只能再次道歉。

text: I do what I can to raise the tone. But one cannot empty the sea with a spoon.
translation: 我尽力把格调拔高些。可一勺是舀不干大海的。

text: I don't always know why.
translation: 我并非总能说清缘由。

text: I don't believe you.
translation: 我不信。

text: I don't believe you. Bring me proof. I will not be gulled by a mountebank.
translation: 我不信你。拿证据来。我不会被个江湖骗子蒙骗。

text: I don't currently have the skills to create a Withering item. I could increase one of [[Hushery]], [[Nyctodromy]] or [[Skolekosophy]] to 5; I could try to trick Zèlia; or I could abandon the whole sorry business.
translation: 我目前还没有能力制作凋零之物。我可以把[[静默术]]、[[夜游术]]或[[蠕虫学]]之一提升到 5；我可以试着骗过泽莉亚；也可以干脆丢开这桩倒霉的差事。

text: I don't especially want a coffee.
translation: 我倒不是特别想喝咖啡。

text: I don't get it. Aristide, can you explain?
translation: 我没听懂。阿里斯蒂德,你能解释解释吗?

text: I don't have time to fence with you, Rodia. Tell me or not.
translation: 我没工夫与你周旋,罗迪娅。你说也罢,不说也罢。

text: I don't like chatter.
translation: 我不喜欢絮叨。

text: I don't like her records. And one is never certain, with a Greek.
translation: 我不喜欢她的唱片。况且,希腊人,你永远摸不准。

text: I don't like to miss anything.
translation: 我不想错过任何东西。

text: I don't really want a bath just now. [Step away.]
translation: 眼下我实在不想泡澡。[走开。]

text: I don't remember much of how it was, when the Worms were in me. Pain; poison; the bright face of the ragged sword; the sticky thickness of golden blood. I do remember that I was never lonely. The ones who put the Worms in me had enjoined us to lay waste to Tresigallo, where they thought the City Unbuilt would rise. But the Worms had people to eat and scores to settle.
translation: 我已经记不太清那些蠕虫在我体内时的情形了。痛苦；毒害；残缺之剑的明亮面目；黄金血液的粘稠厚重。我确实记得我从未感到孤独。那些将蠕虫植入我体内的人曾命令我们夷平特雷西加洛——他们认为未建之城将在那里升起。但蠕虫有要吞噬的人，也有要清算的宿怨。

text:
I don't remember much of how it was, when the Worms were in me...

Recall  <link="mypaststagneseve">My Past: St Agnes' Eve, 1937 (?)</link>
translation:
蠕虫在我体内时是何种光景，我已记不太清……

追忆 <link="mypaststagneseve">我的过去：圣阿格尼丝节前夜，1937年（？）</link>

text: I don't think she expects ever to leave the Sanitarium alive. Stinking shame.
translation: 我看她没指望自己能活着离开疗养院。真他妈的可惜。

text: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么认为。

text: I don't think... wait, no, I remember the name. Here...
translation: 「我不太记得……等等,不,我记得这个名字。在这儿……」

text: I don't want to answer that just now.
translation: 我现在不想回答这个。

text: I don't... I don't really know what you want.
translation: 我不……我真的不明白您想要什么。

text: I favour the Arts Unconsidered - so that's Verdant Places above all, but also sometimes Shadowed Places, Hearths and Thresholds.
translation: 我偏好未识技艺：因此以翠绿之地为首，但也时常用到阴影之地、炉畔与门阈。

text: I favour the Bright Arts: so that's Holy Places above all, but sometimes also Quiet Places, Thresholds and Hearths.
translation: 我偏好光之技艺：因此以圣地为先，但也时常用到静谧之处、门阈与炉畔。

text: I favour the Night Arts: so that's Wounds and Shadowed Places first, but sometimes also Quiet Places and Thresholds.
translation: 我偏好夜之技艺：因此以伤处与阴影之地为先，但也时常用到静谧之处与门阈。

text: I feel Aubière's eyes on my back, but he says nothing.
translation: 我感觉奥比埃的目光落在我背上，但他什么也没说。

text: I feel empty...
translation: 我觉得空虚……

text: I feel so much better.
translation: 感觉好多了。

text: I find him churlish. And his arm revolts me. There; it's said.
translation: 我觉得他粗鲁。他的胳膊,令我作呕。好了,说出来了。

text: I find it more fruitful not to limit myself to narrowly binary ontologies.
translation: 我发现,不把自己局限在狭隘的二元本体论里,更有收获。

text: I found Nina! She'll help me... if I bring her the name of the nun at the Couvent Saint-Mamert de Raveline who is with child.
translation: 我找到尼娜了!她会帮我……只要我带给她一个名字:拉韦林的圣马梅尔修道院里,那位怀有身孕的修女的名字。

text: I found something romantic in the notion of Edge-long - each a dyad of two dearest enemies, each contending eternally down the ages of the world - but I never loved or hated anyone near half enough.
translation: 我在刃之长生者的理念里找到某种浪漫——每一位都是一对最亲密的宿敌，成双成对，在世界诸纪元间永恒争战——但我对任何人的爱与恨，都远远到不了那份程度的一半。

text: I gave Zèlia the letter from Max Mustermann. She seems convinced he is, indeed, her missing husband. A happy ending.
translation: 我把马克斯·穆斯特曼的信交给了泽莉亚。她似乎相信,他确实就是她失踪的丈夫。一个美满的结局。

text: I gave Zèlia the letter from Maître Argant. She seems convinced it is, indeed, her missing husband. A happy ending.
translation: 我把阿尔冈大律师的信交给了泽莉亚。她似乎确信,那的确就是她失踪的丈夫。一个圆满的结局。

text: I gave Zèlia the letter from Topsy Juliusz. She seems convinced he is, indeed, her missing husband. A happy ending.
translation: 我把托普西·尤利乌什的信交给了泽莉亚。她似乎确信,他的确就是她失踪的丈夫。一个圆满的结局。

text: I gave up tobacco back in the thirties. My passengers hated smoke. Something you wouldn't expect from Worm infestation: better skin, better teeth.
translation: 三十年代起我便戒了烟草。我的乘客讨厌烟味。蠕虫侵染倒有一桩意想不到的好处:皮肤更好,牙齿更白。

text: I give you now one-half the sum we agreed. The rest on your return. Go quickly.
translation: 我现在付你约定数目的一半。余下的等你回来再付。快去吧。

text: I had a question...
translation: 我有个问题……

text: I had gone from the stinking dankness of the orphanage into the clean narrow chill of the minor seminary. A serious place. But I was twelve years old that winter, and it is difficult to contain twelve-year olds, even those who lack my particular talent. There was a snowball fight on the cobbles. We conducted an operation for the larceny to liberate chestnuts from their sellers. We burnt our fingers, all of us, and afterwards we had the ferrule across the hand, but that part is only punctuation now. The sunset on the snow...
translation: 我已经离开了那座又臭又黑的孤儿院，来到了整洁、逼仄、寒冷的初级神学院。那是个严肃的地方。但那年冬天我才十二岁，十二岁的孩子都很难约束，哪怕是那些不曾拥有我这样特殊天赋的孩子也一样。我们在鹅卵石地上打过一场雪仗。我们策划过一场盗窃行动，从商贩手中夺走栗子。我们烧伤过自己的手指，无一例外，害得我们的手被套上了箍子。不过，那些事如今只是人生的小小注脚了。雪地上的夕阳……

text:
I had gone from the stinking dankness of the orphanage into the clean narrow chill of the minor seminary...

Recall <link="mypastststephenseve">My Past: St Stephen's Eve, Paris, 1907</link>
translation:
我从孤儿院那股发臭的潮闷中，走进小修院那干净、狭窄的寒意……

追忆 <link="mypastststephenseve">我的过去：圣司提反节前夜，巴黎，1907年</link>

text: I had no opportunity to ask him...
translation: 我没有机会问他……

text: I have already made my feelings very clear on that... icy villainess.
translation: 对于那个……冰冷的恶妇,我的态度已经表达得很清楚了。

text: I have been thinking about the matter, Madame Zèlia...
translation: 泽莉亚夫人，我一直在考虑这件事……

text: I have better things to do than get drunks drunker.
translation: 我还有更要紧的事，犯不着把醉汉灌得更醉。

text: I have concealed nothing from you. The circles in which we both move - the same matters occur, and co-occur. And this institution - indeed, this building itself - benefits from certain parallels to your [[Hush House]]. Some, I will be frank, beyond my understanding.
translation: 我对你什么都没隐瞒。我们彼此活动的圈子里——同样的事一再发生,交相发生。而本院——说实在的,连这栋房子本身——得益于与你的[[噤声居屋]]的某些相似。其中一些,老实说,超出我的理解。

text: I have doctorates from Leiden, Navarre, and Bonn. I'm a colleague of dear Aubière's.
translation: 我在莱顿、纳瓦拉和波恩都取得过博士学位。我是亲爱的奥比埃的同事。

text: I have learnt, over many years, to disregard the promises of fine gentlemen. No.
translation: 「多年以来,我学会了一件事:体面先生们的承诺,听听就算了。不。」

text: I have my ways.
translation: 我有我的办法。

text: I have no choice but to open my hand, revealing a palmed coin.
translation: 我别无他法，只得张开手，露出掌中藏着的一枚硬币。

text: I have no excuses. I can only throw myself upon the mercy of the State.
translation: 我无话可辩。只能请求邦国宽恕。

text: I have no more time for your insolences. Go away.
translation: 我没时间再听你这些无礼之言。走开。

text: I have no pictures. And it was years ago now. Years. He will be different. Only mention my name. Zèlia. He'll remember me.
translation: 我没有照片。而且那是多年前的事了。许多年前。他会变样。你只需提起我的名字。泽莉亚。他会记得我的。

text: I have not told you this.
translation: 这话不是我告诉你的。

text: I have not. I'll return when I have.
translation: 我可没白费够。等白费够了,我再回来。

text: I have nothing to say about monsieur le Directeur.
translation: 关于院长先生,我无可奉告。

text: I have promised Nina a favour: to help her end her long life on her own terms. Rendering her the Sign of the Sun-in-Rags would be a way to achieve this - perhaps the only way.
translation: 我已承诺满足宁娜的一个请求：协助她按自己的意愿结束自己漫长的一生。将残阳的印记交给她或许是达成她愿望的一种方式——或许是唯一的方式。

text: I have reconsidered, Monsieur Hobson. I am ready to tell you where you might find her.
translation: 我重新考虑过了,霍布森先生。我准备告诉你去哪儿找她。

text: I have remembered something. [Mathis accepts the note, which disappears without fuss.]
translation: 我记起了一件事。[马蒂斯收下钞票,它不动声色地消失了。]

text: I have seen your poor spirit, remember, S.H. You are bent by the sign of the Gate.
translation: 我看过你那可怜的魂灵,记得吗,S.H.。你被「门」的印记压弯了。

text: I have stopped speaking. Aubière watches me, wide-eyed.
translation: 我已不再言语。奥比埃睁大眼睛注视着我。

text: I have the sense that someone in Alexandria mentioned something like this...
translation: 我隐约觉得，在亚历山大港有人提起过类似的东西……

text: I have the skills to create a Withering item - if I want.
translation: 我有能力制作一件凋零之物——只要我愿意。

text: I have the skills to create a [[Hallow]] or [[Unveil]] item, which could be useful here. Something to think about.
translation: 我有技艺,可以炼制[[祝圣]]或[[揭示]]之物,在这里或许用得着。值得想一想。

text: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

text: I have wasted enough words with you. Go.
translation: 我跟你白费的话已经够多了。走。

text: I have what I needed from the doctor - I found it in his dream.
translation: 我已从医生那里得到了所需之物——我在他的梦里找到了它。

text: I haven't performed gentleman's rites this morning.
translation: 我今天早上还未行过绅士的仪典。

text: I heard Linou express clear Republican sympathies.
translation: 我听见利努明确流露出共和派的同情。

text: I imagine you will wish to leave without further delay. But I hope that you will return. You are an interesting man. I speak professionally, and otherwise.
translation: 我猜你会希望尽快离开,不再耽搁。但我希望你能回来。你是个有趣的人。这话出于职业立场,也出于别的。

text: I knew one of the clubs he used to play. Chez Bricktop. I've been away a long time... but you don't forget Reinhardt. This must be new?
translation: 他以前常演的俱乐部,我知道一家——布里克托普之家。我离开太久了……但莱因哈特是忘不掉的。这首一定是新作?

text: I knew there was something!
translation: 我就知道有蹊跷！

text: I know exactly. You will find her at the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui, past the park.
translation: 我知道了。你会在今日疗养院找到她，就在公园那边。

text: I know her a little. We used to see each other at church. I felt sorry for her. But she never really approved of me anyway. And I don't think she likes people feeling sorry for her.
translation: 我略略认识她。我们从前常在教堂碰面。我那时可怜她。不过她反正从来没真正看得起我。而且我觉得,她不喜欢别人可怜她。

text: I know how to get into the hidden space at night.
translation: 我知道如何在夜里进入那处隐秘的空间。

text: I know nothing.
translation: 我一无所知。

text: I know the name. We can discuss that when our business is done.
translation: 我听过这个名字。等正事办完,再谈这个。

text: I know what I said. Don't confuse me. She's just as bad, anyway.
translation: 我知道我说了什么。别来搅乱我。反正她也一样坏。

text: I know where to find Nina Lagasse. I don't need to risk snooping around in Dr A's records.
translation: 我知道去哪里找尼娜·拉加斯了。不必再冒险翻查 A 医生的档案。

text: I laid the curse on Philomèle. Not on Griotte.
translation: 我把诅咒施在了菲洛梅尔身上。不是格里奥特。

text: I learnt a great deal that day.
translation: 那一天,我学到了很多。

text:
I left the Légion when my five years were done. I didn't think anything could be worse than the Rung Ma or Khorasan. So when the [[Bureau]] invited me back, I accepted.

It was at Gladwyn Lake - when I saw the foxfire in the crawling waters, when I saw the celebrant grow fruitful - I knew I'd been wrong. But we kept the lid on the worst of it, and they offered me another promotion. I knew the Bureau had changed, but I thought I could help change it back. And I very quickly grew used to the pay.
translation:
我五年服役期满后便离开了门关军团。我曾以为没有什么比戎马或呼罗珊更糟的了。因此，当防剿局再次邀请我时，我接受了。

直到在格拉德温湖——当我看见爬行水域中的磷火，看见主祭者变得丰硕之时——我才知道自己错了。但我们掩盖了最糟糕的部分，他们又给了我一次晋升。我知道防剿局已经变了，但我以为能帮忙把它变回去。而且我很快就习惯了那份薪水。

text:
I left the Légion when my five years were done. I didn't think anything could be worse than the Rung Ma or Khorasan... 

Recall <link="mypaststrobigoseve">My Past: St Robigo's Eve, Gladwyn Lake, 1935</link>
translation:
五年期满后，我离开了军团。我曾以为，没有什么会比朗玛或呼罗珊更糟……

追忆 <link="mypaststrobigoseve">我的过去：圣罗比戈节前夜，格拉德温湖，1935年</link>

text: I like happy endings.
translation: 我喜欢圆满的结局。

text: I like the cold.
translation: 我喜欢寒冷。

text: I liked it, though.
translation: 不过，我喜欢。

text:
I liked the painted nights on the stage, for the gasps of the audience and the absence of uncertainty.

Recall <link="mypaststbrazenseve">My Past: St Brazen's Eve, 1924</link>
translation:
我喜欢舞台上的彩绘之夜，为的是观众的惊叹，也为那份没有不确定性的时光。

追忆 <link="mypaststbrazenseve">我的过去：圣黄铜节前夜，1924年</link>

text: I liked the painted nights on the stage, for the gasps of the audience and the absence of uncertainty. It still comes back to me when I smell sawdust or stale beer. Every now and every then, I did a little - a very little - real magic. That's probably why the [[Bureau]] caught up with me.
translation: 我喜欢舞台上那些涂满色彩的夜晚，喜欢观众倒吸一口气时的惊叹，也喜欢那里没有任何不确定性的感觉。每当闻到木屑或隔夜啤酒的气味，我总会想起那段日子。偶尔——真的只是偶尔——我会施展一点真正的魔法。大概，也正因为如此，[[防剿局]]最终找上了我。

text: I look forward to meeting again on the other side of sleep, shining one.
translation: 期待与你在睡眠的彼岸重逢,光辉者。

text: I mean - Moscow -
translation: 我是说——莫斯科——

text: I mean nothing by it. But you understand it is surprising, to meet you in such a dream.
translation: 我并无冒犯之意。但你得理解，在这样一场梦里遇见你，实在令人惊讶。

text: I mean...
translation: 我是说……

text: I mean: everything good - everything, really - is supposed to emanate from the Oneness. It comes down to us from the henads, which participate in the Oneness, along their seirai. And at points along its descent, it manifests as distinct things we perceive. Like the Sun, or the phenomenal Hours.
translation: 我的意思是：一切善——真的，是一切——都据称自至一流出。它从那些参与至一的太一处而来，沿它们的赛拉降临到我们身上。而在它下降途中的某些节点上，它显现为我们所感知的种种不同之物。比如太阳，或那些现象司辰。

text: I mentioned earlier that I'm looking for a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]]...
translation: 我之前提过，我在找一个叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]的女人……

text: I met a man in Venice once who liked to say that the past was a foreign country...
translation: 我在威尼斯曾遇见过一个人,他喜欢说,过去是异国他乡……

text: I might ask you the same, m'sieu.
translation: 我也想这么问您,先生。

text: I miss Alex
translation: 我想念亚历山大

text: I miss him, signaire. I loved him so. Even now I will forgive him.
translation: 我想他，符师。我那样爱他。即便是现在，我也愿原谅他。

text: I miss him.
translation: 我想念他。

text: I miss it still
translation: 我仍思念它

text: I miss it.
translation: 我想念它。

text: I must be frank. You have brought disharmony to my house. Your presence here makes it increasingly difficult to concentrate on more important business.
translation: 我得直说。你给我的宅院带来了不谐。你的在场,让我愈发难以专心处理更要紧的事务。

text: I must find Nina Lagasse. My heart's been very clear about that since the day I returned to the world. Nina, as they say, knows where the bodies are buried.
translation: 我必须找到尼娜·拉加斯。自我重返世间那天起,我的心对此便一清二楚。正如人们所说,尼娜知道那些尸体埋在何处。

text: I must warn you: this is a bad book. A very bad book.
translation: 我必须提醒您:这是一本坏书。一本非常坏的书。

text: I need no appointment. My business is of the highest importance.
translation: 我不需要预约。我要办的事至关重要。

text: I need to find a woman called [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我要找一个名叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]的女人。

text: I need to read the scenario,  and satisfy a sceptical Monica that I can do this.
translation: 我需要读一读剧本,再让满腹狐疑的莫妮卡相信,我能胜任。

text: I need to see a patient of yours. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我要见你的一位病人。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: I need to speak with the Director.
translation: 我要见院长。

text: I never completed my medical degree, though I learnt enough to set a bone and treat a fever. I was distracted by medicine's occult hinterlands. In 1927, Spencer was sponsored by the Suppression Bureau to study medicine. When that arrangement fell apart in 1930, he signed up for five years as a medical officer in the [[Légion du Seuil]].
translation: 我从未修完医学学位,不过我学到的已经足够接骨、退烧。是医学背后那片秘术地带分了我的心。 1927 年,斯宾塞受防剿局资助学医。1930 年,这项安排破裂之后,他在[[门关军团]]应征为军医,为期五年。

text: I never mix business with politics. A rule of long standing. Very useful, this last decade. Now: shall we do business?
translation: 我从不把生意与政治混为一谈。这是多年的规矩。过去这十年,尤其受用。好了:我们谈生意吧?

text: I never really understood that.
translation: 我从未真正理解过这一点。

text: I never succeeded
translation: 我从未成功

text: I never tried
translation: 我从未尝试

text:
I notice details others don't.

[A [[Worldly Skill]].]
translation:
我能注意到旁人忽略的细节。

[一项[[世俗技艺]]。]

text: I noticed some, ah, gaps in Antibes. Do you know what they are?
translation: 我注意到,昂蒂布有一些,呃,裂隙。您知道那是什么吗?

text: I only hoped that you would reconsider; but the saint knew that you would.
translation: 我不过是盼望您回心转意;但圣人知道,您会。

text: I passed through the outer oceans...
translation: 我曾穿越外海……

text: I prepared Labrikon earlier. I'll use it to visit Aubière's dreams. [This won't be restful, and you won't lose Troubles.]
translation: 我之前准备了拉布里孔。我要用它进入奥比埃的梦境。[这一觉不会安稳，烦扰也不会消除。]

text: I promise nothing.
translation: 我什么也不保证。

text: I promised that I would help the Lantern-long Sinombre, the next time that she needed it.
translation: 我答应过,下一次灯性长生者西诺姆布尔需要帮助时,我会伸出援手。

text: I propose an arrangement. I have in my desk a certain box, which has resisted my efforts to open it. Before your so-mysterious disappearance, you were, I understand, good with locks. Seals. Safeguards of that kind.
translation: 我提议一项安排。我的书桌里有一只盒子,一直抗拒着我打开它的尝试。在您那次神秘莫测的失踪之前,据我所知,您精于锁具。封缄。诸如此类的防护之法。

text: I reach out as if to brush something from her headband.
translation: 我伸出手，仿佛要拂去她发带上的一点什么。

text: I really don't need another bath just yet. [Step away.]
translation: 我现在真的还不需要再泡一次澡。[走开。]

text: I reckon Chance won.
translation: 我猜是机缘赢了。

text: I regret: we sell only books here.
translation: 很遗憾:我们这里只卖书。

text: I remember a night when Ghirbi spoke of the Door. 'Our company it was that shattered it. Before the [[Gods-who-were-flesh]], the House was forbidden to mortals. We were the first [[Know]]. I wish that we had not. I wish I had died in the world...'
translation: 我记得一个夜晚，吉比尔说起那扇门。『是我们一伙人砸碎了它。在[[肉源之神]]之前，居屋对凡人是不许进入的。我们是最早的[[知者]]。我但愿我们不曾那样做。我但愿我当年就死在人间……』

text: I remember a night when Ghirbi was talkative. He spoke in his siege-engine voice of the [[histories]] he'd overheard in the waking world. I listened, until his stories tailed off again into weeping.
translation: 我记得一个夜晚，吉比尔话很多。他用那攻城机械般的嗓音讲起他在醒时世界偷听到的[[历史]]。我听着，直到他的故事又渐渐消隐成呜咽。

text: I remember a night when Ghirbi wept again. I scooped up his tears of molten brass in my cupped palm. In the dream, my skin peeled and blistered, but only in the dream.
translation: 我记得一个夜晚，吉比尔又哭了。我捧起手掌，接住他熔铜般滚烫的眼泪。在梦里，我的皮肤剥落、起泡，但只是梦里。

text: I remember her martyrdom. She was burnt and beheaded. Somewhere in there, she was forced to drink boiling pitch. Then her body was set to drift on the sea until it washed up on a coast, somewhere.
translation: 我记得她的殉难。她被火焚,被斩首。其间,她还被逼着喝下滚沸的沥青。随后,她的遗体被放入大海漂荡,直到在某处海岸搁浅。

text: I remember that I remarked on it; and he told me that it was a 'prefigure', done before the war by one of the Librarians of the place - someone who had the knack of copying work by other artists. But he'd copy the work before they'd ever actually painted it.
translation: 我记得我曾就它作过评点;他告诉我,那是一件“先行之作”,战前由此地一位司书所作——此人颇擅摹仿其他艺术家的作品。但他摹仿的,是那些艺术家尚未来得及画出的作品。

text: I remember the story...
translation: 我记得这个故事……

text: I remember you!
translation: 我记得你！

text: I remember. At the Sanitarium, they said you'd arrived with Nina, didn't they? Interesting. Let's take a look at you...
translation: 我记得。在疗养院,他们说你跟尼娜一起来的,对吧?有意思。让我好好瞧瞧你……

text: I repaid my debt to Sinombre.
translation: 我还清了欠西诺姆布尔的债。

text: I returned from the Mansus to flesh...
translation: 我从漫宿归来，重获血肉之躯……

text: I said that the [[Enemy]] disliked swing. But not all of them. They let the Roulotte stay open late, you know? The men in grey. So they could listen to Reinhardt.
translation: 我说过[[敌人]]不喜欢摇摆乐。但并非人人如此。他们让大篷车开到很晚,你知道吗?那些穿灰衣的人。就为了能听莱因哈特。

text: I saved lives, wearing this.
translation: 穿着这身制服,我救过人命。

text: I saw Bronek in this carriage, and also in the rear carriage. 'Dappled,'  he said when I asked.
translation: 我看见布罗内克在这节车厢里，也在后面那节车厢里。「斑驳，」我问他时，他这么回答。

text: I saw strange things, over where the rain ends.
translation: 在雨水终结之处，我看见了一些奇异之物。

text: I saw what happened to people who passed that door. I'm confident it would have been different for me. But I never did answer Ghirbi's riddle.
translation: 我见过穿过那扇门的人会怎样。我确信换成我会不一样。但我始终没有答出吉比尔的谜语。

text: I saw what happened to people who passed that door. Not all of them. But enough of them. So I never really made the attempt.
translation: 我见过穿过那扇门的人会怎样。不是所有人。但足够多的人。所以，我从未真正做出尝试。

text: I see deeper, petitioner, than any mere flesh. Have a care what you say in this place.
translation: 我看得比任何血肉之躯都深,请愿者。在这个地方说话,当心些。

text: I see your point. I regret it. But some men are simply not suited to each other's company.
translation: 我明白你的意思。很遗憾。但有些人就是合不来,仅此而已。

text: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

text: I see. And so does the saint. This is very good.
translation: 我明白了。圣人也明白了。这很好。

text: I see. Never mind, then.
translation: 我明白了。那就算了。

text: I see. [He makes a note.]
translation: 我明白了。[他记了一笔。]

text: I set out to disinter the Signs of the dead Hours. Why?
translation: 我动身去掘出那些死去司辰的印记。为什么?

text: I should be going, then.
translation: 那么，我该走了。

text: I should be sure I've considered all the other options... [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation: 我得先确认自己考虑过所有其他选项……〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

text: I should follow her to the Sanitarium, then. Thank you.
translation: 「那我该跟到疗养院去了。谢谢您。」

text: I should go.
translation: 我该走了。

text: I should go. Thanks for the omelette, Bessy.
translation: 我该走了。谢谢你的蛋卷,贝茜。

text: I should have known -
translation: 我早该知道的——

text: I should not discuss the health of other guests. But I can say that there is some reason for optimism.
translation: 我不该谈论其他客人的健康状况。但我可以说,有理由乐观。

text: I should not, perhaps, have raised the matter. I hope I have not offended.
translation: 也许,我不该提起这件事。希望没有冒犯到您。

text: I spent a decade outside the world. I'm not who I used to be. I don't know exactly who I am now. Not yet.
translation: 我在世界之外度过了十年。我已不是昔日的我。我也不清楚,自己如今究竟是谁。还没有。

text: I started to wonder. If this one thing is not as I've been taught - how deep do the differences go? How high?
translation: 我开始猜想。若这一件事并不如我所受的教导——那么差异究竟有多深？又有多高？

text: I stayed for a while. I knew Mat, I knew Mat's crowd. Me, two other girls, we were singing. We were doing okay, even then.
translation: 我留了一阵。我认识马特,认识马特那帮人。我,还有另外两个姑娘,我们一起唱歌。哪怕在那时候,我们混得也还凑合。

text: I stow the cigars carefully in my pockets to minimise the risk of crushing them.
translation: 我把雪茄小心收进衣袋，尽量减少压坏它们的风险。

text: I suppose I can hardly prevent you...
translation: 想来我也拦不住你……

text: I suppose I will, won't -
translation: 我想我会记住的，不是吗——

text: I suppose then you must be a man of means - a respectable man. You may bring me your papers later.
translation: 那我想，您一定是位有财力的体面人。以后再把证件拿给我看就行。

text: I suppose we can. But we keep strict accounts at the Librairie des Heures. Be sure not to forget your debt to little Andrée.
translation: 「我想可以。不过,我们时光书店的账目分毫不差。可别忘了,您还欠小安德烈一份人情。」

text: I suppose, in a way -
translation: 我想，从某种意义上说——

text: I suppose.
translation: 算是吧。

text: I suppose. In a sense.
translation: 也许吧。在某种意义上。

text: I survived their torments, and the reward they did not intend: now,  I can survive much more.
translation: 我在他们的折磨中幸存了下来，这带给了我他们意料之外的回报：我将能在更困难的境地下幸存。

text: I suspect it's too mystical for me, also. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我猜,对我来说它也太过玄奥。我们聊点别的吧。

text: I suspected as much. For a while now, I have had my eye on that woman.
translation: 我早就有所怀疑。那个女人，我已经盯了一阵子了。

text: I swear that I'll guide you; nor draw from your strength; nor enter where I am not bid. On the [[Watchman]] I swear it, the Door in the Eye, on his robe and his [[Names]] and his light.
translation: 我发誓,为你引路;不汲取你的力量;不踏入未受邀请之地。以[[守夜人]]起誓,以瞳中之门、以他的衣袍、他的[[名号]]与他的光起誓。

text: I thank you for the admiration, [q=alias.formal.fr].
translation: 承蒙您的佩服,[q=alias.formal.fr]。

text: I think I'm a visitor. Aubière thinks I'm a resident.
translation: 我觉得我是访客。奥比埃觉得我是住客。

text: I think of myself as an exorcist...
translation: 我认为自己是个驱魔师...

text: I think sometimes that I will never look upon the sea without that memory surfacing like a shark - that memory of the knives of Ys.
translation: 我有时想，自己再也无法看海而不让那段记忆像鲨鱼一样浮出水面——那段关于伊苏之刀的回忆。

text: I think that in fact you do.
translation: 我觉得你其实挺像。

text: I think...
translation: 我想……

text: I thought I had that one.
translation: 我还以为那一局是我的。

text: I thought they'd pulped every copy...
translation: 我以为他们把每一本都打成纸浆了……

text: I thought, I've been lied to. The eternal can be altered. It's not even that difficult.
translation: 我想：我被骗了。永恒之物是可以改变的。甚至并不怎么难。

text: I told Aubière where he could put his offer. But I can probably find someone else here who can help me find Nina Lagasse.
translation: 我告诉奥比埃,他的提议该滚到哪儿去。但我大概还能在这里找到别人,帮我找到尼娜·拉加斯。

text: I told her I would find her husband... free of charge.
translation: 我告诉她,我会找到她的丈夫……分文不取。

text: I told you: it got into my dreams once already. It's hard to get it out once it's in there, you know?
translation: 我跟你说过:它已经钻进过我的梦里一次了。一旦进了去,就很难把它赶出来,你懂吧?

text: I travel; I seek. Yes.
translation: 我远行;我求索。是的。

text: I travelled third class from Alexandria. Never again.
translation: 我从亚历山大港来时坐的就是三等座。绝不再坐了。

text: I travelled third class from Alexandria. Slatted wooden benches and students bawling drinking-songs. Sometimes, cages of chickens. Just once, a small but desperately plaintive goat. I didn't get much sleep.
translation: 我从亚历山大港来时坐的就是三等座。条板木凳,学生们扯着嗓子唱酒歌。偶尔还有装鸡的笼子。只有一次,笼子里是一只小小的山羊,叫得凄惨至极。我没睡多少觉。

text: I trust you did
translation: 我相信你没有

text: I turn the handle. With an oiled click, the safe swings open, yawning a steel yawn...
translation: 我转动把手。随着一声油润的咔嗒,保险柜的门荡开,仿佛打了个钢铁的哈欠……

text: I understand what you are saying. You are wrong; but I understand. Go beneath the eye of Heaven.
translation: 我明白您的话。您错了;但我明白。去吧,愿您在苍天之眼下前行。

text: I understand your arm is named Annabelle?
translation: 我听说,您的胳膊名叫安娜贝尔?

text: I understand your feelings, M. Hobson, most sincerely I -
translation: 我理解你的感受，霍布森先生，万分真诚地，我——

text: I understand. A little peculiar, it occurs to me, that one thinks aloud, but that one speaks to oneself. Not 'speaks silently'. No?
translation: 我明白。我忽然觉得有几分奇特:人说是「自言自语」,却说是「出声地思考」,而非「无声地说话」。不是吗?

text: I used to visit the White Door in dreams myself. Something about the chill tugs at a memory...
translation: 我自己过去也常在梦中拜访白门。那寒意似乎牵动着某段回忆……

text: I wanted pyrotechnics for the ending The stage manager overruled me. Probably for the best.
translation: 结尾我本想要烟花效果。舞台经理否决了我。或许这样最好。

text: I wanted to see what would happen.
translation: 我只是想看看会发生什么。

text: I wanted to talk about malcontents in Antibes. You had mentioned a little gift?
translation: 我想谈谈昂蒂布的不满分子。您提过,有份小礼物?

text: I was a prisoner
translation: 我曾是囚徒

text: I was always good with my hands, and I took that talent to the stage to pay the bills. Eventually, my illusions were sufficiently convincing to draw the attention of the [[Suppression Bureau]]. In Europe, since the War, a knack for appearances and disappearances is more useful than ever. Since 1924, Spencer has intermittently been known to perform as 'Father Brass'.
translation: 我的手一向灵巧,于是我把这份天赋带上舞台,靠它养家糊口。久而久之,我的幻术逼真得足以引来[[防剿局]]的注意。 在欧洲,自大战以来,擅长现身与消失的把戏比以往任何时候都更有用。 自 1924 年起,斯宾塞偶尔会以「黄铜神父」之名登台献艺。

text: I was hollowed out by [[Worms]]. Although now I'm recovering.
translation: 我曾被[[蠕虫]]掏空。不过如今,正在恢复。

text: I was in London, reviewing books and trying to get my plays staged. I could have been rubbing shoulders with Cocteau and Bischoff and Stravinsky. Writing film scripts and librettos...
translation: 我那时在伦敦,评书撰稿,设法让我的剧作搬上舞台。我本可以跻身科克托、比绍夫与斯特拉文斯基之列。写电影剧本,写歌剧脚本……

text: I was mistaken? Well, my sight is not what it was.
translation: 是我认错了人?唉,我的眼力已大不如前。

text: I was on the train from Milan at dawn, before the cafés opened.
translation: 拂晓时分,我正坐在从米兰开出的火车上,那时咖啡馆还没开门。

text: I was the youngest chaplain in the regiment, but Father Schaller had taken me under his wing, and Father Schaller was Exorcist-in-Ordinary. And so I became his assistant. In the ashes and churned earth at [[Cambray]], in the sick and shattered places, it was me they would call to give the viaticum to the dying - when it was feared the dead might struggle up again after, with their bones grinding like glass.
translation: 我是团里最年轻的随军牧师，而沙勒神父一直对我悉心提携。沙勒神父还是教会正式任命的驱魔师，因此，我成了他的助手。也因此，在[[康布雷]]那片布满灰烬与炮火翻搅过的土地上，在那些充满病痛与残破的地方，人们总会叫我前去，为垂死之人施予临终圣体 ——因为他们害怕死者会重新挣扎着站起，伴随着骨骼彼此摩擦，发出宛如玻璃碎裂般刺耳的声响。

text:
I was the youngest chaplain in the regiment, but Father Schaller had taken me under his wing... 

Recall <link="mypaststoulioseve">My Past: St Oulio's Eve, Cambray, 1919</link>
translation:
我是团里最年轻的随军神父，但沙勒神父已将我护在羽翼之下……

追忆 <link="mypaststoulioseve">我的过去：圣欧利奥节前夜，康布雷，1919年</link>

text: I watched men die, wearing this.
translation: 穿着这身制服,我看着人们死去。

text: I will consider it second-hand inventory, then. Should you change your mind before I find a buyer, let me know.
translation: 那么,我就把它当作二手存货处置了。若在我找到买主之前您改变了主意,请告诉我。

text: I will consider your proposal.
translation: 我会考虑你的提议。

text: I will do my very best to answer it!
translation: 我一定尽力回答!

text: I will endeavour so not to do.
translation: 我会努力不再如此。

text: I will hope for your reunion.
translation: 我会祈盼你们重逢。

text: I will know who you are, and what you're doing here.
translation: 我会弄清楚你是谁,以及你在这里做什么。

text: I will share a secret. Andrée, at the Librairie des Heures, sells other things than books.
translation: 我分享一个秘密。安德烈，在时光书店那位，除了书还卖别的东西。

text: I wish I had something more to offer you in return. But I can give you only my blessing.
translation: 我真希望还有别的东西能回报您。可我只有祝福可以给您。

text: I wish I'd said goodbye
translation: 我但愿自己道过别

text: I wish you every chance. But Nina's gone. I liked her, but I never trusted her. So smooth; so bright; so sharp. I don't know what she sought, here in Antibes. She said once that the sun sets here; but yet I do not think she liked to watch it set.
translation: 我祝你一切顺利。但尼娜已经走了。我喜欢她,却从不信任她。那么圆滑;那么明艳;那么锋利。我不知道她在昂蒂布寻求什么。她曾说过,太阳在这里落下;可我觉得,她并不喜欢看它落下。

text: I won't forget this.
translation: 我不会忘记这个。

text: I wonder - I wonder if you find it comforting, perhaps. I mean that in these times, all of us must make hard choices - decisions about where to take our lives. While you are so fixated on Mme Lagasse, you do not need to consider other matters. You are like a questing knight, perhaps, freed from the quotidian.
translation: 我在想——我在想,这或许令你安心。我的意思是,在这年月,我们谁都得做出艰难的选择——决定要把人生带向何方。而当你如此专注地追着拉加斯夫人,就不必再考虑别的事了。你就像一位行侠的骑士,也许,摆脱了尘世的琐屑。

text: I wonder if it's true.
translation: 不知此事是否属实。

text: I wonder if you mean your heart has imposed upon you? Sometimes I think that Strathcoyne's arm must be an imposition. But I find you more appealing than that man.
translation: 我在想,你的意思是不是说,你的心强加于你?有时我觉得,斯特拉斯科因的胳膊,想必也是一种强加。不过,你比那个人讨人喜欢得多。

text: I wonder what I'd look like with Dundrearies? Or a neat little goatee?
translation: 不知蓄起邓德雷里式长鬓须，会是什么模样？或者一把整齐的小山羊胡？

text: I wonder what secret this box contains, hm?
translation: 不知道这盒子里藏着什么秘密，嗯？

text: I wonder where I'll wear it? A garden party? A cricket match? A desert conjuration?
translation: 不知我会在哪儿穿上它?花园派对?板球赛?还是荒漠中的一场召唤?

text: I wonder where I'll wear it? A snow festival? An arctic expedition? At the head of the stairs to an unnamable abyss?
translation: 不知道我会在哪儿穿它?一场冰雪节?一次北极探险?还是在通往不可名状之渊的楼梯顶端?

text: I wondered whether I could be of any assistance to the Milice. I have experience as a private inquiry agent.
translation: 我在想，自己能不能为法国民兵出一份力。我做过私人调查员。

text:
I'd been out drinking with Teresa and Christopher, and when I came back to my rooms, the quiet men of the [[Bureau]] were waiting. I had performed unwise feats, they pointed out. I had kept unwise company. If I came with them, all that would be forgotten. Already I was a private inquiry agent, when I wasn't performing under the Brass name or writing under the Lux one. The Bureau would be the same. Just better paid.

No, they said, I wouldn't have to turn in my friends. Not unless I wanted a promotion.
translation:
我和特蕾莎、克里斯托弗出去喝了酒，当我回到住处时，一群沉默寡言的[[防剿局]]员工正等着我。他们指出，我曾做过不明智的举动，也曾结交过不该结交的人。若我跟他们走，这一切就既往不咎。那时，我不以“黄铜”之名登台或以“勒克斯”之名写作时，就已是个私人调查员了。防剿局也不过是类似的差事——只是薪水更高罢了。

他们说，不，我不用出卖朋友。除非我想要晋升。

text:
I'd been out drinking with Teresa and Christopher, and when I came back to my rooms, the quiet men of the [[Bureau]] were waiting... 

Recall <link="mypastlammastide">My Past: Lammastide, Camden Lock, 1925</link>
translation:
我和特蕾莎、克里斯托弗在外头喝了一夜的酒，回到住处时，[[防剿局]]那些沉默的人已经等着我了……

追忆 <link="mypastlammastide">我的过去：收获节，卡姆登船闸，1925年</link>

text: I'd like to examine it further. I'm sure you won't mind.
translation: 我想再仔细研究它。想必你不会介意。

text: I'd say it's more like pissing in a violin. But that's because I lack manners.
translation: 要我说，更像往小提琴里撒尿。不过那是因为我缺乏教养。

text: I'll be leaving with the Rosa Mundi circus.
translation: 我将随罗莎·蒙迪马戏团一同离开。

text: I'll come back later.
translation: 我稍后再来。

text: I'll consider it.
translation: 我会考虑的。

text: I'll consider the trabai.
translation: 我会考虑这桩差事。

text: I'll cut a dash.
translation: 我要穿出风采。

text: I'll need something in return. I'm looking for someone: a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我需要回报。我在找一个人:一位名叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]的女子。

text: I'll need time in front of the mirror tomorrow morning to renew my Well-Groomed condition.
translation: 明早我还得在镜子前花些时间,重新打理出仪表整洁的状态。

text: I'll need to consult with my superiors. Wait here.
translation: 我得请示上级。你在这里等着。

text:
I'll need two things: an Influence with the Grail aspect, and something Sharp to shed my blood (a razor blade would do).


I can craft it at a Verdant Place - also, with Bosk 5, at a Shadowed Place; with Birdsong 5, at a Threshold; or with Preservation 5, at a Hearth.
translation:
我需要两样东西:一样带杯性相的影响,以及一件锋利之物,用来割破我的血(剃刀片就行)。


我可以在翠绿之地炼制它——丛林学达到 5 时,也可在幽影之地炼制;鸟鸣学达到 5 时,可在门关炼制;保存术达到 5 时,可在炉边炼制。

text:
I'll need two things: an Influence with the Lantern aspect, and a token of Authority (an Incorporate dollar would do).


I can craft it at a Holy Place - also, with Horomachistry 5, at a Threshold; with Illumination 5, at a Quiet Place; or with Ithastry 5, at a Hearth.
translation:
我需要两样东西:一份带有灯性相的影响,以及一枚权威凭证(一枚集团美元就行)。


我可以在圣地炼制它——同样,司辰学 5 时可在门关,照明术 5 时可在幽静之地,盗火术 5 时可在炉边。

text: I'll need two things: an Influence with the Moth aspect, and a token of Necessity (a Ministries doli would work). With Nyctodromy 5, I can craft it at a Wound or Threshold. With Skolekosophy 5, I can craft it at a Wound or Shadowed Place. With Hushery 5, I can craft it at a Shadowed or a Quiet Place.
translation: 我需要两样东西:一样带蛾性相的影响,以及一件'必然'的信物(联盟的诈符也行)。 夜游术达到 5 时,我可以在受创之地或门关炼制。 蠕虫学达到 5 时,我可以在受创之地或幽影之地炼制。 静默术达到 5 时,我可以在幽影之地或静谧之地炼制。

text: I'll show them 'rough'.
translation: 我会让他们见识见识什么叫「艰难」。

text: I'll stay here for the moment. And perhaps we'll talk again.
translation: 我暂且留在这里。也许，我们还会再谈。

text: I'll think about it
translation: 我会考虑的

text: I'll wake in the night.
translation: 我会在夜里醒来。

text: I'm Spencer Hobson.
translation: 我是斯宾塞·霍布森。

text: I'm Sylvain Huissier.
translation: 我是西尔万·韦西耶。

text: I'm a complicated man.
translation: 我是个复杂的人。

text: I'm a doctor.
translation: 我是医生。

text: I'm a priest.
translation: 我是神父。

text: I'm a wanderer, not a pilgrim.
translation: 我是个漫游者,不是巡礼者。

text: I'm afraid I'm not at liberty to say.
translation: 恐怕我不便相告。

text: I'm afraid I've come out without any form of identification.
translation: 恐怕我出门时没带任何身份证明。

text: I'm afraid so. I had it directly from him. In fact, the doctor is the only person I've heard use this silly nickname.
translation: 恐怕是的。我是从他本人那里听来的。事实上,这个傻绰号,我只听医生一个人用过。

text: I'm afraid, [q=alias.first], the games are finished for today.
translation: 恐怕,[q=alias.first],今天的牌局到此为止了。

text: I'm by the wall at the back of Aubière's office.
translation: 我正站在奥比埃办公室的后墙边。

text: I'm certain that was the name you gave.
translation: 我很确定你当时说的就是这个名字。

text: I'm disappointed in you, Dr Aubière.
translation: 我对你很失望，奥比埃医生。

text: I'm expected.
translation: 有人等着见我。

text: I'm fine, Bessy, thank you.
translation: 我没事,贝茜,谢谢。

text: I'm free of it.
translation: 我已摆脱了它。

text: I'm glad to find you here.
translation: 我很高兴在这儿遇见你。

text: I'm going on stage again. It's been a while.
translation: 我要再次登台了。已隔了好些时候。

text: I'm going to make sure that everyone understands what it means to cross me.
translation: 我要让所有人都明白，与我为敌意味着什么。

text:
I'm good with words. This can be useful when I want to explain to someone why they might want to help - or at least ensure they'll enjoy listening. It can also be useful for speed-reading, or spotting details like word choice and subtext.

[A [[Worldly Skill]].]
translation:
我擅长言辞。当我想向某人解释他们为何应当帮忙——或至少确保他们听得入耳时,这很有用。它也能用于速读,或留意遣词与言外之意之类的细节。

[一项[[世俗技艺]]。]

text: I'm high up - very high up. There is a flight of stairs, stretching down into the dark. It is light by torches. Someone will come. I will guard against them...
translation: 我在高处——很高的地方。有一段楼梯，向下延伸进黑暗。火把照亮着它。会有人来。我得防着他们……

text: I'm known as
translation: 人们称我为

text: I'm listening.
translation: 我在听。

text: I'm looking for [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我在找[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: I'm looking for a former patient of yours. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我在找您的一位旧病人。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: I'm looking for a woman - [[Nina Lagasse]]. I wonder if the Milice knows where to find her.
translation: 我在找一个女人——[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。我在想，法国民兵会不会知道去哪儿找她。

text: I'm looking for a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 「我在找一个女人,名叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。」

text: I'm looking for a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]]...
translation: 我在找一个名叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]的女人……

text: I'm looking for a woman who was here in the Sanitarium. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我在找一个女人,她曾在这家疗养院里住过。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: I'm looking for a woman. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我在找一位女士。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: I'm looking for someone too. A woman. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我也在找一个人。一个女人。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: I'm looking for someone.
translation: 我在找一个人。

text: I'm looking for someone. A woman.
translation: 我在找一个人。一个女人。

text: I'm more than just a medic, Vincent. You must be starting to understand that by now.
translation: 我可不只是个医生,文森特。到了现在,你总该开始明白了吧。

text: I'm not a nihilist! You're not nearly as funny as you think you are, Aristide.
translation: 我不是虚无主义者！你远没自己想的那么有趣，阿里斯蒂德。

text: I'm not committing. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation: 我不打算现在就定下来。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

text: I'm not going to talk to you like this, Sinombre. It's the twentieth century.
translation: 我不会这样跟你说话,西诺姆布尔。如今是二十世纪。

text: I'm not going to waste time worrying about that. Take each day as it comes.
translation: 我才不会浪费时间为此烦恼。过好每一天就是了。

text: I'm not immortal. (Who is, now?) I  should watch my health.
translation: 我并非不朽之身。（如今还有谁是呢？）我得关注自己的健康状况。

text: I'm not making any more charitable donations to newcomers with... unexpectedly good luck.
translation: 我可不想再向运气……出乎意料地好的新人,做慈善捐献了。

text: I'm not sure I'd measure up. Later, perhaps. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation: 我不确定自己能配得上。以后再说，也许。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

text: I'm not sure about this.
translation: 我拿不准这事。

text: I'm not sure if I believe that.
translation: 我不确定该不该相信这话。

text: I'm not sure why we're here. What are we talking about?
translation: 我不太明白我们怎么会在这里。我们在谈论什么？

text: I'm not surprised at all. I think he may not even be a real doctor.
translation: 我一点也不意外。我看他甚至可能根本不是真正的医生。

text: I'm now Well-Groomed.
translation: 我现在仪表整洁了。

text: I'm smiling and smiling am I in motion - beneath a glory of gold that loves me - should I give myself to it - should I only give myself -
translation: 我微笑着，微笑着，我正飘然而行——在爱着我的金色辉光之下——我该把自己交给它吗——我该只把自己交出去吗——

text: I'm sorry - sometimes, when a gentleman is dazzled by beauty, he fumbles his manners.
translation: 抱歉——有时候,绅士被美色晃了眼,便会乱了礼数。

text: I'm sorry to tell you, Mr Hobson, that you must be mistaken. Dr Aubière is a man of excellent character.
translation: 很抱歉,我要告诉你,霍布森先生,你一定是弄错了。奥比埃医生,品行端方。

text: I'm sorry to tell you, Mr Strathcoyne, that I heard this 'Annabelle' nonsense directly from Dr Aubière. I had no idea it would offend you so. I'm very disappointed in him.
translation: 很抱歉告诉您,斯特拉斯科因先生,这「安娜贝尔」的胡话,我是从奥比埃医生那里亲耳听来的。我不知道这会如此冒犯您。我对他,非常失望。

text: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to be crude. I wondered if there were benefits to your condition - rejuvenations.
translation: 抱歉,我无意粗鲁。我只是在想,你的病症是否也有好处——比如返老还童。

text: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to be impertinent. It was a botanical enquiry.
translation: 抱歉,我无意冒犯。那只是一次植物学上的探询。

text: I'm sorry, Jaume. I'm not who you think I am.
translation: 抱歉,若梅。我不是您想的那个人。

text: I'm sorry, that was not exactly true. But it's important that I find her.
translation: 抱歉,刚才那句话不完全属实。但找到她,对我很重要。

text: I'm sorry.
translation: 「我很抱歉。」

text: I'm sorry. Is that difficult for you?
translation: 我很抱歉。这对你来说很艰难吗？

text: I'm sorry. The librarie is closed.
translation: 「对不起。书店已经关门了。」

text: I'm still a handsome fellow. Debonair, even.
translation: 我依旧是个俊朗的家伙。甚至可说风度翩翩。

text: I'm still looking for [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我还在找[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: I'm there.
translation: 我在场。

text: I'm watching you.
translation: 我盯着你呢。

text: I've always wondered about a connection with the wolf-headed traveller-saint, Christopher Lycocephalus. He always seems likeable in the stories.
translation: 我一直琢磨着他与那位狼首的行旅圣徒克里斯托弗·吕科克法洛斯之间是否有所关联。故事里的他总是显得和善可亲。

text: I've been away from Europe almost all that time. I didn't know you'd recorded anything else.
translation: 那段时间,我几乎一直不在欧洲。我不知道你还录过别的歌。

text: I've been called 'pilgrim'.
translation: 有人曾叫我「巡礼者」。

text: I've been catching up with Vincent Chraibi.
translation: 我一直在与文森特·沙莱比叙旧。

text: I've been many things, but I've learnt what I do best. Perhaps I'll focus on depth of skills.
translation: 我做过许多行当，但我知道自己最擅长什么。也许我会专注于技艺的深度。

text: I've been priest, conjuror, writer, physician, and more. When circumstances demand change, I change with them. Perhaps I'll focus on breadth of skills.
translation: 我做过司祭、术士、作家、医生，还有更多。当境况要求改变时，我便随之而变。也许我会专注于技艺的广度。

text: I've been thinking about Nina. About Mlle Lagasse, I mean.
translation: 我一直在想尼娜。我是说，拉加斯小姐。

text: I've changed my mind. [Empty the bath and step away.]
translation: 我改主意了。[放掉浴水，转身走开。]

text: I've changed so much since those days...
translation: 自那些日子以来，我变了太多……

text: I've completed my first performance with the Rosa Mundi! I should speak to Torgue again.
translation: 我与罗莎·蒙迪的首场演出已经完成!我该再去见托尔格一面。

text: I've determined that I'll wake at midnight.
translation: 我已决定,自己会在午夜醒来。

text: I've done as you asked. Listen; soon you will hear the news of her illness.
translation: 我照你说的办了。听着:很快你就会听到她生病的消息。

text: I've finished everything I need tto do before I travel with Rosa Mundi.
translation: 与罗莎·蒙迪同行之前需要做的种种,我都已办妥。

text: I've followed Nina to the city of Antibes, in the French State - the southern half of divided France.
translation: 我一路跟随尼娜,来到法兰西邦国的昂蒂布城——分裂的法国,南边的那一半。

text: I've found what I need in Aubière's private records.
translation: 我已在奥比埃的私人记录里,找到了所需的东西。

text: I've generally preferred to rely on my own efforts.
translation: 我一般更倾向于依靠自己的努力。

text: I've gone too long without sleep - for a moment there, I lost consciousness.
translation: 我太久没有睡觉了——方才那一刻,我失去了意识。

text: I've had a rough time of it, these last years. It could get rougher.
translation: 这些年我过得很艰难。以后可能更难。

text: I've helped Father Jaume open the eyes of St Reparata.
translation: 我已帮助若梅神父,为圣雷帕拉塔开启了双眼。

text: I've hung around with disreputable people doing disreputable things. I might be able to find goods on the black market, and if I had to do something criminal, I'd have a good start. [A [[Worldly Skill]].]
translation: 我曾与声名狼藉之人厮混,做些见不得光的事。我或许能在黑市上寻到些货;若我不得不做点什么违法的事,也算开了个好头。 [一项[[世俗技艺]]。]

text: I've learnt that Aubière is accepting inducements from his residents to provide black market goods. He probably wouldn't want this to come out.
translation: 我已得知,奥比埃收受住院者的好处,为他们提供黑市货物。他多半不愿此事败露。

text: I've learnt that Nina Lagasse has left the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui. Someone here will know where she went.
translation: 我得知尼娜·拉加斯已离开今日疗养院。这里总有人知道她去了哪里。

text: I've learnt what I needed from Dr A in his dream.
translation: 我在他的梦中,从 A 医生那里得知了我所需的一切。

text: I've learnt where to look for Nina Lagasse. I have no need to pester Dr A in his dreams.
translation: 我已经知道该去哪里寻找尼娜·拉加斯了。没有必要再到梦里纠缠 A 医生。

text: I've located a hidden space behind Aubière's office.
translation: 我找到了奥比埃办公室后面的一个隐蔽空间。

text: I've made a useful connection with the bookseller Andrée, and can buy her other wares.
translation: 我与书商安德烈搭上了一条有用的门路,如今可以买她的其他货品了。

text: I've managed to enter Aubière's secret office.
translation: 我成功潜入了奥比埃的密室。

text: I've often wondered that.
translation: 这个问题,我也常常好奇。

text: I've only seen these roses since the Wars. 'Magpie roses', I hear them called. 'The skewbald rose'. Or 'dappled'.
translation: 战争之后,我才见过这种玫瑰。我听人叫它们「喜鹊玫瑰」,或者「花斑玫瑰」、「斑驳玫瑰」。

text: I've performed a gentleman's rites this morning.
translation: 我今天早上已行过绅士的仪典。

text: I've practiced them in my time, and regretted it.
translation: 我年轻时练过那些，后悔得很。

text: I've reached Mimata, and I've found Rosa Mundi.
translation: 我已抵达米玛塔,并找到了罗莎·蒙迪。

text: I've reconsidered. I can, and I will, help you open the saint's eyes.
translation: 我重新想过了。我能,而且愿意,帮您睁开圣人的眼睛。

text: I've refused to help Sinombre.
translation: 我已拒绝帮助西诺姆布尔。

text: I've seen Cross-touched humans, and Cross-relics in the wild places. Never anything quite like this. But it's clearly the Cross-change.
translation: 我见过受介壳种沾染的人,也在荒野之地见过介壳种遗物。从未见过与此相似的景象。但显然,这是介壳种之变。

text: I've seen Cross-touched humans, and Cross-relics in the wild places. Never anything quite like this. It's clearly the Cross-change. But...
translation: 我见过受介壳种沾染的人,也在荒野之地见过介壳种遗物。从未见过与此相似的景象。这显然是介壳种之变。但是……

text: I've seen this before...
translation: 我以前见过这个……

text: I've seen this painting before...
translation: 我以前见过这幅画……

text: I've set an alarm. But I'm not tired enough to sleep. [To sleep, gain at least one Trouble.]
translation: 我设了闹钟，却还困得不够，睡不着。[要入睡，需至少一种烦扰。]

text: I've set my alarm clock for midnight.
translation: 我已把闹钟定在午夜。

text: I've smartened up, and I'm ready for the day.
translation: 我已拾掇利落，准备好迎接这一天。

text: I've told Father Jaume I can't help him open the eyes of the saint. He seems untroubled.
translation: 我已告诉若梅神父,我无法帮他开启圣人之眼。他似乎并不介怀。

text: I've used my nyctodromist's skills to enter Dr A's dream.
translation: 我运用夜游术士的技艺,进入了 A 医生的梦境。

text: I've wanted a hot bath since I got off that damned train. No - since Milan. [Turn on the taps!]
translation: 自从下了那该死的火车，我就想泡个热水澡。不——自从米兰。[拧开水龙头！]

text: I've wanted a shave since I got off that damned train. No. Since Milan.
translation: 自从下了那该死的火车，我就想刮个脸。不。自从米兰。

text: I... said already that was not something I would do for you.
translation: 我……已经说过，那件事我不会替你做的。

text: I... said already that was not something I would do for you. You became very angry. You don't remember?
translation: 我……已经说过，那件事我不会替你做的。你当时非常生气。你不记得了？

text: I... sometimes, I fear the saint.
translation: 「我……有时候,我会害怕这位圣徒。」

text: IMPORTANT YES THIS IS THE OPPORTUNITY TO RESPOND TO PASSION CHOICES YES
translation: 重要 是的 这是回应激情抉择的机会 是的

text: IMPORTANT! Cubbies have a +10x +5y raycatcher so they're more generous with drag-drops. If we change the size of the grid, we'll also need to change the size of the cubby raycatcher, else the raycatchers will overlap or be insufficient.
translation: 重要!储物格带有一个 +10x +5y 的射线感应器,以便对拖放操作更加宽容。如果我们更改网格的尺寸,也需要同步更改储物格感应器的尺寸,否则感应器会重叠或覆盖不足。

text:
IN BIBLIOTHECA CORVORUM RUTILA MEMORIA SEPULTA

In the library of ravens, a buried memory of gold and red
translation:
IN BIBLIOTHECA CORVORUM RUTILA MEMORIA SEPULTA

在渡鸦的图书馆中，埋藏着一段金红交织的记忆

text:
IN HAC FIGURA VINCES
In this form shall you conquer
translation:
IN HAC FIGURA VINCES
以此标志，汝将得胜

text: Iasnate Eye
translation: 伊亚斯纳特之眼

text:
Ice
Crowns
translation:
冰
冠

text: Ichor Auroral
translation: 曙光神血

text: Identical
translation: 同一

text: Identified St Reparata with Sister-and-Witch
translation: 以双生巫女认出圣雷帕拉塔

text: If Grail is oldest, Moth is older.
translation: 若杯最古老，那么蛾比它更古老。

text: If I bring you this kind of information... will you help me find [[Nina Lagasse]]?
translation: 如果我给你带来这类情报……你会帮我找到[[尼娜·拉加斯]]吗？

text: If I can't win Dr Aubière's co-operation... perhaps I can compel it.
translation: 若我无法赢得奥比埃医生的配合……也许我能迫使它发生。

text: If I could change it - if it could be changed so easily - where was the perfection? How could it be intended? You start to ask questions.
translation: 若我能改变它——若它如此轻易就能被改变——那完美又在哪里？它又怎能是出自本意？你便会开始发问。

text: If I hear anything, I'll let you know.
translation: 要是听到什么，我会告诉你。

text: If I open that box for you, then you'll tell me where I can find Nina?
translation: 如果我替你打开那只盒子,你便会告诉我,我能在哪里找到尼娜？

text: If I rest in this bed tonight, my sleep will remain undisturbed.
translation: 若今晚我歇在这张床上，我的睡眠将不受惊扰。

text: If I sleep in this bed tonight, I'll wake at midnight, sacrificing a restful sleep for the ability to explore untroubled by busybodies.
translation: 若今晚我睡在这张床上，便会在午夜醒来——牺牲一夜安眠，换来不受多事之人打扰的探索之便。

text: If I step through the hidden door here, I'll be in Aubière's secret office, or secret lumber room.
translation: 若我从这里的暗门穿过去，就会进到奥比埃的秘室，或他那间秘密储物室。

text: If I want in, I'll have to wait until the proprietress is distracted. Next time she bends below the bar, perhaps.
translation: 若想进去,我得等老板娘分了神才行。或许下次她弯腰到吧台下面时,就是个机会。

text: If I'm not imposing...
translation: 如果我不打扰的话……

text: If Monsieur wishes to threaten me again with the Milice, Monsieur can return when we are open again for business. In the decades to come.
translation: 「先生若还想拿法国民兵威胁我,就等我们重新开门营业时再来吧。等上几十年。」

text: If Nina has an opinion, she keeps it to herself.
translation: 如果宁娜有什么看法，她会把它藏在心里。

text: If One Of Them Is Dead
translation: 若其中一人已死

text: If a Skill check is way out of reach, or if your [[Aspect Pool]] has the wrong [[Aspects]], or if you've been using the Pool to rescue skill checks - you might not have enough juice to rescue a failure. The game will let you look at the Aspect Pool so you can see what's lacking.
translation: 若某次技艺检定的难度遥不可及，或你的[[性相池]]里没有对的[[性相]]，又或你一直在动用性相池去挽回技艺检定——你可能就没有足够的点数去挽回一次失败了。游戏会让你查看性相池，好让你看清缺了什么。

text: If a pathfinding bug has got Spencer stuck, this will get him unstuck again. Don't use it unless he's properly stuck! It's not good for him!
translation: 如果寻路错误让斯宾塞卡住，此功能可助他重新脱困。除非他确实卡住了，否则不要使用！这对他没有好处！

text: If everything is long ago, everything is foreign. Even the country of my birth, now.
translation: 若一切都已遥远,则一切都成异乡。如今,连我出生的国度也不例外。

text: If it exists, and if you can see it while you're not asleep, then you're in the Wake.
translation: 倘若它确实存在，而你在未入睡时也能看见它，那你便身在醒世。

text: If it's a pyx, then I would imagine only the dust of centuries. If a reliquary, then, perhaps, a relic of St Galileo. Or, it might be, a surprise! Enticing, no?
translation: 若是圣体盒，我想里面只有几个世纪的尘埃。若是圣物匣，那或许装着圣伽利略的遗骸。又或许……是个惊喜！引人好奇，不是吗？

text: If it's not impolite to ask which book...
translation: 「如果这样问不算失礼的话——是哪本书……」

text: If one of them likes you enough, perhaps they'll open up. Except Aristide. If Aristide knew anything, he'd already have blurted it out.
translation: 若他们中有人足够喜欢你，或许会敞开心扉。阿里斯蒂德除外。他若知道什么，早就脱口而出了。

text: If only I had razor blades...
translation: 要是有剃刀刀片就好了……

text:
If only life came with [[Footnotes]]!


Once you've viewed a [[Footnote]], you can always find it by searching for its name via Footnote search - which you're looking at now, because that's the only way to get here.


Most [[Footnotes]] come with opportunities for reflection, self-expression, or angst, allowing you to choose an [[Experience]]. You don't have to make the choice straight away - the Footnotes finder will track and remind you of [[Footnotes]] with incomplete choices.
translation:
要是人生也附有[[脚注]]就好了！


查看过一条[[脚注]]之后，你随时可以通过脚注搜索按名称找到它——你现在正在看的正是这种搜索，因为这是到达这里的唯一途径。


大多数[[脚注]]附带着沉思、自我表达或忧惧的机会，让你可以选择一种[[经验]]。你不必立刻做出选择——脚注查找器会追踪并提醒你那些尚有选择未完成的[[脚注]]。

text: If only the Church could have remained whole.
translation: 要是教会能保持完整就好了。

text: If such a door does exist here, then it's hidden from my sight.
translation: 如果这里真有这样的门,那它也避开了我的视线。

text: If that is so, I wish she had been less generous.
translation: 若果真如此,我倒希望她别这么大方。

text: If that's all you have...
translation: 如果你只有这个……

text: If the toast alerts start to pile up, you can right-click to dismiss ALL alerts immediately.
translation: 若提示弹窗开始堆积，你可以右键点击，立即关闭全部提示。

text: If there's no other option... so be it.
translation: 若是没有别的选择……那就这样吧。

text:
If there's one thing every adept has in common with every scholar... Curious choices are not necessarily wise.

[Evolve this Passion to Curiosity, which contributes Lantern and Knock to your Aspect Pool.]
translation:
如果说每位修士与每位学者有什么共同之处……好奇的选择未必明智。

〔将这项激情进化为好奇，它将为你的性相池增添灯与启。〕

text: If they hadn't joined their powers, there would have been nothing left of the [[Histories]] at all.
translation: 倘若他们不曾联合同心，[[历史]]恐怕什么也不会留下。

text: If we don't know yet know where Nina is, can't accept payment twice
translation: 如果我还不知道宁娜在哪，就不能接受第二次付款

text: If we're finally now finished with the badinage, there's something I need to discuss with you.
translation: 玩笑若是终于开够了，我有件事要和你谈谈。

text: If you ever learn a way to be certain what Mlle Lagasse likes... do please share it with me.
translation: 如果你哪天弄明白拉加斯小姐喜欢什么……务必也告诉我一声。

text:
If you fail a [[Skill]] challenge, you can try to force a success by using any points in your Aspect Pool that match the [[Skill]] [[Aspects]].

If you've got enough, click to assign them, then Succeed.

Though sometimes you'll Concede, even if you have enough. Perhaps you're worried you won't have enough Pool points for a later challenge.
translation:
若你在[[技艺]]挑战中失败，你可以尝试消耗性相池中与该技艺[[性相]]相符的点数，强行换取成功。

若你的点数足够，点击分配它们，然后成功。

不过有时，即使点数足够，你也会认输。也许你担心自己留下的点数不足以应对之后的挑战。

text: If you find her... I think that would please the saint. I hope that it will please you also.
translation: 若您找到她……我想,那会让圣人欢喜。我也希望,那会让您欢喜。

text: If you had spent the last ten in the world - I can't say if you'd understand much more. We all of us have changed.
translation: 就算你在世间度过这十年——我也说不上,你会多明白几分。我们全都变了。

text: If you just close the Crafting menu without collecting what you've made, it'll go to your inventory anyway. But we find it satisfying to appreciate the results of our work.
translation: 如果你不收取做好的东西就直接关闭炼制菜单，成品反正也会进入你的行囊。不过，我们觉得欣赏自己劳动的成果是件令人满足的事。

text: If you like.
translation: 随你。

text:
If you lose control of your mind or soul; if your body betrays you; if a worldly power imprisons or executes you - if these things happen, the game will end.

The Threats section shows what you need to worry about, and how much you need to worry.
translation:
若你失去对心智或灵魂的掌控;若你的身体背叛你;若世间的权柄将你囚禁或处决——倘若这些事发生,游戏便会结束。

威胁栏目会告诉你,你需要担心什么,又需要担心到什么程度。

text: If you make me regret telling you this... I'll make you regret it, too.
translation: 你若让我后悔告诉你这件事……我也会让你后悔。

text: If you search the cafe - Chez Felix - you'll find a store of illicit goods.
translation: 如果你搜查那间咖啡馆——费利克斯之家——会找到一批违禁品。

text: Ignites on anything, burns with a clear and beautiful white flame. They don't make these any more, because the manufacturing process made the match-girls' jaws rot, then glow, then collapse. Except in the Vatican, for certain essential rights; and there, we are assured, the matches are produced so safely and carefully that phossy jaw is entirely unknown.
translation: 在任何东西上都能擦燃，燃起清澈美丽的白色火焰。这种火柴已经不再生产了，因为制造过程会让火柴女工的颌骨腐烂，继而发光，继而塌陷。只有梵蒂冈还在为某些必不可少的礼典生产；而在那里，我们得到保证，火柴生产得如此安全、如此小心，磷毒性颌骨坏死完全不为人知。

text: Illumination
translation: 照明术

text: Implausible
translation: 匪夷所思

text: Importunate
translation: 扰人

text: Impossible ever to say. Our understanding lies buried beneath ignorance, beneath the gravestone knowledge, raised by science and art.
translation: 永远无从言说。我们的理解深埋在无知之下，深埋在科学和艺术竖起的墓碑般的知识之下。

text: Improve with {0} {1} Experiences
translation: 以 {0} 点{1}提升

text: Improve your Skills to craft this recipe
translation: 提升你的技艺以炼制此配方

text:
In 1919, the last year of the Great War, I left seminary and volunteered as a chaplain in the Dorsetshire Regiment, where [[Stanislav]] trained me as an exorcist.

The Great War; we really thought that was as bad as it would get. It took twenty years to learn how wrong we were. I'm not sorry I missed...
translation:
1919 年,大战的最后一年,我离开神学院,志愿加入多塞特团担任随军牧师,在那里,[[斯坦尼斯拉夫]]将我训练成一名驱魔师。

大战;我们当时真的以为,那已经是最坏的光景了。我们花了二十年,才明白自己错得有多离谱。我并不遗憾自己错过了……

text: In Europe now, the seasons often follow weather, not the other way around.
translation: 如今的欧洲,季节常常跟着天气走,而不是反过来。

text: In Fucine, 'the dry tongue', that symbol means...
translation: 在富西讷语——“干涸之舌”——中，那个符号的意思是……

text: In Fucine, 'the tongue of witches', that symbol means...
translation: 在富西讷语——“女巫之舌”——中，那个符号的意思是……

text: In Merchant's Till:
translation: 商贩钱匣中:

text: In Paris, she sang.
translation: 在巴黎,她唱过歌。

text: In Progress
translation: 进行中

text: In This History
translation: 在这重历史中

text: In [[Alexandria]], I was relieved to learn that the Aviforms weathered the War in the [[Sun]] much better than most.
translation: 在[[亚历山大港]]，得知鸟形诸司辰在太阳中的战争中比大多数司辰过得都好，我松了一口气。

text: In candour, I chose very little of what you see beyond my office. Our patrons provided tasteful and suitable appointments for the rooms.
translation: 说句实话,我办公室以外的陈设,几乎没一件是我挑的。赞助人们为各间屋子提供了品味高雅、得体的摆设。

text:
It's difficult to explain Harvey Hattington to those who haven't met him.. He claimed to have consumed the only extant copy of the Fire-Circle Tantra, with butter and garlic. He claimed to have eavesdropped on the Roost of the [[Aviform]] Hours. He would go into the kitchen garden of the House and return with what he claimed were 'transcriptions' of his chats with the bees.

The only verifiable fact about Hattington was that he'd flown with the RFC, and been decorated after he came down behind enemy lines. But he never would talk about that.

关于哈廷顿唯一可核实的事实是：他曾随皇家飞行队飞行，并在坠落在敌后之后获得勋章。但他从不肯谈这件事。

Mortals who've answered a dream-riddle and entered the [[Mansus]] through the [[Stag Door]]. (And returned: otherwise they probably don't count as mortal any more.)

Initiation into the ranks of the Know once allowed initiates to learn secrets that the [[Hours]] kept from most mortals. Since the wars, these secrets are often dropped carelessly in the world, like coins in roadside mud.

text: My Dread has increased to [q=Dread]. I'm falling into Despair...

text: My Fascination has increased to [q=Fascination], making me, technically, Chrysoleptic. The third stage of a process which... is bad... for some reason? Why?
translation: 我的入迷已增至 [q=Fascination],严格来说,这使我陷入金幻。这是某个过程的第三阶段,这个过程……不知为何……很糟糕?为什么?

text: My Fascination has increased to [q=Fascination]. I'm Chrysoleptic now.
translation: 我的入迷已增至 [q=Fascination]。我现在陷入金幻了。

text: My Outfits exalt me and delight others.
translation: 我的行头使我受到尊崇，也取悦他人。

text: My Outfits protect me. Not from a bullet, but from subtler dangers. Like embarrassment, or possession.
translation: 我的行头保护我。不是挡住子弹，而是挡住更微妙的东西。比如窘迫，比如被占据。

text: My Pain has increased to [q=Pain]. I'm suffering Agonies now.
translation: 我的痛苦已增至 [q=Pain]。我现在正受剧痛折磨。

text: My Past: St Oulio's Eve, Cambray, 1919
translation: 我的过去：圣欧利奥节前夜，康布雷，1919年

text: My Traces have increased to [q=trace]. I'm Pursued now.
translation: 我的痕迹已增至 [q=trace]。如今我已遭追缉。

text: My Traces have increased to [q=trace]. I'm being Pursued now.
translation: 我的痕迹已增至 [q=trace]。如今我已遭追缉。

text: My Weariness has increased to [q=Weariness]. I'm Exhausted now.
translation: 我的倦怠已增至 [q=Weariness]。如今我已筋疲力尽。

text: My apologies, madame. I find myself embarrassed. I'll return promptly and settle my account.
translation: 失礼，夫人。我实在难堪。我很快就回来结清账目。

text: My arm has no 'name', Mr Hobson! This is a tedious and puerile bit of pawkiness perpetrated by an... ignoramus.
translation: 我的胳膊没有「名字」,霍布森先生!这是某个……无知之徒,炮制出的乏味又幼稚的促狭把戏。

text: My business is my own.
translation: 我的事,是我自己的事。

text: My colleagues and I - we will teach you respect.
translation: 我和同僚们——会教会你什么叫尊重。

text: My condolences on your condition, Mr Strathcoyne.
translation: 斯特拉斯科因先生,对您的状况,我深表同情。

text: My dreams are only a hushed polka of the day's events. I make no attempt to reach the House that has no walls, or even the Wood around its walls. Much safer to stick with the midnight shuffle of sleeping thought.
translation: 我的梦不过是白日旧事的一支低声波尔卡。我无意抵达那座无墙的居屋，甚至它墙外的树丛也不曾触及。午夜睡思的曳步要安全得多。

text: My first war, that. I was a chaplain with the Dorsetshires. In different times, I'd never have been attached so young.
translation: 那是我的第一场战争。当时,我是多塞特团的随军牧师。若在别的时代,我绝不会那么年轻就被编入团中。

text: My friend.
translation: 我的朋友。

text: My friends and I, we would get in through the kitchen, to listen. Then one of my friends drew attention from the men in grey...
translation: 我和朋友们会从厨房溜进去听。后来,我有个朋友引起了那些灰衣人的注意……

text: My hair and collar are gritty with coal-dust.
translation: 我的头发和衣领上,结满了沙沙的煤灰。

text: My heart and the night agree: the safe will open when I turn the handle.
translation: 我的心与夜晚不谋而合:只要我转动把手,保险柜便会打开。

text: My heart is not quite the one I was born with.
translation: 我的心,已不是生来的那颗。

text: My heart pounds in dismay.
translation: 我的心因惊惶而怦怦直跳。

text: My heart recalls some matter of the [[lark]] - but that's not an Aviform [[Hour]] I recognise.
translation: 我的心隐约记得与[[百灵鸟]]有关的一桩旧事——但那不是我认识的鸟形[[司辰]]。

text: My heart throbs urgently in response.
translation: 我的心随之急切地搏动。

text: My heart thumps uncomfortably. Jealousy? Apprehension? Difficult to be sure.
translation: 我的心,不安地擂动。嫉妒?忧惧?说不准。

text: My heart urges me to find her soon. But I don't always listen to my heart.
translation: 我的心催我尽快找到她。但我并不总是听从自己的心。

text: My heart urges me to find her soon. Since I came back to the World, I've learnt to listen to my heart.
translation: 我的心催我尽快找到她。自从回到人间,我学会了听从自己的心。

text: My honour is not negotiable!
translation: 我的荣誉不容收买！

text: My husband is gone. Find him for me.
translation: 我的丈夫不见了。替我找到他。

text: My last name's Bloom. But I didn't go by Bloom, you know? Not for a while there.
translation: 我姓布卢姆。但我不叫布卢姆,你知道吗?好一阵子不用了。

text: My little vice protects me, so it seems. Tobacco's poisons - so our doctor says - purge animalcules from my tainted skin... and we all know the deep wood fears the fire.
translation: 我这点小恶习,似乎护住了我。烟草的毒素——我们那位医生说的——能从我受染的皮肤上清除微生物……而众所周知,深林畏火。

text: My mediations on light have taught me ways to wake when the sun is dark. [Wake at midnight.]
translation: 我对光的冥想，教我学会了在太阳晦暗时醒来的法子。[午夜醒来。]

text: My memory is cobwebbed. But a war memorial inscription comes to mind.
translation: 我的记忆里蛛网丛生。但一句战争纪念碑上的铭文,浮上了心头。

text: My name is Spencer Hobson. 'Mr Hobson', if you can't manage that.
translation: 我的名字叫斯宾塞·霍布森。“霍布森先生”,你要是叫不全的话。

text: My name is Fraser Strathcoyne. Did you have business with me?
translation: 我是弗雷泽·斯特拉斯科因。你找我,有何贵干?

text: My old Légion uniform, meticulously mended by the elder Janvier.
translation: 我昔日的军团制服，由年长的让维耶一针一线精心补缀而成。

text: My old name
translation: 我旧日的名字

text: My old premises in Paris. The last summer I was there.
translation: 我在巴黎的旧铺面。我在那里的最后一个夏天。

text: My pilgrim. When a lady's seen the dawn, she's earned the right not to be questioned in on the dew. D'you follow me?
translation: 我的巡礼者。一位女士既已见过黎明,便有资格不被盘问晨露之事。你明白我的意思吗?

text: My real name
translation: 我的真名

text: My revised proposal is this. You remain as my guest for a few days, so that I can satisfy my - my concerns about your wellbeing. Your medical history is extraordinary. You must know that.
translation: 我修订后的提议是这样的。你以我客人的身份再留几天，好让我满足我——我对你安康的担忧。你的病史非同寻常。你应当知道这点。

text: My secret is out, hein? The little follies of youth.
translation: 我的秘密败露了,嗯?年轻时的荒唐事。

text: My sincere condolences.

text: My third and last Brancrug autumn, when the days shrank and the storms beat at the coast. I went up to the chapel at Hush House, to bless the fruits arrayed before the setting sun, and light the candles as the dark gathered. I scattered the blessed crusts we'd kept from Lammastide. I stood on the clifftop and tasted the wind. All the time, my letter to the Bishop lay heavy in my pocket. I hadn't quite decided to resign.
