text: Not quite two hundred square miles forests, mountains, a single small but charming lake: a stew of Austrians, Hungarians, Burgenland Croats, and unclassifiables from the Bounds. The Counts of Graustark kept their own laws and their own Landtag beneath the shadow of the Habsburg eagle-wings. Even in the twenties, when the Republic abolished the nobility, the changes didn't touch this corner of Austria. That won't last long under the Soviets, but for now, the place is still not far out of the 1880s. And through all that time, Dagmar von Nagelsburg has held tiny court in her tiny castle. text:
October in [[Brancrug]], the last year before the war. Dusk-purple heather, grey-growling sea. The last day I remember before I went away.

I walked on the beach that night. I followed a woman in a heather-purple gabardine and a woman in a salt-white surplice. I watched as they gathered sea-shells under the moon. It was a dream. I woke in the village, in the Sweet Bones. But there were sea-shells laid beneath the mirror there, when I went to splash my face with cold water.

Then we went to [[Hush House]], my passengers and me, to the cave beneath. I was terrified. But what I'd seen on the Continent made it necessary.
translation:
十月，[[布兰库格]]，大战前最后一年。暮紫色的石楠，灰蒙蒙咆哮的海。那是我记忆中离开前的最后一日。

那夜我走在海滩上。我跟随一个穿石楠紫华达呢风衣的女人，和一个穿盐白法衣的女人。我望着她们在月下拾捡贝壳。那是一场梦。我在村里的甜美的骨头醒来。但当我走去用冷水泼脸时，镜台下面摆着几枚贝壳。

随后我们前往[[噤声居屋]]——我和我的那些客人——去往地下的洞穴。我满心恐惧。但我在大陆上目睹的一切，让此行成为必然。

text:
On the rare occasion than an [[Hour]] truly dies, what remains it is laid to rest in a temenos, a sacred place beneath the [[Wake]], a secret precinct of [[Nowhere]], sealed by law and art and nature.

Who laid the stones of the temenoi? Who lays the Hours to rest there? What else lies within? I can answer only the third question: the [[Sign]] of that Hour. I know, too, that because of what I was and what I became, I am one of the very few who might be able to open the temenos seals.
translation:
在极少数[[司辰]]真正逝去的情况下，其遗骸会被安葬进一座圣茔：那是[[醒时]]之下的神圣所在，[[虚界]]中的秘密圣域，由律法、技艺与本质共同封印。

是谁铺下了这些圣茔的基石？是谁把司辰安葬在那里？里面还剩下什么？第三个问题我能回答：那位司辰的[[印记]]。我还知道，由于我过去与现在的本质，我是极少数有可能开启圣茔封印的人之一。

text:
Once more unto the breach, dear friends, once more;
Or close the wall up with our English dead.
In peace there's nothing so becomes a man
As modest stillness and humility:
But when the blast of war blows in our ears,
Then imitate the action of the tiger;
Stiffen the sinews, summon up the blood,
Disguise fair nature with hard-favour'd rage;
Then lend the eye a terrible aspect;
Let pry through the portage of the head
Like the brass cannon; let the brow o'erwhelm it
As fearfully as doth a galled rock
O'erhang and jutty his confounded base,
Swill'd with the wild and wasteful ocean.

再向缺口冲去,亲爱的朋友们,再冲一次;
否则就用我们英格兰人的尸骸把城墙填满。
太平之时,再无他物比静默的安详与谦逊
更合于一个人的本色:
但当战争的号角在我们耳畔炸响,
便去效仿猛虎的行径;
绷紧筋腱,唤起热血,
以严峻的怒容遮掩温善的天性;
再令双目透出可怖的神情,
让它们从头颅的窗孔间窥望,
如同黄铜大炮;让眉峰压住眼眸,
如一块被狂野而空耗的海洋冲刷的岩石,

text:
Picasso's friend, Michel Sima, rescued a wounded owl during a trip to the Château Grimaldi, and Picasso adopted it. His lover Françoise Gilot would feed Ubu with mice that she trapped in the studio, but it never took to her. It took to Picasso, eventually, to the extent that it usually stopped biting him. 

Ubu served as a model in Picasso's paintings as war; as peace; as wisdom; perhaps as a model for a conjectured seventh [[Aviform]] [[Hour]]. But none of this is likely ever to be relevant.
translation:
毕加索的朋友米歇尔·西马在格里马尔迪城堡之行中救下一只受伤的猫头鹰，毕加索收养了它。他的情人弗朗索瓦丝·吉洛常用她在画室里捉到的老鼠喂乌布，可乌布始终不肯亲近她。它最终亲近了毕加索，以至于通常不再咬他。

乌布曾在毕加索的画作中充当模特：化作战争；化作和平；化作智慧；或许也是一位被推想出的第七位[[鸟形]][[司辰]]的模特。不过这些事，多半永远不会与任何事相干。

text: She had owned that songbird almost a year. I recall that she had to crush its throat and cut its heart out with a pocket-knife. To prove her conviction - or perhaps only because the one she called was one who liked that kind of thing.

text:
Since the Wars, cash is king, barter is queen, and the black market is the power behind the throne.

Every merchant prefers to be paid in their local currency, and they'll only pay out in that currency. But they'll grudgingly accept a  range of others. Legitimate [[State]] merchants like Janvier, for instance, prefer the [[francisque]] but will usually accept dollars, sterling, or Swiss francs.

Harder currencies like the dollar are more widely accepted, but local politics are important. The [[State]] won't accept [[Republic]] currency, and dollars are unwelcome in [[Ministries]] territory. But if you can find a black market merchant, they'll often take all kinds of currency - even cigarettes.
translation:
战争以来，现金为王，易物为后，而黑市才是幕后真正的掌权者。

每位商人都偏爱本地货币，也只肯用那种货币付款。不过，他们也会勉强收下其他一些货币。比如让维耶这类正当的[[邦国]]商人，偏爱[[法兰西斧币]]，但通常也收美元、英镑或瑞士法郎。

美元这类硬通货更受欢迎，但地方政治也很要紧。[[邦国]]不收[[共和国]]货币，美元在[[联盟]]的地盘上不受欢迎。但若能找到黑市商人，他们往往什么货币都收——连香烟也要。

text: Since the war, Bright Arts practitioners rely on the authority of the dollar. If I won't, or can't, I can mischievously assert authority with a token of paper and old light. But it will rely on - and add to - the dangerous dazzlement of Fascination.
translation: 战争之后，光之技艺的施术者依赖美元所代表的权威。若我不愿或不能如此，也可以用纸片与旧光制成一枚信物，恶作剧般「宣示权威」。不过这依赖危险的入迷眩光，也会让入迷加深。

text: Since the war, Night Arts practitioners rely on the assertions of the Ministries dolya. If I won't, or can't, I can defiantly acknowledge necessity with a token of base metal backed by the older powers of night and bone. But it will rely on - and add to - that familiar half-cosmic Dread.
translation: 战争之后，夜之技艺的施术者依赖联盟多利亚的断言。若我不愿或不能如此，也可以用一枚贱金属信物，借夜与骨的旧权能，桀骜地「承认必然」。不过这依赖——并加深——那熟悉的、半属宇宙尺度的恐惧。

text:
Skills overlap. [[Sophistication]] and [[Hushery]] might both let you spot forged art. [[Bosk]] and [[Preservation]] are both relevant if you ever need to deliver a baby.

So you might see a dialogue choice with two [[Skill]] icons. In this case, you'll automatically use the Skill with the best chance of success. Hover over the choice for details about the other one.

所以你可能会看到带有两个[[技艺]]图标的对话选项。这种情况下，你会自动使用成功机会最大的那门技艺。将光标悬停在选项上，可查看另一门技艺的详情。

text:
Sleep cures [[Troubles]] - and is only possible when Spencer has at least one Trouble.

[[Pain]] becomes [[Weariness]].

Weariness fades.

[[Dread]], and [[Fascination]], cancel each other out. Any leftover Dread or Fascination will fade... but may cause dreams in the process.

[[Traces]] are the exception. Traces don't allow Sleep, and aren't cured by Sleep - in fact, Sleeping in the same place for more than one night creates a Trace.

[[痛苦]]化为[[倦怠]]。

倦怠会渐渐消退。

[[恐惧]]与[[入迷]]会相互抵消。残留的恐惧或入迷会慢慢消退……但过程中可能引发梦境。

[[痕迹]]是例外。痕迹不容入睡,也不为睡眠所愈——事实上,在同一处睡过不止一夜,便会留下一道痕迹。

text: Spencer Hobson

text:
Spencer Hobson, once called 'the best-dressed man in the Suppression Bureau', prefers clothes tailored for him personally, not garments haphazardly collected from cupboards. Have new Outfits made at tailors and sent on to you - or relocate items from your past.

Outfits have Aspects which suit them for the right climate, or which provoke positive and negative reactions from NPCs. Don't wear a Light outfit in the snow. Don't wear a Raffish outfit to speak to a Ministry commissar. And don't wear your dressing-gown to breakfast.

Most Oufits also provide small bonuses to [[Skills]]. Unlike bonuses from active items, Outfit bonuses are additive - they always apply on top of other bonuses.

Spencer can (or, perhaps. will) only change his Outfit in Wardrobe Areas - places where he can disrobe discreetly, and might keep a change of clothes. Any room where he sleeps will count.
translation:
斯宾塞·霍布森，曾被称作『防剿局衣着最讲究的男人』，只穿为他量身定做的衣服，而不是随手从衣橱里攒来的衣裳。让裁缝为你做新行头送来——或者从你的过去里寻回旧物。

行头带有性相，有的适合特定气候，有的会激起 NPC 好或坏的反应。别在雪地里穿轻便行头。别穿着花哨浪荡的行头去见联盟的政委。也别穿着睡袍吃早饭。

大多数行头还会为[[技艺]]提供小幅加成。与已激活物品的加成不同，行头的加成是叠加的——它们总是与其他加成累加生效。

斯宾塞只能（或者说，也许，将会）在更衣区域更换行头——那些他可以谨慎地宽衣、或许会放一身替换衣服的地方。任何他睡觉的房间都算。

translation: 斯宾塞·霍布森。

text:
Spencer has had many careers, but there's one where he felt he belonged. Through the long years of his hollowing in the dark, all his [[Skills]], decayed - but the ones from that career decayed slowest.

Any other [[Skill]] can be acquired or increased with [[Experiences]] later - but increasing a Career Skill only costs half as much.
translation:
斯宾塞做过许多职业，但只有一份让他感到归属。在他于黑暗中空洞化的漫长岁月里，他所有的[[技艺]]都在衰朽——但源于那份职业的技艺，衰朽得最慢。

任何其他[[技艺]]日后都可以用[[经验]]获得或提升——但提升职业技艺的耗费只有一半。

text:
Spencer has lef tthe Sanitarium. Europe awaits -- Mimata, where the red nuns look down on the town-beasts -- Caen, where the New King's catafalque smoulders -- Mahaggony, under its amber - Berlin red-litten - Prague, Cross-hived, with its stairway ever down.

[This concludes the pre-alpha. Drop us a line at support@weatherfactory.biz and tell us what was enjoyable, memorable, or confusing. You can also restart and try other paths.]]
translation:
斯宾塞已经离开疗养院。欧洲在前方等候——米玛塔,红衣修女俯瞰镇兽之地——卡昂,新王的灵柩台仍在阴燃——马哈戈尼,琥珀之下——柏林,红灯映照——布拉格,蜂巢密布,阶梯永远向下。

[前 Alpha 版到此结束。欢迎写信至 support@weatherfactory.biz,告诉我们哪些内容有趣、难忘或令人困惑。你也可以重新开始,尝试其他路线。]]

text: Spencer is a hollow man. His Passions aren't deeply rooted yet. If your idea of him changes, you can sometimes evolve your Passions to different ones.

text: Spencer was hollowed out by Worms; he is much less than he was. But that's changing now. You know now that [[Experiences]] come in nine different flavours, and you can only use them to upgrade matching Skills and Passions. You could try to use Skills that offer the Experiences you need. Or you could just let Experiences guide you into developing Spencer in unexpected ways. See what you prefer.
translation: 斯宾塞曾被蠕虫掏空；他远不如从前了。但这一切正在改变。 你现在已经知道，[[经验]]有九种不同的味道，而你也只能用它们来提升相符的技艺与激情。你可以试着使用能提供所需经验的技艺；也可以干脆让经验引着你，把斯宾塞养成意想不到的样子。看看你更偏爱哪种。

text:
Spencer was never really an adept - and the [[Worms]] took much of his ability from him - but he can prepare tools to achieve a variety of supernatural effects in dialogue. As his Unworldly [[Skills]] increase, he'll be able to create more powerful tools.

You can look through Spencer's recipes whenever you like - but to make something, you'll need to find a crafting [[Venue]].

斯宾塞从来算不上真正的修士——[[蠕虫]]也从他身上夺走了大半本领——但他仍能备好工具，在对话中实现种种超自然效果。随着他世俗之外的[[技艺]]提升，他将能制作出更强大的工具。

你可以随时翻阅斯宾塞的配方——但若要制作某样东西，你需要先找到一个炼制[[场地]]。

text:
Spencer's body - scarred and fragile flesh, gnawed and hollowed, sustained by the pulse of his brazen internal interloper - Spencer's body has failed. It's astonishing that it lasted this long.

Spencer is dead.

This is not a positive ending.

斯宾塞的身体——伤痕累累、脆弱易碎的肉体,被啃蚀,被掏空,仅靠他体内那黄铜色闯入者的搏动维系——斯宾塞的身体终于衰竭了。它能撑这么久,实在令人惊讶。

斯宾塞死了。

这不是一个好结局。

Recall <link="mypasteveofstdahutys1942">My Past: Eve of St Dahut, Ys, 1940 (?)</link>
translation:
冰的圣殿，泛着琥珀光泽的卵石，锋利得毫无知觉的刀，一座珊瑚的牢笼……

追忆 <link="mypasteveofstdahutys1942">我的过去：圣达于特节前夜，伊苏，1940年（？）</link>

text: Temples of ice, cobbies gleaming amber, knives of nerveless acuteness, a cage of coral... [[Ys]]-behind-the-wave... where for endless agonised days they stretched me behind bars. Ys the city unprecedented, whose slow bells heard above the sea might strike the [[Hours]]... none can go living to Ys, and I was not living when I went there. Still less when they cut the [[Worms]] from me. Still less when they cut out my heart.
translation: 寒冰塑造的神殿，琥珀般闪烁的卵石，无情的锐利刀刃，珊瑚铸成的牢笼……波涛之下的[[伊苏]]，在此城的无尽痛苦岁月，我都在铁栏之后度过。伊苏是一座前所未有的城市，当其缓慢的钟声在海面之上响起时，或许能撼动[[司辰]]……无人能以生者之身前往伊苏，而我前往那里时也并非活着。更不必说当他们从我体内割除[[蠕虫]]之时。更不必说当他们挖出我的心脏之时。

text:
The 'Threshold Legion', founded in service of the [[Duties]] to guard the edges of things. Almost anyone - or anything - is accepted as a recruit, as long as they're prepared to endure the training and abandon their old lives.

After three years service, recruits who survive may apply (a) for citizenship of a sponsoring nation and (b) if necessary, to be considered formally human.

The Légion's motto is 'Honneur et Humanité'. Its unofficial motto, more often cited by legionnaires, is 'sue, ou saigne!' - 'sweat, or bleed!'
translation:
门关军团，为服务职司而创立，旨在守护万物的边界。几乎任何人——或任何东西都可被召收入伍，只要他们愿意忍受训练并告别过去的生活。

服役三年后，幸存的新兵可以申请获得赞助国的公民身份，以及如有必要的话，被正式认定为人类。

军团的座右铭是“Honneur et Humanité（荣誉与人性）”。军团士兵们更常引用的非官方座右铭则是“sue, ou saigne!”——“流汗，或流血！”

text:
The 'house without walls', the 'house behind the world', which has always (always?) been the dwelling-place of most of the [[Hours]] (and the [[Names]], many inhuman spirits, and some among the Dead): accessible in dreams to sufficiently knowledgeable mortals, and to very unlucky ones. It is not as it was.

When I think of the Mansus, I think first of...
translation:
『无墙之屋』，『世界背后的屋宅』，大多数[[司辰]]（以及[[尊名]]、许多非人的灵体，还有一些亡者）一直（一直？）栖居于此：足够博识的凡人在梦中可以抵达，非常不幸的凡人也可以。它已不复旧观。

想到漫宿，我首先想到的是……

text: The Acheson Mission was launched to rebuild Europe... under a Coronal paradigm. The [[Ministries]] are having none of that. Their most recent response is to blockade Berlin. Anyone from the West trying to reach the capital - even the Allied sector - will need sympathetic intervention or a very unusual plan.
translation: 艾奇逊使团的成立,是为了重建欧洲……奉行冕之范式。[[联盟]]对此绝不买账。他们最近的回应,是封锁柏林。任何试图从西方抵达首都的人——哪怕是盟军管区——都需要善意的干预,或一个极不寻常的计划。

text: The Allies answer! The mighty air forces of the Incorporates and the State rain down bounteous plenty on the suffering citizenry!
translation: 盟国回应!集团与邦国的强大空军向受苦的市民倾洒丰饶的物资!

text: The Allies suddenly issued their new [[currency]]... and overnight the old Reichsmarks were useless outside the Eastern sector of Berlin. To stave off inflation, Ministry clerks sanctioned a limited number of Reichsmarks by attaching little Star-watched adhesive coupons, and these became the Eastern currency. It held the line against hyperinflation, but the Ostmark is only worth about half a D-Mark, and the coupons come off in the rain. The Stars may now agree to issue their onteiristically flawless dolya in East Berlin now. But that would be an escalation that might force the Incorporates' hand in turn. No-one is ready for a third war. Roughly six ostmarks to the dollar.
translation: 盟军忽然发行了他们的新[[货币]]……一夜之间，旧帝国马克在柏林东区之外统统成了废纸。为遏制通货膨胀，联盟的职员们给一批帝国马克贴上印有小星守望图样的附票予以认可，这批马克便成了东区货币。它守住了恶性通胀的堤线，但东德马克只值大约半个西德马克，而且附票一淋雨就会脱落。 群星如今或许会同意在东柏林发行他们那在梦境学意义上无懈可击的多利亚。但那将是升级之举，反过来可能逼得集团不得不摊牌。没有人准备好迎接第三次战争。 大约六东德马克兑一美元。

text: The Austrian government under Figl has more leeway in the western than the eastern zone - but it still operates under the veto of the Allied Council.
translation: 菲格尔领导下的奥地利政府在西部占领区比东部有更大的回旋余地——但它仍须在盟军委员会的否决权之下行事。

text: The Aviform [[Hours]] wear the shapes of birds: twin funeral kites, laughingthrush, dove, crow. My heart would add a magpie to their number. The night would suggest a seventh.
translation: 鸟形[[司辰]]披着鸟的形态：孪生的葬礼鸢、笑鸫、鸽子、乌鸦。我的心会为它们再添一只喜鹊。夜晚则会提议第七位。

text: The Church of the Unconquerable [[Sun]] acknowledges four [[Horae]] Canonicae, but its outer rites and doctrines present a humanised, comfortable version of each. The earliest church councils resolved that the inner mysteries of the Hours are much too dangerous to be approached directly. They're right, of course - most of all, about the mysteries of one particular Hour.
translation: 不可征服之太阳的教会承认四种[[时序女神]]正时，但其外部仪式与教义呈现的是每种正时人性化、令人安适的版本。最早的教会公会议认定，司辰的内层奥秘太过危险，不可直接触及。他们当然是对的——尤其是关于某一位司辰的奥秘。

text: The Church teaches that the Sun has many natures. And the esoterics teach that the world has other natures, necessary to sustain its existence. The 'War in the Sun' is not only a figure of speech. These natures warred. Many died. And now Europe dies with them.
translation: 教会教导说，太阳有许多本性。密教学者则教导说，世界还有另一些本性，为维系其存在所必需。『太阳之战』并非仅仅一个比喻。这些本性交战了。许多本性死去。如今，欧洲正随它们一同死去。

text: The Church's older traditions have their roots in the Persian fire-cults.

text: The Church's version is much safer than the original. They were very clear about that in the seminary.

text:
The Corona-touched [[currency]] of the United States, buttery smooth beneath the fingertips, faintly luminous even in darkness. Much valued in the wilder hinterlands of Europe as a talisman of onteirological stability. The new five dollar bill is sometimes nailed above doors to invoke the protection the one whose likeness it bears - Barkley, who is both President and Incorporate.

Every other currency's value is expressed in terms of the dollar. Heaven bless America.
translation:
美国那种被冕触及的[[货币]]，指尖抚过如奶油般滑顺，即使在黑暗中也会发出微光。在欧洲更蛮荒的内地，它作为梦境学稳定的护符而备受珍视。崭新的五美元钞票有时会被钉在门楣之上，以祈求钞票上那位形象的庇护——巴克利，他既是总统，也是集团成员。

所有其他货币的价值都以美元计。天佑美利坚。
