translation: 《男儿本色》

text: The Mansion of Heaven, worshipped singly and severally as its constituent [[Hours]]. Since the War which raged among its elements, it is visibly troubled every day - by signs, by shadows, by a curling tint of blood.
translation: 天穹之宅邸，人们以其组成[[司辰]]分别或共同礼拜之。自从那场在其诸元素间肆虐的战争以来，它每日都显露出不安——经由征兆、阴影、一缕盘曲的血色。

text: The Mansus has fallen, but we still dream. Dr Aubière must go somewhere to dream. A sufficiently skilled nyctodromist might follow him there - or perhaps there's another way.
translation: 漫宿已倾颓,但我们仍在做梦。奥比埃医生必然去了某处做梦。技艺足够精湛的夜游者,或许能循他而去——也许还有别的路。

text: The Mansus! A particularly fascinating symbology-superstition. And psychologically potent. Extremely potent.
translation: 漫宿!一种格外引人入胜的象征-迷信。而且心理效力极强。极强。

text:
The Map becomes relevant once Spencer is ready to leave Antibes. Travel from a station to any adjoining city... if you have the relevant travel documents. Be careful: repeatedly traversing the same route will inflict [[Traces]].

More about [[travelling]] here.
translation:
等斯宾塞准备离开昂蒂布，地图就派上用场了。从车站出发，可以前往任何相邻的城市……前提是证件齐备。当心：反复走同一条路线，会招来[[痕迹]]。

关于[[旅行]]的更多内容，见此处。

text: The Milice, monsieur, does not offer such a service. Remove your lusts to the houses of tolerance.
translation: 先生，法国民兵不提供这种服务。请把你的欲望带去合法妓院解决。

text: The Ministries
translation: 联盟

text: The Ministries have not yet taken an interest in me.
translation: 联盟尚未对我产生兴趣。

text: The Ministries have taken an interest in me.
translation: 联盟已经对我产生了兴趣。

text:
The New King gave his life at Caen in battle against the [[Enemy]] - as no Englishman will fail to remind you - but the Plantagenet line continues under Queen Alexandra.

The New King's golden age is gone with the Wars, but so is the febrile air that attended it. In the new quiet, there is the sense of waking from an eager dream. But Parliament still meets by candle-light.
translation:
新王在卡昂与[[敌人]]作战时殒命——这一点，不会有哪个英格兰人忘了提醒你——不过金雀花的血脉在亚历山德拉女王治下延续至今。

新王的黄金时代已随战争而去，随之而去的还有伴随它的那股亢奋气息。在新生的静谧中，有种从热切梦境里醒来的感觉。但议会仍在烛光下议事。

text: The Night Between Cities
translation: 城市之间的夜色。

text: The Oath of Kufra is fulfilled; above the scarred Cathedral, three colours glow
translation: 库夫拉之誓已然履行;在伤痕累累的大教堂上方,三色光芒闪耀

text: The Orchid Transfigurations
translation: 《兰花之变容》

text: The Ordo Limiae, later called the Obliviates, often used this rite to cover their tracks, despite its inherent risk of Fascination.
translation: 利米亚教团——后来被称作遗忘者——常用这一仪式掩盖行迹，尽管它天然带有引发入迷的风险。

text: The Perils of Generosity
translation: 慷慨的风险

text: The Persistence
translation: 长存之道

text: The Pilgrim Rose
translation: 朝圣玫瑰

text: The Plague of Leaves - but first the civil war. [[Icarians]] made a stronghold of our Epirus. I sang for them; so when the King's men took the city, it went hard for me.
translation: 叶疫——但在那之前,是内战。[[伊加利亚人]]把我们的伊庇鲁斯变成了据点。我曾为他们歌唱;所以当国王的人马攻陷城邦时,我便遭了殃。

text: The Plague of Leaves: it came to Epirus. It took the streets, the churches, then our flesh. We fled in sorrow, or we joined the green. But some of us did not leave when we might.
translation: 叶疫:它降临伊庇鲁斯。它夺走街道、教堂,然后是我们的血肉。我们或含悲逃离,或融入那片绿意。但我们之中有些人,本该离开时却没有走。

text: The Plague of Leaves? A little. When I rise. No wood is quite so pliable as flesh. And so I rarely venture from this room. My view is charming, but I tire of it. And so I greet all visitors as friends. Even the ones like Fraser and his pet.
translation: 叶疫?有一点。在我起身的时候。没有哪种木头,像血肉这般柔韧。所以我很少离开这间屋子。窗景迷人,可我也看腻了。因此,我把所有访客都当作朋友。连弗雷泽和他那只「宠物」也不例外。

text: The Plague of Leaves? Perhaps. But none has yet. In Epirus, its spores are precious in our flesh. But here, they do not make their homes in us.
translation: 叶疫?也许吧。但至今还没有人染上。在伊庇鲁斯,它的孢子在我们血肉中弥足珍贵。但在这里,它们不会在我们体内安家。

text: The Quiet American
translation: 《文静的美国人》

text: The Radical Measure
translation: 《激进之策》

text: The Rising Heart
translation: 升腾之心

text: The Romanian People's Republic is an Icarian state... but there are no Star-fragments here. Though King Michael is gone, the other Michael, the Messenger who writes in invisible blood, the dead-guide for whom candles are lit - that Michael is seen every day in Cluj, in paintings, mirrors, chalk. A power walks that has nothing to do with Gleam.
translation: 罗马尼亚人民共和国是一个伊加利亚国家……但这里没有星之碎片。虽然米哈伊国王已经不在了,但另一位米哈伊——那位以隐形之血书写的信使,那位人们为他点烛的引魂者——这位米哈伊每天都在克卢日现身:在画作里,在镜子里,在粉笔痕迹里。有一股与烁毫无干系的权能,正在行走。

text: The Roost
translation: 栖木

text: The Rue Racine is deserted. The rain? A curfew? Or some nastier reason?
translation: 拉辛街空无一人。是雨？是宵禁？还是什么更糟的原因？

text: The Sanitarium Aujourd'hui. In the Cap d'Antibes, just past the park.
translation: 「今日疗养院。在昂蒂布海岬,过了公园就是。」

text: The Sanitarium receives substantial funding from the European Recovery Program - the Acheson Mission - and from a semi-charitable Incorporate entity called the Meninger Foundation. Very substantial funding.
translation: 疗养院从欧洲复兴计划——艾奇逊使命——以及一家名为曼宁格基金会的半慈善集团实体处获得大笔资金。极其大笔的资金。

text: The Sanitarium wanted a bit of local colour.
translation: 疗养院想要一点本地色彩。

text: The Second Battle of Cambray, 1919. My first battle, where we almost - almost - broke through. It hung on a knife-edge. Had we broken through, the [[Great War]] might have been over a year earlier. The books will tell you the Germans rallied. But I remember what we found in the church there, and why the Dorsetshires drew back, leaving ten thousand of our own lying dead in the ashes.
translation: 1919 年的第二次康布雷战役。我的第一场战役,我们几乎——几乎——就要突破。胜负悬于一线。若当时突破了,[[大战]]或许能提前一年结束。史书会告诉你,德国人重整了旗鼓。但我记得我们在那里的教堂中发现了什么,也记得多塞特团为何后撤,抛下我们一万名弟兄,倒毙于灰烬之中。

text: The Secrets of Dr A.
translation: A 医生的秘密

text: The Serapeum is in [[Alexandria]]. It's even harder to find than it sounds. But I managed it.
translation: 塞拉皮雍在[[亚历山大港]]。它比听上去还要难找。但我还是找到了。

text: The Stars are bright here.
translation: 此处的群星格外明亮。

text: The Stars.
translation: 群星。

text: The State is generous. But this is my personal initiative, you see? I use my own funds to incentivise public service. When the information is accurate, my service is recognised.
translation: 邦国当然慷慨。不过你看，这是我的个人行动。我拿自己的钱来激励公共服务。只要情报准确，我的功劳就会得到认可。

text: The State is generous, to pay so freely for information.
translation: 邦国真慷慨，为情报出手这么大方。

text: The Sun-in-Rags' Sign: Gleam
translation: 残阳的印记：烁

text: The Suppression Bureau, an organisation founded in service to the [[Duties]]. The Bureau recruited me when I lived in London, and again after I left the Légion. Both times, it ended badly, for both sides.
translation: 防剿局，一个为服务[[职司]]而创立的组织。我还住在伦敦时局里就曾招募过我；在我离开军团后它又一次招募我。两次都以糟糕的结果收场——对双方都是如此。

text: The Temenos of the Sun-in-Rags
translation: 残阳的圣域

text: The Thunderskin is the Heart Relentless: the Hour that preserves.
translation: 轰雷之皮即不息之心：那位守护的司辰。

text: The Thunderskin's Sign: Corona
translation: 轰雷之皮的印记：冕

text: The Thunderskin's Sign: Gleam
translation: 轰雷之皮的印记：烁

text: The Thunderskin's Temenos
translation: 轰雷之皮的圣域

text: The Twelve Hours of the Night
translation: 《夜的十二时辰》

text: The USA has always been a hotbed of [[Crucian]] heresy. This is some new permutation. Good?
translation: 美国一直是[[十字派]]异端的温床。这是某种新的变体。好事？

text: The Victory
translation: 胜利

text: The Wandering Heart
translation: 漂泊的心

text: The War's over, but war never will be.
translation: 大战已经结束，但战争永不止息。

text: The War. The first one.
translation: 那场战争。头一场。

text: The Wars and their plagues took the glitter off those golden evenings, left the air dense and villainous.
translation: 战争与瘟疫,磨去了那些黄金夜晚的光彩,把空气变得沉滞而险恶。

text: The Watchman's vigilance is invoked to reveal, command or expel troublesome spirits.
translation: 召请守夜人的警觉,以揭露、号令或驱逐滋扰的鬼灵。

text: The White Door
translation: 纯白之门

text: The White Door: the lowest door of the Mansus, that even untrained dreamers could sometimes pass. And the Dead.
translation: 白门：漫宿最低的一道门，连未经训练的做梦者有时也能穿过。还有亡者。

text: The Witch
translation: 女巫

text: The Witch-and-Sister are usually depicted on the sea-shore. In the gentler Limian tradition, the Salt-Skein is what the Sister has used to bind them together.
translation: 双生女巫通常被描绘在海滨。在较温和的利米安传统中，盐线团正是姊妹用来把她们绑在一起的东西。

text: The Witnesses
translation: 《见证者》

text: The Wood has always been the place of [[Moth]] and his allied [[Hours]]. It doesn't have to make sense.
translation: 木材之地向来是[[蛾]]与其同盟[[司辰]]的领域。它不必讲得通。

text: The Ysiens were not kind to me, but its amber-shining cobbles, its coral canals, its ice-temples - they have no equal anywhere this side of the wave.
translation: 伊苏人待我并不和善，但那里琥珀泛光的卵石街、珊瑚色的运河、冰砌的庙宇——浪的这一边，天下无可与之相比。

text: The [[Bureau]] believed that he was killed by a rising competitor. But a Winter-long like Coseley could not die before the date agreed with his patron - any more than he could live beyond that date.
translation: [[防剿局]]相信他是被一个正在崛起的竞争者杀死的。但像科斯利这样的冬之长生者，既不能在与其庇护者约定的日期之前死去，也不可能活过那个日期。

text: The [[Church]] acknowledges some [[Hours]], denies others, and is ambivalent on the rest, adopting them as metaphors or parables; or as saints.
translation: 「[[教会]]承认一些[[司辰]],否认另一些,对其余的则态度暧昧——把祂们收作隐喻或寓言;或者,收作圣徒。」

text: The [[Church]] calls it Hell, and won't speak of it. Adepts call it Nowhere, and won't speak of it where they can be heard. It is lit by lamps of black nephrite. It is where the Dead go, in the end. [[Worms]], and the worst [[Hours]], were found there, but now they're found in other places too.
translation: [[教会]]称之为地狱,而不愿谈及。修士们称之为虚无,也不愿在有人听得见的地方谈及。那里以黑色软玉之灯照明。那是亡者最终的去处。[[蠕虫]]与最恶劣的[[司辰]]曾在那里被发现,但如今,它们也在别处现身了。

text: The [[Cross]]-change, Mr Hobson. A final personal advancement. The efflorescence of a long-held secret.
translation: 介壳种之变,霍布森先生。一次最终的个人进阶。一桩久藏秘密的绽放。

text: The [[Hours]] always determined what [[Histories]] persisted. But the Librarians of the [[Watchman's Tree]] were known to make determinations in their Great Inks. Perhaps they don't, not any more.
translation: [[司辰]]们决定何种[[历史]]得以存续。但[[守夜人之树]]的图书管理员素来以使用伟大之墨做出决断而闻名。或许，现已不然。

text: The [[Hours]] used to war over which History was real, and braid them together into a future. Perhaps it's not up to them any more.
translation: [[司辰]]曾为哪些历史才是真实而争战，并将它们编织成同一个未来。或许这已经不由祂们决定了。

text: The [[Madrugad]], fire in ashes
translation: [[昕旦]]，灰烬中的火

text: The [[Meniscate]], the unforgotten mirror
translation: [[弧月]]，未被遗忘的明镜

text: The [[Ministries]] tread more lightly in Austria. Chancellor Figl came alive through Dachau and Malthausen, and found his way back into a coalition government. The Republic of Austria is free of the [[Enemy]], and may yet steer its own course between the greater powers. But the Stars are always watching.
translation: [[联盟]]在奥地利更为克制。总理菲格尔从达豪和毛特豪森生还，设法回到了联合政府之中。奥地利共和国已摆脱[[敌人]]，或许仍能在列强之间把握自己的航向。但[[群星]]始终注视着。

text: The [[Skills]] this recipe needs can't be used at this [[Venue]].
translation: 这个配方所需的[[技艺]]，无法在此[[场地]]施展。

text: The [[Sun-in-Rags]], king of sorrowful heaven
translation: [[残阳]]，悲怆天穹的君王

text: The [[Sun]] still glows, and Corona is only his latest blessing.
translation: [[太阳]]仍在发光，冕不过是他最新的恩赐。

text: The [[Watchman]], light and sigh
translation: [[守夜人]]，光与叹息

text:
The [[currency]] of the French Republic, graced by the profile of Marianne, its personification. 'LIBERTY, EQUALITY, FRATERNITY.' Don't be caught with these in the French State. They're prickly about their currency down there.

The franc, like the francisque, trades at about two hundred to the dollar.
translation:
法兰西共和国的[[货币]]，币面饰有其拟人化身玛丽安娜的侧影。「自由、平等、博爱。」别在法兰西邦国境内被人搜出这些。那边的人对自己货币的事可计较得很。

法郎与法兰西斧币一样，约莫两百兑一美元。

text:
The [[currency]] of the French State, named for the double-headed axe which serves the State as its symbol. 'WORK, FAMILY, HOMELAND.'

The francisque, like the franc, trades at about two hundred to the dollar.
translation:
法兰西邦国的[[货币]]，得名于那柄充当邦国象征的双头斧。「劳动、家庭、祖国。」

法兰西斧币与法郎一样，约莫两百兑一美元。

text: The alloys of Ys are not permitted either in the [[Mansus]] or the [[Wake]]. Perhaps the [[Hours]] really do fear them.
translation: 伊苏合金无论在[[漫宿]]还是[[醒时]]都是被禁止的。或许[[司辰]]确实畏惧它。

text: The amber town adrift on consolation's tides far from the rush of the world
translation: 琥珀色的小镇,漂荡在慰藉的潮汐之上,远离尘世的奔忙

text: The animal is essentially inert, monsieur. Expect nothing of him.
translation: 这动物基本上是一动不动,先生。别对它抱什么指望。

text: The aristocracy of the old Sun; a power of the Mansus gracing the Wake. [Incline your head.]
translation: 旧日太阳的贵族;一位驾临醒界的漫宿权柄。[微微颔首。]

text: The arrangement is unconventional... certainly she cannot leave, but certainly she would not survive without my assistance. It's complicated. Like this dream.
translation: 这安排不同寻常……她确实无法离开，可也确实没有我的帮助就活不下去。说来复杂。就像这场梦一样。

text: The arts of Bosk, of Hushery, of Skolekosophy are best worked in shadow.
translation: 丛林学、静默术、蠕虫学这些技艺,最宜在暗影之中施展。

text: The authoriteeees!
translation: 当——当局!

text: The bath-water cools gently. At some point, I wrinkle. At last, the bath-water is entirely cold, and the joy of it is gone.
translation: 浴水缓缓变凉。不知何时，我的皮肤起皱了。终于，浴水彻底冷透，那份欢愉也荡然无存。

text: The big man reaches out for the passport.
translation: 大汉伸手来拿护照。

text: The bishop might not agree with everything I have said to you. But the bishop does not come often to Antibes, and the saint is here always.
translation: 主教未必赞同我对您说的每一句话。但主教不常来昂蒂布,而圣人,始终在这里。

text: The blessing of the [[Incorporates]]. Everything gets better.
translation: [[集团]]的恩赐。一切都会变好。

text: The blond man is watching me impatiently.
translation: 金发男人正不耐烦地看着我。

text: The books in the graveyard are for display only. Not for sale.
translation: 墓园里的书只供陈列,一概不卖。

text: The books.
translation: 那些书。

text: The bookseller rolls her eyes, very slightly.
translation: [女书商极其轻微地翻了个白眼。]

text: The bookseller starts, then moves to cover the start by stubbing out her cigarette.
translation: 女书商吃了一惊,随即借着掐灭香烟,把这一惊掩饰了过去。

text: The box is heavy; cold to the touch. One quartz-crystal eye flashes in the Antibes sunlight. The dove's other eye is missing.
translation: 盒子很沉；触手冰凉。一颗石英水晶眼在昂蒂布的阳光下闪烁。鸽子的另一只眼不见了。

text: The bulky quartered-cross ornament sometimes worn by ordained priests of the [[Church]] of the Unconquered [[Sun]].
translation: 那种笨重的四分十字饰物，有时由[[教会]]中受圣职的司祭佩戴，侍奉不可征服之[[太阳]]。

text:
The campfire flames were bright as hair-ribbons, the night before we met the men of the Lion in battle, and the moon a scarred and naked knife... 

Recall <link="mypasteveofstjamesthegreater">My Past: Eve of St James the Greater, Khorasan, 1934</link>
translation:
营火的火焰亮如发带——那是我们与狮子的人马交战的前夜——月亮像一把伤痕累累、裸露无鞘的刀……

追忆 <link="mypasteveofstjamesthegreater">我的过去：圣大雅各节前夜，呼罗珊，1934年</link>

text: The campfire flames were bright as hair-ribbons, the night before we of the [[Légion]] met the men of the Lion in battle, and the moon a scarred and naked knife. We were joking, and when they thought I couldn't see, they were drinking, but neither could quite hide our fear. And we didn't even know then just how many of us were going to die.
translation: 营火的火焰亮如发带，那是我们[[门关军团]]与狮子军交战的前一夜，那晚的月亮像一柄伤痕累累、赤裸裸的刀。我们说笑着，而当他们以为我看不见的时候，还偷偷喝起了酒，但谁也藏不住心中的恐惧。而那时我们甚至还不知道，我们之中究竟有多少人将要死去。

text: The card-players Chez Felix asked for drinks...
translation: 费利克斯之家的牌友们要了酒水……

text: The cat backs away, bristle-twitching with ineffectual martinet fury, and darts off down the train.
translation: 猫退了几步,毛根根竖起,带着一股徒劳的、教官式的怒火,然后窜出车厢,朝列车深处跑去。

text: The cat in the living room.
translation: 客厅里那只猫。

text: The cat leaps, skids, scrambles away in a tangled paroxysm of terror. It finds refuge on the top of the piano, staring warily from wide, resentful eyes.
translation: 猫跳起,打滑,在一团纠缠的恐惧痉挛中连滚带爬地逃窜。它躲到钢琴顶上,睁着圆瞪的、怨恨的眼睛警惕地望来。

text: The cat remains motionless on the sofa.
translation: 猫在沙发上一动不动。

text: The cat remains safely out of reach on the piano's summit.
translation: 猫安然待在钢琴顶上,让人够不着。

text: The cat suffers my touch, although no purr is forthcoming. The fur is very soft. The eyes are quite mad.
translation: 猫容忍了我的抚摸,尽管并未发出呼噜声。毛非常柔软。那双眼睛相当疯狂。

text: The cat watches me with unblinking suspicion.
translation: 猫一眨不眨地、满含猜疑地望着我。

text: The cat's eyes fix upon me. Its stare is at once both terrified and indignant.
translation: 猫的眼睛定在我身上。那目光既惊恐,又愤慨。

text: The chill of the metal is more clearly perceptible. There is no taste; except the dust of an object kept for some time in a doctor's desk.
translation: 金属的凉意更清晰可辨。没有味道；只有某件在医生抽屉里搁置已久的器物所沾的灰尘味。

text: The circus came west from Genoa to the Côte d'Azur - which must have been when Nina stopped in at the Sanitarium.  Its route goes on along the coast through Marseille, Montpellier, Béziers. Then north into wilder regions. I've missed most of the dates, but it's due in the city of Mimata, in the mountains of Lozère. There should still be time to catch it there.
translation: 马戏团自热那亚西行至蔚蓝海岸——想必就是那时,尼娜顺道去了疗养院。其路线沿海岸继续延伸,途经马赛、蒙彼利埃、贝济耶,然后北上进入更为蛮荒的地带。大部分日期我已错过,不过下一场演出定在洛泽尔群山中的米玛塔城。赶到那里,应当还来得及。

text: The circus train can't or won't travel here.
translation: 马戏团列车无法或不愿前往此地。

text: The circus...?
translation: 马戏团……？

text: The clock whirrs and whines. The numbers flip frantically to what might be a date or a message, before returning to the steady flipping. The mechanism is incomprehensible.
translation: 时钟嗡嗡作响，呜呜哀鸣。数字疯狂翻动，拼出某个也许是日期、也许是讯息的东西，然后才回到平稳的翻动。这机制实在无法理解。

text: The coffee is irreproachable - bitter enough to make an impression, gentle enough not to leave one.
translation: 这咖啡无可指摘——苦得足以让人记住,柔得让人记不住。

text: The cold of the grave; the cold that comes before the dawn.
translation: 坟墓的寒冷;黎明之前的寒冷。

text: The compass rose faces every direction from the circle's edge. Rose goes anywhere.
translation: 罗盘玫瑰从圆周边缘指向所有方向。引能去任何地方。

text: The crawling feel of half-grown whiskers -like dirt beneath the nails or tinny music half-heard - until it's gone, the aggravation is almost imperceptible.
translation: 半长胡茬带来的爬搔感——像指甲缝里的污垢，或隐约可闻的刺耳乐声——不到消失之时，这份烦扰几乎不可察觉。

text: The crowd hoots and cheers as the two of them kiss. Her ticket-clipper falls from her hand as she grabs desperately at the small of his back, to press him closer...
translation: 两人亲吻时,人群又是起哄又是欢呼。她拼命抓着他后腰,想把他搂得更紧,剪票钳从她手中滑落……

text: The current manageress is identified as 'Mlle [[Nina Lagasse]].'
translation: 现任女班主的署名是 '[[尼娜·拉加斯]]小姐'。

text:
The death of faith in human nature? Or daylight's chill? Cynical choices are lonely, cautious, practical.

[Evolve this Passion to Cynicism, which contributes Knock and Winter to your Aspect Pool.]
translation:
是对人性信念的幻灭？还是白昼的寒意？犬儒的选择是孤独的、谨慎的、务实的。

〔将这项激情进化为犬儒，它将为你的性相池增添启与冬。〕

text: The debatable space at the edge of the waking world. One of the concerns of the [[Duties]]. Some authorities identify the Marches with the Bounds between the [[Wake]] and the [[Mansus]]. [[Legion]]
translation: 醒世边缘那片悬而未决的空间。[[职司]]所关切的事务之一。有权威人士认为,边地与[[醒世]]和[[漫宿]]之间的边界之地是同一处。[[军团]]

text: The departing water swirls, gurgles, and leaves for the sea.
translation: 流走的水打着旋，汩汩作响，奔赴大海。

text: The devastated city where the New King fell in battle - and its coastal lifeline
translation: 新王战殁于斯的废墟之城,连同它的海岸生命线

text: The director is a man in distinguished middle age with a look of sleek intelligence. His hair, his nails, his smile are all extremely clean.
translation: 院长是位风度高雅的中年人，神情透着油滑的机敏。他的头发、指甲、笑容，全都干净得出奇。

text: The director of the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui smiles at me from behind his desk.
translation: 今日疗养院的院长隔着办公桌向我微笑。

text: The doc's a vegetarian. Rodia's always on a diet. The Strath doesn't like 'foreign food'. Though Vincent and Mat... those cats have appetites.
translation: 医生吃素。罗迪娅永远在节食。斯特拉斯科因不喜欢“外国菜”。倒是文森特和马特……那俩家伙胃口好得很。

text: The doc's people?
translation: 医生那边的人?

text: The doctor bends over in his chair to poke around in a drawer at the base of his desk. For a few seconds, he bends low enough that his head is beneath the level of the desk-top.
translation: 医生坐在椅中弯下腰,在书桌底座处的抽屉里翻找。有那么几秒,他弯得极低,头都低到了桌面之下。

text: The doctor observes my dressing gown.
translation: 医生打量起我的睡袍。

text: The door behind me, m'sieu.
translation: 门在我身后,先生。

text: The door swings inwards - not only a little, before it jams against something in the crowded room beyond - but the opening is wide enough for me to step through.
translation: 门向内旋开——开得不算少，随即卡在门后那间拥挤房间里某样东西上——不过开口已足够我跨步而入。

text: The door swings open. No-one in the corridor.
translation: 门摆开了。走廊里没人。

text: The door to the kitchen? A sign reads 'PRIVATE'.
translation: 通往厨房的门?牌子上写着 '闲人免进'。

text: The dream moves on. Perhaps it's found better prey.
translation: 梦继续前行。也许它已觅得更中意的猎物。

text: The dream of the wood. I don't like the dark.
translation: 树林之梦。我不喜欢黑暗。

text: The dream of worms. [Shudder]
translation: 蠕虫之梦。打了个寒颤。

text: The driver turns his head, eyes steady under the gamma-badge cap of the State Milice, and meets my gaze for a moment.
translation: 司机转过头来——邦国民兵队饰着伽马徽章的帽檐下,目光沉稳——与我对视了片刻。

text: The effect is soothing - hypnotic, even - but not revelatory. Except of course that it reveals the future with every flip.
translation: 这效果令人安心——甚至催眠——却谈不上启示。当然，每一次翻动都在揭示未来，那又另当别论。

text: The experience altered my priorities.
translation: 那些经历改变了我的目标。

text: The experience strengthened my resolution.
translation: 那些经历坚定了我的决心。

text: The eyes of the saint are opened.
translation: 圣人的眼睛,睁开了。

text: The eyes of the saint in the window are open.
translation: 彩窗上,圣人的眼睛睁开了。

text: The familiar blossom-apple taste. Like a gently sanctimonious aunt.
translation: 熟悉的苹果花香。像一位温和而一本正经的姑母。

text: The fascinating horror we call [[Nowhere]].
translation: 我们称之为[[虚无]]的迷人恐惧。

text: The fascists are gone, the Biennale is back, and the Comedy of the Sun is welcome
translation: 法西斯已经离去,双年展重新开幕,太阳喜剧备受欢迎

text:
The first thing I saw, when I opened my new eyes in [[Alexandria]], was Stanislav's face.

Recall <link="mypaststcatherineseve">My Past: St Catherine's Eve, Alexandria, 1948</link>
translation:
在[[亚历山大港]]睁开我这双新眼睛时，我见到的第一样东西，是斯坦尼斯拉夫的脸。

追忆 <link="mypaststcatherineseve">我的过去：圣凯瑟琳节前夜，亚历山大港，1948年</link>

text:
The first thing I saw, when I opened my new eyes in [[Alexandria]], was Stanislav's face. Before that, the first thing I knew was the scent of jasmine. But only once the agony of birth had begun to pass. No wonder infants scream.

By midnight I could move my hands. By morning I could speak. After three days, Stanislav still refused to tell me why they had brought me back. 'Be grateful,' was all he would say. And, eventually, I was - once the pain had soaked into memory like water into sand.
translation:
当我在[[亚历山大港]]睁开崭新的双眼时，第一眼看见的便是斯坦尼斯拉夫的脸。在此之前，我最初感知到的，是茉莉花的香气——但那是在重生的剧痛开始消退之后。难怪婴儿会啼哭。

到午夜时，我已能移动双手。到清晨时，我已能开口说话。三天后，斯坦尼斯拉夫仍不肯告诉我他们为何要让我复活。“心怀感激便是，”他只肯这么说。而最终，我确实满是感激之情——当那痛苦如水流渗入沙土般融入记忆之后。

text: The first time Spencer was dismissed from the Suppression Bureau, it was wretched. The second time was worse.
translation: 斯宾塞第一次被防剿局开除时,那滋味糟透了。第二次更糟。

text: The flag flaps soggily.
translation: 旗帜湿重地翻卷着。

text: The fridge compressor buzzes grumpily.
translation: 冰箱的压缩机嗡嗡地响着,一副不耐烦的模样。

text: The game continues...
translation: 牌局继续……

text: The game couldn't reach the internet - or our server is down.
translation: 游戏无法连接网络——或者我们的服务器宕机了。

text: The game looks best in 16:9 resolutions, but we'll letterbox for widescreen.
translation: 游戏在 16:9 分辨率下观感最佳,宽屏下我们则会以黑边呈现。

text: The garments I recovered from Janvier the tailor, that I'd given him to mend, long ago...
translation: 这些衣物是我从裁缝雅维埃那里取回的,是很久以前我交给他修补的……

text: The gift the Stars brought the [[Ministries]]. Something like [[Lantern]], but not.
translation: 群星赠予[[联盟]]的礼物。有几分像[[灯]],却又不尽相同。

text: The grass here ripples with life, like a well-kept horse in a sunray.
translation: 此处的草叶如波浪般起伏,生机盎然,像一匹养得油亮的马立在日光之中。

text: The hands quiver desperately, as if trying to break free of this moment. Twelve division-marks watch hungrily. The Wars were hard on clocks.
translation: 指针绝望地颤抖着,仿佛要挣脱这一刻。十二道刻度贪婪地注视着。战争对钟表并不友善。

text: The hands rotate lazily, like circling dragonflies. Since the Wars, clocks have grown unhelpful.
translation: 指针懒洋洋地转着,像盘旋的蜻蜓。战争之后,钟表已帮不上什么忙。

text: The headlights burn; the engine rumbles.
translation: 车灯灼亮;引擎轰鸣。

text: The heart of a pet? Did you take its life with your own hands?
translation: 一只宠物的心?是你亲手取了它的性命?

text: The heart's a well of truths. I sang that once. Better in Greek.
translation: 心是真理之井。我唱过这一句。用希腊语唱,更妙。

text: The heat of the forge; the heat that warms silver to gold.
translation: 锻炉的炽热;那将白银暖成黄金的炽热。

text: The heat strikes me like a friendly fist. I'm now Dripping.
translation: 热浪像一记友善的拳头迎面打来。我现在大汗淋漓了。

text: The heat strikes me like a friendly fist. I'm now Perspiring.
translation: 热浪像一记友善的拳头迎面打来。我现在微微冒汗了。

text: The heresy of choice in the New World, where dissenters fled the [[Church]]'s light. Its iconography includes doves, lambs, and the Crucian Form on which they assert the Shepherd-Illuminate was executed by the Roman authorities - empty, to symbolise his Illumination and ascent.
translation: 新大陆备受青睐的异端，异议者逃离[[教会]]之光后所皈依的信仰。其图像学包括鸽子、羔羊，以及十字形态——他们断言启明之牧者被罗马当局处死于其上，而那形态是空的，象征他的启明与升天。

text: The high city running hungry under the arrowed yoke
translation: 高城在缀箭之轭下忍饥前行

text: The holes in the world?
translation: 世界上的窟窿?

text: The honour is mine, Dr Aubière.
translation: 荣幸的是我,奥比埃医生。

text: The inattentive will see a pale grey handkerchief - the attentive, a subtle pattern for a subtle colour on a weave that grants it subtle life. 'Nothing dearer than the song of grey, where Precision joins Imprecision.'
translation: 不留心的人只看见一块浅灰的手帕——留心的人则看见：一种精巧的颜色，一个精巧的图案，织在一块赋予它们精巧生命的布上。“没有什么比灰色的歌更珍贵，在那里，精确与不精确交汇。”

text: The invisible hand of the market; the golden hand of Incorporation.
translation: 市场那只看不见的手；集团那只金色的手。

text: The itch is tiresome.
translation: 这瘙痒,着实恼人。

text: The keystone of civilisation; the world's deep heart.
translation: 文明的基石；世界深处的真心。

text: The kind of thing that rattles around in a drawer until, one day, you really need it.
translation: 那种在抽屉里叮当作响、直到某一天你真需要它的东西。

text: The last of the divided god
translation: 被分裂之神的最后残余。

text: The last of the flayed god. (The last?)
translation: 剥皮之神的最后残余。（最后的？）

text: The last of the generous god
translation: 慷慨之神的最后残余

text: The last witch of Lagash! A traitress, a fraud.
translation: 拉格什的末代女巫!一个叛徒,一个骗子。

text: The laws and contentions of the Hours and their emanations. Covers Church doctrine and to some extent technique, although technique is more usually [[Illumination]]. Like Illumination, it's a [[Bright Art]]. Used at Thresholds and in Holy Places.
translation: 司辰及其流溢之物的律法与纷争。涵盖教会教义,也部分涉及技法,尽管技法通常更归于[[照明术]]。与照明术一样,它是一门[[光之技艺]]。用于门关与圣洁之地。

text: The letter confirms that its bearer, Père Laiton, has the diocese's authorisation to pursue matters concerning the medical records of his one-time parishioner, Liliane Huissier. It carries the stamp of the episcopal chancery. It's easily good enough to convince someone who doesn't spend much time looking at episcopal chancery stamps.
translation: 这封信确认持信人黄铜神父获得教区授权，可处理其昔日教区居民莉莉安·韦西耶的医疗档案事宜。信上盖着主教府的公章。对不常细看主教府公章的人来说，它足以乱真。

text: The light in Cornwall was famous. When I saw a strange face, it was usually a painter.
translation: 康沃尔的光,远近闻名。每当我见到陌生的面孔,那多半是位画家。

text: The light-bulb fizzes faintly. Léon is definitely gone.
translation: 灯泡发出轻微的滋滋声。莱昂肯定已经走了。

text: The looking first; perhaps the listening next? One question is enough.
translation: 先是打量;接下来,兴许是聆听?一个问题,足矣。

text: The lore of the primaeval wood; rarely written, often felt. One of the [[Arts Unconsidered]], used in Verdant and Shadowed Places.
translation: 太古之林的学问;罕有书载,多为亲觉。属[[未识技艺]]之一,用于翠绿与幽影之地。

text: The lovely chaos we call the [[Wood]].
translation: 我们称之为[[木材]]的可爱混沌。

text: The lower reaches of the Mansus are no longer safe - not since their guardians fled and the colder powers moved in.
translation: 漫宿的下层不再安全——自从那里的守护者逃散、更寒冷的力量入驻之后。

text: The management regrets any inconvenience.
translation: 「店方为造成的不便深表歉意。」

text: The management situation at the Rosa Mundi circus.
translation: 罗莎·蒙迪马戏团的经营状况。

text: The miners in my congregation came filthy as worms from under the earth, but they were spotless every Sunday in church.
translation: 我堂区的矿工们从地底钻出来时,污秽得像蠕虫,可每逢礼拜日走进教堂,总是纤尘不染。

text: The mirror has been placed here to catch and share the light that falls through the window.
translation: 这面镜子放在这里，是为了接住并散播透窗而入的光。

text: The mirror is useless for any practical purpose. But it is difficult now to find a working mirror. And it will help me remember, when my wits finally fail me.
translation: 这面镜子于任何实际用途而言都毫无用处。但如今,想找到一面还能用的镜子并不容易。而且等我终有一日神志不清时,它能帮我记起从前。

text: The mirror shows a completely different room - a larger shop - in late evening or early twilight.
translation: 镜中映出的是另一间完全不同的屋子——一间更大的店铺——时值黄昏将尽,或暮色初临。

text: The moment you hear anything, yes?
translation: 你一听到任何风声,就来告诉我,好吗?

text: The moonlight here is clear enough to make out the edges of the discoloured patch - of the texture of the paint.
translation: 这里的月光清朗得足以辨出那块变色区域的边缘——以及涂料的纹理。

text:
The mortal and immortal institutions, like the [[Bureau]], that from time immemorial kept the hidden world from intruding into the everyday.

All seems a bit pointless now, really.
translation:
那些凡人与不朽的机构,如[[防剿局]],自亘古以来守护着隐匿的世界,不让它侵入日常。

如今,这一切似乎都有点徒劳了,真的。

text: The most fundamental elements of reality; or, the various natures of the [[Hours]]; or, words tumbled in [[Eternity]]'s echoes; or, abstruse occult categories obsessively argued over by obsessives.
translation: 现实最根本的元素；或者，[[司辰]]的种种本性；或者，在[[永恒]]的余响中翻滚的词句；或者，被痴迷者痴迷争论的晦涩秘学范畴。

text: The most significant characters that you've met appear here. Examine them to remind yourself who they are... and how glad they'll be to see you.
translation: 你遇见过的那些最重要的人物会出现在这里。检视他们，提醒自己他们是谁……以及见到你时他们会多么高兴。

text: The murderous regime whose crimes broke the continent; whose weapons soured the sun. So much for their dreams of conquest and purification. Even the night is against them now.
translation: 那个嗜杀的政权，其罪行撕裂了整片大陆；其武器使太阳变色。他们的征服与净化之梦，算是完了。如今连夜晚也站在他们的对立面。

text: The name given to seven great libraries of the hidden world, where the [[Church]] and the [[Duties]] tolerate otherwise forbidden knowledge. Perhaps the result of an arrangement with the [[Watchman]], though that sounds unlike him.
translation: 这是隐世七座伟大图书馆共用的名号，在那里，[[教会]]与[[职司]]容忍着本应被禁的知识。或许是某次与[[守夜人]]达成安排的产物——尽管这听起来不像他的作风。

text: The name itself is a reminder that the Sun is divided yet indivisible; constant but ever-changing.
translation: 这书名本身便提醒着:太阳分裂而不可分,恒常而无常。

text: The nearest card-player calls out in a hoarse stage-whisper: 'Be careful! Linou always overcharges foreigners!'
translation: 最近的那位牌客哑着嗓子，以人人都听得见的耳语喊道：「当心！利努总是敲外国人的竹杠！」

text: The new heart of Europe... not quite as broken as we might expect
translation: 欧洲的新心脏……并不像我们预想的那般破碎

text: The newly-minted Italian Republic. The King is gone, the Julian March is lost, the Icarians were roundly defeated in this year's election. Everything is different. And this time, everything will be different.
translation: 新铸的意大利共和国。国王已去,尤利安边区已失,伊加利亚人在今年的选举中一败涂地。一切都不同了。而这一次,一切将会不同。

text: The night is entertained...where it can find its place in the shadowless sanitarium. It speculates how it would be if I were alone again.
translation: 夜色自得其乐……在无影的疗养院里,它也能寻到自己的位置。它揣想着,若我再度孤身一人,会是何种光景。

text: The number of nights that Spencer has slept somewhere. After the first night, he'll begin to accrue Traces.
translation: 斯宾塞在某地过夜的天数。过了第一夜，他便开始积攒痕迹。

text: The odour of Labrikon is grainy and dank - like cellar-stone, or the smell of the lower layers of the Mansus.
translation: 拉布里孔的气味粗粝而阴湿——像地窖的石头，像漫宿底层的味道。

text:
The official [[Ministries]] currency - more than that, the currency of the Great Exchange, the mutual bank guaranteed by Stars themselves. Utterly reliable incarnation of Icarian-Proudhonist mutualism; onteiriologically perfect reflection of the value of labour; a means of exchange guaranteed not by gold or by silver, but by the fate-synthesis of the shining fellow-travellers from outside the sky. Universally accepted in the Soviet sphere, utterly forbidden in the West.

One dollar will get you four doli, if you can find someone to make the exchange.
translation:
[[联盟]]的官方货币——不止于此，它还是大汇兑所的货币，那家由群星亲自担保的互助银行。它是伊加利亚—蒲鲁东式互助主义绝无偏差的化身；是劳动价值的梦境学完美映照；是一种不以黄金或白银、而以天外闪耀的同路者们的命运合成为担保的交换媒介。在苏联势力范围内普受接纳，在西方则绝对禁止。

一美元能换四多利亚——前提是你能找到愿意做成这笔兑换的人。

text: The old woman who masquerades as the Pilgrim's mother. Her attributes strongly suggest the [[Vagabond]].
translation: 那个伪装成巡礼者母亲的老妇人。她的种种特质强烈地指向[[浪游旅人]]。

text: The omelette is excellent. Fresh eggs, peppers, ham: all of those are difficult to come by.
translation: 煎蛋卷美味极了。鲜蛋、甜椒、火腿:这些如今可都不好弄到。

text: The only town of any size in Graustark; the seat of the von Nagelsburgs since the 1500s
translation: 格劳斯塔克唯一略具规模的小镇;自 16 世纪起便是冯·纳格尔斯堡家族的驻地

text: The order of the [[Hours]] had its flaws, but they upheld time, sense and symmetry...
translation: [[司辰]]的秩序自有其瑕疵,但他们维系着时间、意义与对称……

text: The other hand, however, the one holding her cigarette, is almost clear of greenery.
translation: 然而,另一只手——夹着香烟的那只——几乎不见草木滋生。

text: The other kind of night-work?
translation: 另一种夜活？

text: The pewtered surface of the Baie des Anges falls away. The rain slams the sky closed. The hills rise around us...
translation: 天使湾锡灰色的水面落在身后。大雨砰然阖上天空。山丘在我们四周隆起……

text: The phenomenal Hours - where the seirai touch the world - are downstream manifestations of the henades. You can call on them. But it doesn't do anything. You can't make them do anything, any more than they can make the henads do things. I'd be like...
translation: 现象司辰——赛拉触及世界之处——是太一下游的显现。你可以呼唤它们。但那无济于事。你无法让它们做任何事，正如它们也无法让太一做任何事。那就好比……

text: The point is the point. It's a perfect eternal double motion of emanation and yearning.
translation: 意义就是意义本身。那是流溢与渴慕的完美永恒的双重运动。

text: The possibility of a picnic
translation: 野餐的可能性

text: The possibility of sparks; a heat that alters.
translation: 火花萌生的可能；一种会改变的热。

text: The power of it! Once you taste godhood -even a drop of it - you can't be just a note in the song.
translation: 那种力量！一旦你尝过神性——哪怕只是一滴——你就再不甘心做歌谣中的一个音符。

text: The powers of higher heaven might honour this request - or wink at an exception.
translation: 更高天界的力量也许会成全这一请求——或对某个例外睁一只眼闭一只眼。

text: The pragmatic...
translation: 务实者……

text: The pre-eminent form of socialism in the twentieth century, based on the common ownership of the resources of creation. From the dream of a European radical, to an efflorescence of Utopian communities and revolutionary movements, to the system on which the [[Ministries]] founded their power.
translation: 二十世纪最重要的社会主义形态，基于对创造资源的共同所有权。从一名欧洲激进者的梦想，到乌托邦公社与革命运动的繁盛，再到[[联盟]]建立其权力体系。

text: The presence that calls itself 'Dr Sinombre' has offered to convey me to Aubière's dream, if I meet its requirements.
translation: 那个自称'西诺姆布尔医生'的存在提出,只要我满足它的条件,便把我送进奥比埃的梦中。

text: The presence that calls itself 'Dr Sinombre' is ready to convey me to Dr Aubière's dream when I next sleep.
translation: 那个自称「西诺姆布尔医生」的存在已经准备好,待我下次入睡时,把我送入奥比埃医生的梦境。

text: The priest blinks slowly, as if struggling to focus.
translation: 神父缓缓眨着眼,仿佛正费力地聚拢目光。

text: The priest turns to gesture at the stained glass window behind the altar.
translation: 神父转过身,朝祭坛后的彩绘玻璃窗比了个手势。

text: The proper use of this sombre sign silences restless spirits. Improper use can trouble the sleep and health of living human spirits.
translation: 正确使用这阴沉的印记，能让不安的亡魂归于沉寂。使用不当则会扰乱生者的睡眠与健康。

text: The proprietress raises her head suddenly as I step towards the door.
translation: 我朝门口迈步时,老板娘猛地抬起了头。

text:
The proud but ailing [[currency]] of the proud but failing Empire. Not as widely accepted as Incorporate dollars or Swiss francs. But better than francisques or ostmarks.

A pound's worth about four dollars.
translation:
骄傲却日渐衰颓的帝国那骄傲却病入膏肓的[[货币]]。不像集团美元或瑞士法郎那样广受欢迎。但比法兰西斧币或东德马克强些。

一英镑约值四美元。

text: The rain has drowned the joy of it. Or perhaps Léon just has no imagination at all.
translation: 雨水把其中的喜悦全浇没了。也可能莱昂根本毫无想象力。

text: The rain's only half-erased the chalk. The bookshop owner must have re-lettered it just this morning. A determined soul.
translation: 雨水只擦掉了一半粉笔字。书店老板准是今天早上刚刚重新描过。真是个执着的人。

text: The rain's perked up these flowers, at least.
translation: 至少，这场雨让这些花精神起来了。

text: The relationship between the Wood and the Mansus isn't something anyone can express directly.
translation: 木材与漫宿之间的关系，没有人能够直陈。

text: The repairs are complete. A small sum is payable.
translation: 修补已经完工。还有一小笔钱待付。

text: The revolutionary [[Icarian]] workers' councils which drove the revolution in Russia have become more efficient, under the [[Gleam]]-light. The Stars accept and synthesise their decisions, beneath the avuncular and mighty gaze of Steel - the 'Advisory Entity to the Council of Ministers.' The Stars in turn pass their gifts to the Ministries, who enact those decisions. What could be better?
translation: 当年推动俄国革命的革命性[[伊加利亚]]工人委员会,在[[烁]]的照耀下变得愈发高效。群星在钢铁——「部长会议顾问实体」——亲切而威严的注视之下,接受并综合它们的决定。群星再将馈赠转交联盟,由联盟来执行那些决定。还能有比这更好的吗?

text: The richer the man, the harder to like. M. Strathcoyne [the name is much gallified] is very rich.
translation: 人越有钱,越难让人喜欢。斯特拉斯科因先生[这名字被法语化得厉害]非常有钱。

text: The risen Smok, the seething Nest, the fallen Star
translation: 复生的斯莫克,沸腾的巢穴,坠落的星辰

text: The sadness that remains from time in flesh
translation: 自仍为血肉之躯时便留存下来的悲哀。

text: The safe opens easily.
translation: 保险柜轻而易举地打开了。

text: The saint will bring you together, you and this Nina, once her eyes are open. I'm certain of it.
translation: 等她睁开眼睛,圣人定会让你们重逢——您和这位尼娜。我确信无疑。

text: The sea does not regret the tide, and after the tide withdraws, something always remains, which we call memory.
translation: 大海不会为潮汐而悔恨,潮水退去之后,总有些什么留存下来,我们称之为回忆。

text:
The secret gods who live behind the world; perilous, sublime, merciless in suppressing competition. Some rose through the ranks of [[Know]] and [[Long]] and [[Names]]. Some came by their estate in a different way entirely.

Before the wars, the Hours made sense of History. Their debates and compromises braided all the possible pasts into a coherent future. Now most Hours are [[Uncounted]], and History is increasingly open to onteirological incoherence or hierophanic sabotage.
translation:
那些居于世界背面的隐秘神灵；危险、崇高，在镇压挑战者时全无怜悯。有些经由[[通晓者]]、[[长生者]]与[[具名者]]的序列而飞升；有些则以完全不同的方式获得其地位。

在战前，司辰能让历史保持意义。祂们的争论与妥协将所有可能的过往编织为一个连贯的未来。如今大多数司辰已[[除名]]，而历史愈发暴露于本体性的紊乱与象征性的破坏之下。

text: The secret heart of the wood? Or the [[Wood]]? Did Emmenegger approach the [[Mansus]] in his dreams?
translation: 这片树林的秘密之心？抑或那[[木材]]？埃门内格是否曾在梦中接近[[漫宿]]？

text: The shadow is its own kind of substance. It almost drips darkness.
translation: 那阴影自有其质地。它几乎在滴淌黑暗。

text: The shadowless light of the sun-cross chandelier above, the perpetual fire of the Unconquered Sun, the underwater glow of the stained glass windows, all make the altar bright.
translation: 头顶太阳十字吊灯的无影之光、不败之日的恒久之火、彩绘玻璃窗那水底般的幽光,共同将祭坛映得明亮。

text: The shelves in the living room. A number of the items in the collection have some relationship with Cornwall - even, specifically, with Brancrug, and with Hush House?
translation: 客厅里的那些搁架。藏品里有不少东西跟康沃尔有渊源——甚至,具体说,跟布兰库格、跟噤声居屋有关?

text: The sign of the half-human hill-child called bisclavret. The sign trembles with aguey vitality.
translation: 被称为比斯克拉弗雷的半人山野之子的印记。这印记带着寒热般的活力颤动着。

text: The skeleton of a commedia scenario.
translation: 一幕即兴喜剧的骨架。

text: The sleekly smiling director of the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui.
translation: 今日疗养院那笑容油滑的院长。

text: The soft and dusty grey-green of Highland hills. A fine accessory for an earl out to bag pheasants.
translation: 苏格兰高地丘陵那柔和而蒙尘的灰绿。对一位外出猎雉的伯爵而言,这是得体的配饰。

text: The sombre, the sinister, the suspicious. Works of the [[Night Arts]] and criminal instruments.
translation: 阴沉、险恶、可疑之物。[[夜之技艺]]之作,与犯罪工具。

text: The station hall is almost deserted. Not so many visitors to the Riviera in these times.
translation: 车站大厅几乎空无一人。这个年头,来里维埃拉的游客不多了。

text: The story is that Solomon Husher would use this rite when he wished to leave no footprints. Husher was not a man to fear the Dread this rite sometimes provokes.
translation: 传说所罗门·赫舍希望不留下脚印时便会使用这一仪式。赫舍并不是会害怕此仪式偶尔引发之恐惧的人。

text:
The study of things that should not be studied: Worms, earthquakes, sub-real interventions.

One of the [[Night Arts]]; it can be used at Wounds and Shadowed Places.
translation:
对不应研究之物的研究:蠕虫、地震、亚现实干预。

属[[夜之技艺]]之一;可用于受创之地与幽影之地。

text: The sun has set...
translation: 太阳已经落山……

text: The sunlight folds itself tidily across the desk, softened by the glass of the window. The softened colour of it takes me back...
translation: 阳光穿过窗玻璃，柔柔地、整整齐齐地叠在桌面上。那柔化的颜色，让我回到从前……

text: The tag's applied on this node.
translation: 该标签施加于这个节点。

text: The taste is as I remember: an angry-medical fennel-mint. But it's weak! Much weaker than I remember.
translation: 味道与记忆中的一样：一股带火气的药房味茴香薄荷。可它太淡了！比我记得的淡得多。

text: The things in Russia, I mean. The ones behind the Ministries. Everything changed when they came. I was an [[Icarian]]. I still am, I suppose. I think it might get better. But I think, before then, it will get much worse.
translation: 我是说俄国来的那些东西。联盟背后的那些。它们来时，一切都变了。我一度是[[伊加利亚]]人。我想，现在仍是。我觉得事情也许会好转。但好转之前，会先坏得多。

text: The three candles are a Solar tradition. Linou is invoking three faces of the Sun to look kindly upon the departed.
translation: 三支蜡烛是太阳一系的传统。利努正请动太阳的三副面孔，好让它们垂顾逝者。

text: The ticket-inspector was smoking Gitanes all the way from Milan...
translation: 查票员一路从米兰抽着吉坦烟……

text: The tiniest of revenges.
translation: 最微小的复仇。

text: The touch of [[Corona]] reliably destroys individuals, but it can be safely (or 'safely') manifested through a corporation with suitably sacred founding documents, whose officers and representatives are visibly exalted. The United States are now, in some senses, the Incorporate States.
translation: [[冕]]的触碰必然摧毁个体，但可以经由一家拥有恰当神圣创始文件的法人实体安全地（或者说『安全地』）显化，其高管与代表明显受到尊崇。在某种意义上，美利坚合众国如今已是集团合众国。

text: The town in the forest is the forest in the town, now
translation: 林中之镇,如今已是镇中之林

text: The traditional payment. [Hold up a spintria.]
translation: 传统的酬谢。[举起一枚斯宾特里亚。]

text: The train runs to Mimata, and Mimata is where I'll find [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 列车驶往米玛塔,而我将在米玛塔找到[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: The train's roar fades into the distance. Its echoes follow like beggar-children. A clinging, loamy silence falls.
translation: 火车的轰鸣渐渐远去。它的回声如乞儿般追随其后。一片黏稠的、泥壤般的寂静降临。

text: The train's whistle shrieks with joy, and then its engines drive it forward, into the night between cities.
translation: 火车的汽笛欢快地尖啸,随后引擎驱动车身向前,驶入城与城之间的夜色。

text: The trains here are better than the desert express. Even after the Wars.
translation: 这儿的火车比沙漠快车好。哪怕在战事过后。

text: The tricoloured French flag - but the central band is marked with the francisque, the starry double-axe which has become the emblem of the French [[State]].
translation: 法国三色旗——只是中间的条纹上饰有法兰西斧,这把缀星双头斧已成为法国[[邦国]]的徽记。

text: The uniform doesn't look French. American, perhaps? But the insignia are odd.
translation: 这身军装不像法军的。或许是美军的？可徽记有些古怪。

text: The uniform of a médecin-lieutenant of the Légion du Seuil. A little faded from the bronze sun of the deep deserts; a little stained, faintly, by the clinging mud of the ghost forests of Indochine.
translation: 门关军团军医中尉的制服。被深漠中青铜色的骄阳晒得微微褪色;又淡淡地染着印度支那幽灵林间黏附的泥污。

text: The unmistakably sensual, intelligent, uncompromising features of the immortal magus Julian [[Coseley]].
translation: 不朽法师朱利安·[[科斯利]]的面容——性感、睿智、毫不妥协，一眼即可辨认。

text: The versatile...
translation: 多面手……

text: The victories are notable for being (a) numerous and (b) overwhelming.
translation: 这些胜利之所以引人注目,在于(一)数目众多,(二)势不可挡。

text: The walls of the House are the size of starlight.
translation: 居屋的墙壁，尺度与星光相同。

text:
The war was lost
		The treaty signed
		I was not caught
		I crossed the line
		I was not caught
		Though many tried
		I live among you, well-disguised
translation:
战争已败
		条约已签
		我未被捕
		我越过了线
		我未被捕
		尽管许多人在尝试
		我活在你们中间,伪装良好

text: The warrior-angel, winged, impassive, harnessed for war.
translation: 战争天使,双翼俱全,面容漠然,披挂备战。

text: The whole business is making him... surly. No sense of humour.
translation: 这整档子事让他变得……乖戾。一点幽默感也没有了。

text: The wild mood passes, the moths depart - but they'll always remember something enchanted about the evening.
translation: 狂放的气氛过去了,飞蛾散去——但他们总会记得,这个夜晚有种着了魔的意味。

text: The wild mood passes, the moths depart - but they'll always remember something enchanted about the evening. When they look back, they'll think of this moment as the hinge, the last bright beat before a silence.
translation: 狂放的气氛过去了,飞蛾散去——但他们总会记得,这个夜晚有种着了魔的意味。回望之时,他们会把这一刻当作枢纽,沉默降临前最后一记明亮的节拍。

text:
The wind reaches right through my thin clothing to lay itself against my skin.

[Change to a warmer Outfit - or stay inside.]
translation:
风径直穿过我单薄的衣衫,贴上我的皮肤。

[换一身更暖和的行头——或者待在室内。]

text: The winning animals have been skilfully photographed from angles chosen to emphasise their noble ovine (or caprine) profiles.
translation: 获奖牲口均被巧妙拍摄,取景角度刻意突出它们尊贵的绵羊(或山羊)侧影。

text: The wise...
translation: 智者……

text: The witch followed another, as you follow her - an old woman of Raveline blood. I concerned myself not with her beast-taint and curse. But your Nina sought something from her.
translation: 那女巫追随着另一个人,正如你追随着她——一位拉韦林血统的老妇人。她的兽污与诅咒,我不曾理会。但你的尼娜,想从她那里得到什么。

text: The woman in the chair is watching me curiously. I should at least speak to her before I begin interfering with her floor.
translation: 椅中的女人正好奇地看着我。在我开始动她的地板之前,至少该先同她说句话。

text: The woman is a white carrion crow, Hobson. A baleful nidus of betrayals! If you know what's good for you, you'll stay well away.
translation: 那女人是只白色的食腐乌鸦,霍布森。一个不祥的背叛之巢!你若明白什么对你有好处,就离她远远的。

text: The wonderful radiance we call the [[Glory]].
translation: 我们称之为[[辉光]]的奇妙光辉。

text: The wood of the chair has begun to bow and twist yearningly towards the flesh of her legs.
translation: 椅子的木头已开始弯折扭转,渴望地朝她双腿的血肉倾去。

text: The wood of the chair has begun to bow and twist yearningly towards the flesh of her legs... the magazine is also crinkled with green where her hand touches it.
translation: 椅子的木头已开始弯折扭转,渴望地朝她双腿的血肉倾去……她手触到的那本杂志也泛起绿意,起了皱褶。

text: The wooden panel is cold and smooth. Aubière is a man of powerfully focused reason.
translation: 木板冰冷而光滑。奥比埃是一个理智高度专注的人。

text: The word was that he'd used [[Ys]]-alloys in his work. That's what interested me most.
translation: 传闻说,他在作品中用到了[[伊苏]]合金。那正是我最感兴趣的。

text: The word was that he'd used secrets from the [[Aviform]] [[Hours]] in his work. That's what interested me most.
translation: 传闻说,他在作品中用到了[[鸟形]][[司辰]]的秘密。那正是我最感兴趣的。

text: The words echo, circling the vaulted ceiling like carrion birds. The echoes intensify. The roof trembles beneath the rain. Is that thunder? It does thunder when it's raining. That's not unusual.
translation: 咒文的字句回荡着,像食腐的鸟,绕着拱形穹顶盘旋。回声越来越强。屋顶在雨中颤抖。那是雷声吗?下雨时确实会打雷。这并不稀奇。

text: The words of the charm echo in the vaulted ceiling. When I look up, something's different.
translation: 咒文的字句在拱形穹顶间回荡。我抬头时,有什么不一样了。

text: The words of the charm echo in the vaulted ceiling; but nothing changes.
translation: 咒文的字句在拱形穹顶间回荡;但什么也没有改变。

text: The words of the saint dwell in your ears. Now your memories will dwell in our eyes. Come with me now.
translation: 圣人的话语,栖居于您的耳中。如今,您的回忆,将栖居于我们眼中。随我来吧。

text: The work of a moment to taint Philomèle's glass.
translation: 转瞬之间，菲洛梅尔的酒杯便被玷污。

text: The work of moments to brush a little bewitchment around the rims of the glasses.
translation: 片刻工夫，一缕魅惑便已抹上各只杯沿。

text: The world breaks everyone and afterward many are strong at the broken places. But those that will not break it kills. It kills the very good and the very gentle and the very brave impartially. If you are none of these you can be sure it will kill you too but there will be no special hurry.
translation: 世界击碎每一个人,此后许多人在破碎之处变得坚强。但那些不肯破碎的人,它便杀死。它毫无偏袒地杀死极善良、极温柔、极勇敢的人。如果你三者都不是,大可放心它终会杀死你,只是不会特别着急。

text: The world divides; the saint unites. I am to tell you that [[Nina Lagasse]] entered the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui.
translation: 世界分裂,圣人弥合。我受圣意转告您:[[尼娜·拉加斯]]进了今日疗养院。

text:
The world grows thinner, the light brighter. It's dangerous to see too much of Eternity.

[As Fascination increases, Spencer will suffer penalties. At Fascination 10, he'll lose his mind, ending the game. When Spencer rests, Fascination and Dread will cancel each other out, but anything left over may cause difficult dreams.]
translation:
世界日渐稀薄,光芒愈发炽亮。窥见过多永恒,是危险的。

[随着入迷加深,斯宾塞将遭受惩罚。入迷达到 10 时,他将丧失心智,游戏就此结束。斯宾塞休息时,入迷与恐惧会相互抵消,但残余的部分可能引发难安的梦境。]

text: The world seems closer and clearer again. I'm no longer Despairing.
translation: 世界似乎又近在咫尺、清晰如初。我不再绝望了。

text: The world!
translation: 世界！

text: The world's a big place...
translation: 这世界大得很……

text: The world, I grant you, has changed. More things are possible that once were not.
translation: 世界,我承认,是变了。从前不可能的事,如今更多了。

text: The wound is visible; the pain is not.
translation: 伤口看得见；疼痛看不见。

text: The writer notes that no Republican sheep (or goats) have won anything, although he doesn't specify whether this is because Republican animals are effete, or just ineligible.
translation: 作者指出,没有共和国的绵羊(或山羊)赢得任何奖项——尽管他没有说明,这是因为共和国的牲畜过于孱弱,还是仅仅不合参赛资格。

text: Their...
translation: 他们的……

text: Then I curse you! I curse your name and your shadow! Leave me alone! Never return!
translation: 那我就诅咒你!我诅咒你的名字,诅咒你的影子!别再来烦我!永远别回来!

text: Then I reflect on the last round of bad times. And the time before that. And the time before... and so I shrug. I complete my constitutional. I am not a repairer of abysses, but only of garments.
translation: 然后,我便回想上一轮的坏时世。再上一轮。再上一轮……于是我便耸耸肩,走完这趟散步。我不是修补深渊的人,只是修补衣裳的人。

text: Then I'd like to speak to the Director.
translation: 那我还是要和院长谈谈。

text: Then go. Go! And tell no-one. I am a woman of good reputation and your slanders will not touch me.
translation: 那就走。走!不许告诉任何人。我是名声清白的女人,你的诽谤伤不到我。

text: Then no. In Epirus one saw that sometimes. But Rodia, no.
translation: 那么,没有。在伊庇鲁斯,有时也能见到那样的事。但罗迪娅,没有。

text: Then no. The Plague of Leaves was known to gift its sufferers so, in Epirus. It has been called the Plague of Flowers too. But Rodia left not quite too late, and so she has no flowers.
translation: 那么,没有。在伊庇鲁斯,据说叶疫正是这样恩赐染病之人的。它也曾被称作花疫。但罗迪娅离开得不算太迟,所以,她身上没有花。

text: Then no. We whom the Plague of Leaves has touched are ripe - but not in any human sense. In Epirus one saw the bodies sprouting in the streets. But none bore children.
translation: 那么,没有。我们这些被叶疫触碰过的人,已然成熟——但绝不是人类意义上的成熟。在伊庇鲁斯,人们曾看见街上的躯体萌出新芽。但没有人怀上子嗣。

text: Then the doc's people leased it from her. But Audrey told them I could stay as long as I liked.
translation: 后来医生那边的人从她手里租了下来。但奥德丽跟他们说了,我想待多久都行。

text: Then we will see you later. Perhaps.
translation: 那我们回头见。也许吧。

text: Then why do you keep one in your office?
translation: 那您为什么还在办公室里放一面呢？

text: Then you don't provide any... little luxuries... for Strathcoyne?
translation: 这么说，你从不为斯特拉斯科因提供任何……小小的奢侈……？

text: Then you must surely have an appointment.
translation: 那您想必有预约。

text: Then you'll offer me what? For the dreams that I'll bring?
translation: 那么,你愿意给我什么?换我带来的梦境?

text: Then you'll open her eyes?
translation: 那么,您会睁开她的眼睛?

text: Then, the Enemy came... and it was gone. I mean, it was the end.
translation: 然后,敌人来了……它就没了。我是说,那就是终局。

text: Then...?
translation: 然后呢……？

text: There
translation: 那里

text: There are more important things than what I want.
translation: 有比我想要的更重要的东西。

text: There are parts of the Mediterranean now where the sea is mud or blood. Here, still, it's the Bay of Angels. Blue as the remembered skies of childhood.
translation: 如今,地中海有些地方,海水已成了泥浆或血。而这里,依然是天使湾。蓝得像童年记忆里的天空。

text: There are. But I am not easily frightened by dreams.
translation: 确实有。但我没那么容易被梦吓到。

text: There are... abysses of night... in Antibes.
translation: 有……黑夜的深渊……在昂蒂布。

text: There is a café on the square, near the fountain and the flag. Every day she goes there. Philomèle! Blight her! Punish her!
translation: 广场上有一家咖啡馆,挨着喷泉和旗杆。她每天都要去。菲洛梅尔!降祸于她!惩罚她!

text: There is a small surcharge for painters and for poets. Even Jean-Bernard.
translation: 对画家和诗人，要收一点小额附加费。让-贝尔纳也不例外。

text: There is a story, you know. They took some Charlemagnes - the turncoats, you know, the Enemy volunteers - in the last days of the war. They asked the Charlemagnes how they could stand to wear German uniforms.
translation: 有个故事，你知道吗。战争最后的日子里，他们逮住了一些查理曼师的人——就是那些变节者，你知道的，投敌的志愿兵。他们问查理曼师的人，怎么受得了穿德国军装。

text: There is also an unflattering doodle of me. It's probably me. It has a moustache, anyway.
translation: 还有一幅对我毫不恭维的涂鸦。大概是我。反正它画着胡子。

text: There is no point. There doesn't need to be. It's how things are.
translation: 没有意义。也不需要有意义。事情本就是如此。

text: There is no sugar.
translation: 没有糖。

text: There may be information that will compel Aubière's assistance. Perhaps someone else in the Sanitarum can help me.
translation: 也许有某些情报,能让奥比埃不得不相助。疗养院里或许还有别人能帮我。

text: There really is coffee in there... somewhere.
translation: 里面真的有咖啡……在某个地方。

text:
There used to be more in me.

[An absence that might be filled with any Passion.]
translation:
我体内曾经有更多东西。

[一处可以被任意激情填满的空缺。]

text: There was an ending...
translation: 曾有过一个结局……

text: There was something else?
translation: 还有别的事？

text: There's a [[History]] where I found myself living by the sea in a stately white house, with a painting like this over my fireplace...
translation: 有一段[[历史]],在那其中,我发现自己住在海边的白屋之中,华美庄严,壁炉上方就挂着这样一幅画……

text: There's a door here, carefully painted, hinges almost flush with the wall. No handle, but all I need to do is tug at the other side -
translation: 这里有一扇门，刷得精心，合页几乎与墙齐平。没有把手，我只需拽住另一侧——

text: There's a kind of smoothness in her eyes, like water flowing behind a pane of glass. For a moment it is as if she's forgotten who I am.
translation: 她眼底透着一种平滑，像水在玻璃板后流动。有那么一刻，仿佛她已经忘了我是什么人。

text: There's a painting of the Mansus on open display in your library.
translation: 你的图书馆里,公开挂着一幅漫宿的画。

text: There's a rather grim scholarly debate on whether the Cross-changed actually become the end product, or are consumed by the Cross-seed within them. Strathcoyne's arm moves with unsettling independence.
translation: 学界有一场颇为阴森的争论:经介壳种之变者,究竟是真正成为最终的产物,还是被体内的介壳种子所吞噬。斯特拉斯科因的胳膊正以令人不安的独立性自行活动着。

text: There's a slightly discoloured rectangle on the wall behind the mirror. Was there a door here - now painted or plastered over?
translation: 镜子后面的墙上，有一块微微变色的矩形。这里曾有一扇门——如今被油漆或灰泥糊住了？

text: There's a wolf that eats thought...
translation: 有一匹狼,专噬思想……

text: There's always a reason... but often, I'm playing the long game.
translation: 总归有理由……但很多时候，我放的是长线。

text: There's always a reason... but sometimes I like to keep it to myself.
translation: 总归有理由……但有时我喜欢把它留给自己。

text: There's always a way forward. If I run out of pips, I'll find something else.
translation: 总有路可走。若点数用尽，我会另寻他法。

text: There's always more pips where those pips came from.
translation: 点数总有来处，永远还会有更多。

text:
There's always, always something more to know.

A [[Passion]].
translation:
永远，永远都有更多值得知道。

一种[[激情]]。

text: There's nothing there for you, and be glad of that. Come talk to Sinombre, you poor silly thing.
translation: 那里没有你要的东西,你该为此庆幸。过来和西诺姆布尔聊聊吧,你这可怜的小傻瓜。

text: There's so much pain in the world.
translation: 这世上的痛苦何其之多。

text: There. We have what we need.
translation: 好了。我们需要的,都有了。

text: These are the black halls of sightless Sleep.
translation: 这里是盲目之眠的漆黑殿堂。

text: These cigars look sumptuous. I have to try them. Pocket a few.
translation: 这些雪茄看起来华美极了。非试不可。揣上几支。

text: These rapscallions are drawing cards out of a woman's shoe and playing for small stakes. You're not going to lose your shirt. Or whatever other Outfit you're wearing.
translation: 这群捣蛋鬼正从一只女人的鞋里摸牌,赌的又是小注。你不会输掉衬衫的。或者你身上穿的别的什么行头。

text: These things happen.
translation: 这种事在所难免。

text: These three are pretty clear, actually - they'll allow me to set an alarm to wake me.
translation: 其实这三个相当明白——它们能让我设定闹钟，到点叫醒我。

text: These were the years I drifted fleshless through the Bounds, thin as rain, empty as a soap-bubble. The bright places of the Bel Ilai, the labhites' hunting-grounds, the sluggish silver sea. And I was cold - I was always cold - until I found my way back to warmth at the [[Stag Door]].
translation: 那些年，我作为无躯之魂漂荡在边境，稀薄如雨水，空洞如肥皂泡。我游历了贝·伊莱的明亮之地，狻猊的猎场，以及凝滞的银色海洋。我感到寒冷——始终感到寒冷——直到我在[[牡鹿之门]]寻得回归温暖的道路。

text:
These were the years I drifted fleshless through the Bounds, thin as rain, empty as a soap-bubble...

Recall <link="mypastviaticum">My Past: Viaticum, the Bounds, 1942-1946 (?)</link>
translation:
那些年月里，我无形无体地漂过边界之地，瘦如雨丝，空如肥皂泡……

追忆 <link="mypastviaticum">我的过去：临终圣餐，边界之地，1942-1946年（？）</link>

text: Thessaloniki
translation: 塞萨洛尼基

text: They are of course very welcome in this café.
translation: 他们在这家咖啡馆，当然非常受欢迎。

text: They begin to relax around me. Although Leopold remains watchful.
translation: 他们开始在我面前放松下来。尽管利奥波德依旧警觉。

text: They catch on quick, the authorities!
translation: 当局学得真快！

text: They certainly do.
translation: 他们确实如此认为。

text: They invoked the [[Witch-and-Sister]] to help in drawing the [[Worms]] from me. Which is still strange. The Witch unites, not divides.
translation: 他们曾祈请[[双生巫女]]相助，把[[蠕虫]]从我体内抽出。这至今仍让我费解。女巫主合，不主分。

text: They remember, the night observes; they remember.
translation: 它们还记得,夜在旁观;它们还记得。

text: They tell a story in Brancrug, where once I was priest, about twins who came across the sea, from the West.
translation: 布兰库格——我曾在那边做过神父——流传着一个故事,说的是渡海而来的孪生姐妹,来自西方。

text: They used to call Spencer 'the best-dressed man in the Suppression Bureau'.
translation: 他们过去称斯宾塞为「防剿局里穿着最讲究的人」。

text: They were lovely. I'd like to hear more.
translation: 它们很美。我想多听一些。

text: They were very different, those days. Sometimes good. Always different.
translation: 那些日子大不一样。有时很好。但总是不同。

text: They're wrong, basically.
translation: 他们错了,基本上。

text: They've kept this cicatrix under control, but it doesn't look as if it's getting any better. Likely it discolours the wallpaper, inside. Residents often develop sympathetic marks of their own.
translation: 他们把这处疤痕控制住了，但它看起来并没有好转的迹象。屋里大约连墙纸都被染变了色。住户们身上往往也会长出相应的印记。

text: Thief of Sights
translation: 窃景者

text: Think of myself as a physician
translation: 就当作自己是名医生

text: Think of myself as a priest
translation: 就当作自己是名神父

text: Think of myself as a priest/exorcist
translation: 就当作自己是名牧师或驱灵师。

text: Thinking what?
translation: 在想什么？

text: Third Republic Passport (Endorsed)
translation: 第三共和国护照（已签注）

text: Third Republic Passport (Invalid)
translation: 第三共和国护照（已失效）

text: Third class: five hundred francisques for two tickets, two hundred and fifty each.
translation: 三等座:两张票五百枚法兰西斧币,每张二百五十。

text: Thirty years ago in Brancrug, I met a man who called himself a signaire. Not a true adept - but he knew some tricks. Enough to break the laws of the world and the Church, doing little works among the people.
translation: 三十年前,在布兰库格,我遇见一个自称符师的人。算不上真正的修士——但他会些门道。足以违犯尘世与教会的律法,在百姓中间做些小小的法术。

text: Thirza Blake, Seventh Librarian of Hush House, used this bracingly practical rite to ease her joint pains and the stomach cramps caused by her ceaseless enthusiasm for apples.
translation: 噤声居屋第七任馆长瑟莎·布莱克用这套极为实用、令人精神一振的仪式缓解关节疼痛，以及她因永不停歇地热爱苹果而造成的胃痉挛。

text: Thirza's Renewal
translation: 瑟莎之复新

text: This Nina - what does she look like?
translation: 这位尼娜——她长什么样?

text: This again...
translation: 又是这套……

text: This appears to be in order, Monsieur Hobson. Unless there was something else?
translation: 这份证件看起来没有问题，霍布森先生。还有别的事吗？

text: This can't be a coincidence.
translation: 这不可能是巧合。

text: This document would be satisfactory... except that you told me, earlier, that your name was [q=alias.last]. This is an entirely different name.
translation: 这份文件本来可以通过……可您先前告诉我，您的姓是[q=alias.last]。这上面完全是另一个名字。

text: This entity is dormant - or its attention is elsewhere.
translation: 这个存在正处于沉眠——或者说,它的注意力在别处。

text: This envelope is heavily creased: I stuffed it down behind the seat cushion to ensure its contents weren't stolen while I napped.
translation: 这信封皱得厉害：我把它塞进座垫底下，免得打盹时里面的东西被人偷走。

text: This gold-and-grey divided city has suffered - but it's not like anywhere else now. Poor dying Europe is going out in style.
translation: 这座金灰交织、被撕裂的城市饱经苦难——但如今,它已不同于任何别处。可怜又垂死的欧洲,正在华丽地退场。

text: This is a Rite. it works the same way as any other Recipe, but it'll reduce [[Troubles]] and provide a small random benefit. Some Rites are less safe and may increase other [[Troubles]]. The description will warn you.
translation: 这就是仪典。它的运作方式与其他配方并无二致，但会减少[[烦扰]]，并带来一点随机的益处。有些仪典不那么安全，可能会增加其他[[烦扰]]。描述里会提醒你。

text: This is a battleship-grey safe of Incorporate manufacture, solid as a continent, gleaming dully in the dimness. A safe like this opens only to the correct combination, or with the correct application of explosives.
translation: 这是一台集团出产的军舰灰保险柜,坚固如大陆,在昏暗中泛着暗哑的微光。这样的保险柜,只有正确的密码组合才能打开,或者恰当地使用炸药。

text: This is a bookshop. Reach for a quotation.
translation: 这里是书店。那就伸手摘一句引文吧。

text: This is a crafting venue. Crafting is one of the more complicated bits of the game, and you might want to come back once you've gathered a few Memories and Influences. But it's up to you.
translation: 这里是一处炼制场所。炼制是游戏里较为复杂的环节之一,你或许想等攒下几段回忆与影响之后再来。不过,由你决定。

text: This is a crafting venue. Crafting is one of the more complicated parts of the game. You might want to come back once you've played more of the tutorial and gathered some Memories and Influences. But it's up to you.
translation: 这里是炼制场所。炼制是游戏中较为复杂的部分之一。等你玩过更多教程、收集到一些回忆与影响之后,不妨再回来。不过,一切由你决定。

text: This is a dream, is it not? How are you here?
translation: 这是一场梦，不是吗？你怎么会在这里？

text: This is a generous overpayment! {0}{1} for {0}{2}. Sure?
translation: 这是一次慷慨的溢付!以 {0}{1} 换取价值 {0}{2} 的货物,确定?

text: This is a good message. Spencer can enter the country because he is a nice boy.
translation: 这是一条好消息。斯宾塞可以入境,因为他是个好孩子。

text: This is a place of healing and refuge, M. Hobson. A house of science.
translation: 这是处疗愈与庇护之所,霍布森先生。一栋科学的宅邸。

text: This is a tiny quantity of uzult - one of the Great Inks, the encausta terminalia. The elect of the great libraries - one of them [[Hush House]] - could write determinations of [[History]] in these inks, and the [[Hours]] might choose to take notice...
translation: 这是一小份乌祖尔特——大墨之一,终末彩墨。大图书馆中的遴选者——其中之一便是[[噤声居屋]]——曾以这些墨水书写[[历史]]的裁定,而[[司辰]]们或许会选择留意……

text: This is a wound and a door. Skolekosophy and Nyctodromy will find uses here.
translation: 这是一道伤口,也是一扇门。蠕虫学与夜游术,在这里大有用武之地。

text: This is becoming tiresome. I'm not a man you want to cross. Take me to the Director.
translation: 这可越来越让人生厌了。我可不是你想招惹的人。带我去见院长。

text: This is embarrassing: you've sold so many items that the merchant has run out of cash! Rare, but it happens. If you travel to another city and return, they'll have refilled their till.
translation: 这就尴尬了：你卖掉了太多东西，商人的现金已经见底！不常见，但确实会发生。你若去另一座城市再回来，他们的钱箱已经重新填满。

text:
This is how it ends.

Current Dread: [q=dread]
translation:
一切就是这样结束的。

当前恐惧:[q=dread]

text:
This is how it ends.

Current Fascination: [q=fascination]
translation:
一切就是这样结束的。

当前入迷:[q=fascination]

text:
This is how it ends.

Current Pain: [q=pain]
translation:
一切就是这样结束的。

当前痛苦:[q=pain]

text: This is in order. You may go about your business, monsieur. Unless there was something else?
translation: 证件没有问题。您可以去办自己的事了，先生。还有别的事吗？

text: This is not the Republic. Your papers are worthless.
translation: 这里不是共和国。你的证件一文不值。

text: This is one of the privileges for which I pay my little surcharge to Dr Aubière. As I said, I hope the matter will remain between us. I wouldn't want to provoke unseemly jealousy.
translation: 这正是我付那笔小小费用给奥比埃医生换来的特权之一。如我所说,我希望此事止于你我之间。我可不想招来不合时宜的嫉妒。

text: This is our chance. Come on, Vincent.
translation: 机会来了。走,文森特。

text: This is our last-resort find sanitarium if all else fails: secure route into 'just keep annoying Léon.'
translation: 如果其他所有寻找疗养院的方法都行不通，那这就是我们最后的法子了——‘一直骚扰莱昂。’

text: This is perhaps a very old pyx. Or, one source has it, a reliquary - with a relic perhaps of St Galileo himself. In any case it has proven difficult to open. I am reluctant to damage it.
translation: 这或许是一只年代极古的圣体盒。又或者,据某处记载,是一具圣物匣——内中或许藏着圣伽利略本人的遗物。无论如何,它始终难以开启。我不忍将其损坏。

text: This is really good.
translation: 真好吃。

text: This is the Sanctioned Version of the Book of Suns. A little unusual. The Received Version is more common on the continent. But the Sanctioned Version, with its message of the Sun's approaching rebirth, is more optimistic. Perhaps the priest here hopes to uplift his flock.
translation: 这是《太阳之书》的钦定版。多少有些不同寻常。欧陆上更常见的是通行版。但钦定版传达着太阳临近重生的讯息,更为乐观。或许这里的教士是想提振他的信众。

text: This is the State, Aristide.
translation: 这就是邦国,阿里斯蒂德。

text: This is the altar I once served...
translation: 这是我曾侍奉过的祭坛……

text: This is the dream that sets its teeth in the neck's nape to drag what is left through the snow to the hollow place. It is too long. It ends.
translation: 这是那种将牙齿咬进后颈、把残躯拖过雪地、拖向那凹陷之处的梦。它太长了。该结束了。

text: This is the first night I've spent here. Unless I move on tomorrow, I might attract attention. [Spencer won't gain a [[Trace]] in his first night anywhere.]

text: This is the work of the visionary they called the Magyar. It used to be one of the treasures of Hush House. I saw it there when I visited as a priest in the local parish - above the fireplace in the Westcott Room. It's safer to hang it above a fireplace - to keep the influences from threading their way into the dreams of the locals.
translation: 这是那位被称作“马扎尔人”的幻视者之作。它曾是噤声居屋的珍藏之一。当年我以本地教区神父的身份造访时,正是在那里见过它——在韦斯科特厅的壁炉上方。把它挂在壁炉上方更稳妥——免得那些影响丝丝缕缕,渗入本地人的梦中。

text: This is the worst photograph never taken by a human being. It could be a boat. It could be a pig. It could be the inside of a pig. It could be the inside of a pig inside a boat. It could, in fact, be a photograph taken not by a human at all, but by a pig, perhaps from inside another pig.
translation: 这是从未被人类拍过的最糟糕的照片。它可能是一条船。可能是一头猪。可能是猪的肚子。可能是船里一头猪的肚子。事实上，它可能根本不是人类拍的，而是一头猪拍的，也许还是从另一头猪的肚子里拍的。

text:
Through your [[Signs]] and [[Passions]], you express the fundamental [[Principles]] underlying all things... which in practical terms means you can spend pips from your Pool to force a success on a [[Skill]] test that you fail.

You can only do this with [[Skills]] that match the [[Aspect]] points you're using.

If your Aspect Pool is depleted, then acting with the grain of a [[Sign]] or [[Passion]] will refresh one or more matching pips.
translation:
通过你的[[印记]]与[[激情]]，你表达着万物之下的根本[[准则]]……而在实际操作上，这意味着你可以消耗性相池中的点数，在[[技艺]]检定失败时强行使其成功。

你只能对与所用[[性相]]相符的[[技艺]]这样做。

若你的性相池已耗尽，那么顺应[[印记]]或[[激情]]行事，将补充一个或多个相应的点数。

Now, the cracks spread! The egg leaks until the shell is empty. But to my friends, somehow it is not so clear.

translation: 我们站在站台上。我们身后,砖墙上有一道暗色的水渍,大致呈长方形,和门一般高,是水管漏水渗出来的。

text:
We've been watching you over the garden wall
For hours.
The sky is darkening like a stain,
Something is going to fall like rain
And it won't be flowers.
translation:
我们越过花园围墙注视你
已有多时。
天空正像污渍一样变暗,
有什么东西要像雨一样落下
而那不会是花朵。

translation: 我们已为你的报告生成了一个唯一 ID：

translation: 我们素未谋面。但她握有我需要的情报。

translation: 穿上此行头

translation: 倦怠

translation: 倦怠昏厥
