translation: 天气工厂

text: Welcome, then!
translation: 那就欢迎你了!

text: Well - perhaps we could let this pass, this once -
translation: 呃——也许这一次,我们可以就当没发生过——

text: Well, I can almost hear the night saying, does anything? It has a point. I'd better hurry.
translation: 唔,我几乎能听见夜色在问:万事万物,当真有所不同吗?它说得有道理。我最好快些。

text: Well, I pay a small surcharge. This is the world we live in, Mr Hobson. I trust the matter will remain between us. I wouldn't want to provoke unseemly envy.
translation: 嗯,我付了一笔小小的额外费用。我们活在这个世道里,霍布森先生。我相信此事会止于你我之间。我可不想招来不合时宜的艳羡。

text: Well, Nina has left us, that much you must know. The Director dreams brightly of why. Would you walk in his dreams, then? To learn of her fate? If you offer me what I must have?
translation: 唔,尼娜离开了我们,这一点你必定知晓。至于缘由,院长梦得澄亮。那么,你可愿意走进他的梦里?去探知她的命运?只要你给我,我必需之物?

text: Well, anything can be made interesting.
translation: 唔,任何事都能变得有趣。

text: Well, anything might be interesting.
translation: 唔,任何事都可能有趣。

text: Well, everything is long ago, since the Wars.
translation: 唉,自大战以来,一切都已很遥远了。

text: Well, have it your own way, you thin scrap of flesh. Stay there in your shadowy muck. We can speak at this distance, like travellers by night. But tell me then, first, what I am.
translation: 好吧,随你的便,你这片单薄的肉。就待在你那阴翳的烂泥里吧。隔着这个距离,我们照样可以交谈,就像夜行的旅人。那么,先告诉我,我是什么。

text: Well, if there's something you want, I am here.
translation: 「那么,如果您想要点什么,我就在这里。」

text: Well, look around. Everyone's had a rough time. You live with it, or you go under.
translation: 瞧瞧四周吧。谁都不容易。要么忍受，要么沉沦。

text: Well, okay.
translation: 行吧,随你。

text: Well, she did say you were a traitor. And a defiler of husbands. So...
translation: 唔,她确实说你是个叛徒。还说你专勾引有妇之夫。所以……

text: Well, then. I didn't tell you everything before.
translation: 「那好吧。先前,我没有把一切都告诉您。」

text: Well, we cannot choose where we are born. [A snuffle of hilarity.] Let me see.
translation: 唉，人没法选择自己出生在哪里。[他忍俊不禁地哼了一声。] 让我看看。

text: Well, we have an arrangement, he and I. I have very specific requirements, d'y'see? Creature comforts and so forth. I pay a small surcharge to the doctor, to ensure my requirements are fulfilled. He has asked me to be discreet about our arrangement. But the surcharge has grown less small of late. It has been troubling me, Mr Hobson.
translation: 我与他有份约定,霍布森先生。我有一些很特别的要求,你明白吧?起居上的舒适之类。我向医生付一笔小小的额外费用,好让我的要求得到满足。他请我对这份约定守口如瓶。可近来那笔费用已不那么「小小」了。这让我颇为不安,霍布森先生。

text: Well, you did keep dropping our tickets.
translation: 唔,你刚才可是不停地掉票。

text: Well-Groomed
translation: 仪表整洁

text: Well.
translation: 唔。

text: Well. Hurry up about it.
translation: 好吧。快些了结。

text: Well...
Well... I know an omen when I see one.
translation: 嗯……看见预兆的时候，我总认得出来。

text: Well... don't tell anyone I told you. But you need to talk to Andrée, the bookseller.
translation: 呃……别说是我告诉你的。但你得去找安德烈，那位书商。

text: Well... good.
translation: 好吧……很好。

text: Well... perhaps it is so.
translation: 好吧……也许确实如此。

text: Well... we do have something. If you're desperate. But I will be honest. It is sock juice.
translation: 嗯……我们倒是有一样东西。要是您实在没办法。不过我跟您说实话：那是袜子汁。

text: Well?
translation: 怎么样?

text: Well? No, no, not for some time now. Thank you for asking.
translation: 还好吗?不,不,已经有些日子不好了。谢谢您关心。

text: Well? What book?
translation: 「哦?什么书?」

text: Welland was a Forge-[[long]] with military inclinations - a member of the Society of the Noble Endeavour who were often alchemists and generals, British royalists. What was he doing in Atlanta in 1865? And why does he feature in Aubière's dream?
translation: 韦兰是一位有军人倾向的铸之[[长生者]]——“高尚事业社”的成员，该社中人多为炼金术士与将军，是英国的保皇党人。1865 年，他在亚特兰大做什么？又为何会出现在奥比埃的梦中？

text: Welland, Welland...
translation: 韦兰，韦兰……

text: Welll then! This isn't Monaco. The sabot is our very own Philomèle's very own slipper.
translation: 好吧好吧！这儿可不是摩纳哥。这只木鞋，正是我们菲洛梅尔自己的拖鞋。

text: Weren't you dead? What are you doing here?
translation: 你不是死了吗?你在这儿做什么?

text: West from Genoa to the Côte d'Azur, then to Marseille, Montpellier, Béziers. It's due next in the city of Mimata, in the wild mountains of Lozère.
translation: 自热那亚向西至蔚蓝海岸,再到马赛、蒙彼利埃、贝济耶。下一场演出定在洛泽尔蛮荒群山中的米玛塔城。

text: Westcott's Vapours
translation: 韦斯科特之蒸气

text: Westergren, the Lantern-long that at the Bureau we used to call the Diarist. As I recall, we were hunting Westergren back in the Twenties - but someone else got to him first.
translation: 韦斯特格伦,那个灯之长生者,防剿局过去叫他「日记人」。我记得,二十年代我们就在追捕韦斯特格伦——但有人先一步得手了。

text: Western omelette, coming up.
translation: 西式蛋卷,这就来。

text: What don't I want?
translation: 我不想要什么？

text: What I saw as an exorcist's assistant, and then the priest of an unusual parish, led me to question my faith - and I left the [[Church]] shortly afterwards. From 1919 to 1921, Spencer was a priest of the Church Solar. Ordination marks the phost - the luminous element of the soul - permanently. So he can still technically perform the sacraments, though he might be breaking Church law.
translation: 作为驱魔师的助手、后来又担任一个不寻常教区的神父,我所目睹的一切让我开始质疑自己的信仰——不久之后,我便离开了[[教会]]。 1919 年至 1921 年间,斯宾塞曾任太阳教会的神父。圣职授任会永久地烙下福斯特——灵魂中发光的部分。因此,严格说来,他仍能主持圣礼,尽管这可能触犯教会的法规。

text: What I'd been taught, and what I learnt, didn't fit together.
translation: 别人教我的，与我亲身领会的，对不上。

text: What a lot of tripe psychiatrists talk.
translation: 精神病医生净说些废话。

text: What acttually counts as actually human these days anyway
translation: 如今，究竟什么才算得上是真正的凡类呢。

text: What are my options?
translation: 我有哪些选择？

text: What are you -
translation: 你这是——

text: What are you doing?
translation: 你在干什么？

text: What are you talking about? Let go of me, you scoundrel!
translation: 你在胡说什么?放开我,你这无赖!

text: What can I say? It's a habit. Interested?
translation: 我能说什么呢?习惯罢了。感兴趣?

text: What charming money you have, [q=alias.formal].
translation: 你的钱可真讨喜,[q=alias.formal]。

text: What did you have in mind?
translation: 「您想要什么?」

text: What did you say to me?
translation: 你刚才对我说什么?

text: What do I want?
translation: 我想要什么？

text: What do you have here?
translation: 您这儿都有些什么？

text: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思?

text: What do you mean? That it isn't the twentieth century everywhere?
translation: 你什么意思?难道不是处处都在二十世纪?

text: What do you mean? That it isn't the twentieth century where you're standing?
translation: 你什么意思?难道你站着的地方,不在二十世纪?

text: What do you think of Dr Aubière?
translation: 你觉得奥比埃医生怎么样?

text: What do you think?
translation: 你觉得呢？

text: What does Spencer call Medea?
translation: 斯宾塞如何称呼美狄亚？

text: What does he look like?
translation: 他长什么样?

text: What does that mean?
translation: 那是什么意思?

text: What else can an educated man with no useful skills do for a living? Investigative journalism; book reviews; pseudonymous fiction; plays no one would perform. As a writer, I made a lot of the wrong kind of friends. Good times. From 1921-25, Spencer worked as a journalist and private inquiry agent.
translation: 一个受过教育、却无一技之长的男人,还能靠什么谋生?调查报道;书评;化名小说;没人愿意上演的剧本。 作为作家,我结交了许多不该结交的朋友。快活的日子。 1921 年至 1925 年间,斯宾塞做过记者,也当过私人调查员。

text: What else?
translation: 还有呢?

text: What exactly is Nina's connection with the circus?
translation: 尼娜与这马戏团究竟有何关联?

text: What ghastly imaginations those bishops had.
translation: 那些主教们,想象力何等可怖。

text: What happened? How was it different from what you expected?
translation: 发生了什么？它与你预期的有什么不同？

text: What in Heaven's... get out!
translation: 天哪……出去!

text: What interested me most? That a certain key component of the Lark came, at last, to [[Alexandria]], where [[Serena]] and her protegée put it to use.
translation: 我最感兴趣的是什么?是百灵鸟的某个关键部件,最终辗转到了[[亚历山大港]],被[[塞蕾娜]]和她的门生派上了用场。

text: What is Nina thinking?
translation: 宁娜在想什么？

text: What is his name?
translation: 他叫什么名字？

text: What is it?
translation: 什么事?

text: What is shaped, may be shattered, especially where battle has branded the skin of the world.
translation: 凡被塑成者，皆可被击碎，尤其在战斗已经烙伤世界皮肤的地方。

text: What is she to you, Hobson?
translation: 她与你有什么关系,霍布森?

text: What is that in your hand?
translation: 你手里拿的是什么？

text: What is wrong with you, exactly? Can I catch it from you?
translation: 你到底怎么了?会传染吗?

text: What is...
translation: 这是什么……

text: What it is. [Bessy nods, smiling, humming.]
translation: 就是这么回事。[贝茜点点头,笑着,哼着歌。]

text: What it is.
translation: 就是这么回事。

text: What kind of circus is it?
translation: 这是什么样的马戏团?

text: What kind of work is this, madame? Is it, after all, a signaire that you want?
translation: 这是什么活计,夫人?说到底,你要的是一位符师吧?

text: What moves, hungers.
translation: 凡运动者，皆会饥饿。

text: What of it?
translation: 那又怎样？

text: What on Earth is going on with your arm?
translation: 您的胳膊到底是怎么回事?

text: What price would you accept to take me into the doctor's dream?
translation: 要什么代价,你才肯带我进入医生的梦境?

text: What questions?
translation: 「什么问题?」

text: What safeguards would you offer to take me into the doctor's dream?
translation: 带我进入医生的梦境,你能给出什么保障?

text: What shall we talk about today?
translation: 我们今天聊点什么?

text: What should we call you, Monsieur The Authorities? What alias are you using today to terrorise the innocent working men of Antibes?
translation: 我们该怎么称呼您，当局先生？今天您又用哪个化名，来吓唬昂蒂布无辜的工人们？

text: What the hell is this? Toothpaste?
translation: 这算什么玩意儿？牙膏？

text: What was Nina doing here?
translation: 尼娜在这里做什么?

text: What was it you wanted?
translation: 您想要什么来着?

text: What was that bit with the cat?
translation: 那只猫是怎么回事？

text: What was the destiny of Strathcoyne's cigars?
translation: 斯特拉斯科因的雪茄,命运如何?

text: What was the rest?
translation: 那剩下的是什么？

text: What we find behind a mirror
translation: 我们在镜后寻到之物

text: What you are, not what you do. It's about breeding.
translation: 看你是什么样的人，而不是你做了什么。关乎出身教养。

text: What you hope to achieve, and what your next steps are to achieve it. A guide to where to go and what to do.
translation: 你希望达成什么,以及为达成它而采取的下一步。一处指引——该去哪里,该做什么。

text: What's everyone talking about?
translation: 大家在谈论什么？

text: What's in it?
translation: 里面是什么？

text: What's next?
translation: 接下来做什么？

text: What's the game?
translation: 怎么玩？

text: What's this? You prince! How spontaneous of you!
translation: 这是什么？您这位王子！您可真是随性！

text: What's... where are we, chef?
translation: 这是……我们这是到哪儿了,头儿?

text: What... what was I saying?
translation: 我……我刚才说到哪了？

text: What?
translation: 什么？

text: What? No, I don't understand the joke at all. But I liked the accents. He does good accents, our [q=alias.familiar]!
translation: 什么?不,这笑话我压根没懂。但我喜欢那些口音。他学口音学得真好,咱们的[q=alias.familiar]!

text: What? The [[Cross]]-change? Pray do not distress yourself, Mr Hobson. I have waited a great many years for it to begin.
translation: 什么?[[介壳种]]蜕变?请不要为此不安,霍布森先生。我等它开始,已经等了漫长的岁月。

text: What??
translation: 什么？？

text: Whatever passes in front of this mirror, it displays only a shoulder of black rock between a scattering of snow. Sight, sense, and light are all sometime casualties of the Wars.
translation: 无论什么东西从这面镜子前经过,它都只映出散雪之间的一道黑岩山肩。视觉、感官与光,都曾是战争的罹难者。

text: Whatever you say, Mister Hobson.
translation: 您怎么说都行,霍布森先生。

text:
When I came back to Europe after the war, my heart told me I should seek out Nina Lagasse: actress, artist, witch. She'll know where I can find the things I need to fill my emptiness again.

	Nina is notoriously elusive, but I've followed her trail from Alexandria - where they brought me back - to Antibes - where I now arrive -
translation:
战争结束后我回到欧洲，我的心告诉我，应该去找尼娜·拉加斯：演员、艺术家、女巫。她会知道我在哪里能找到重新填补空虚的东西。

	尼娜素以行踪难觅著称，但我一路追着她的踪迹，从亚历山大港——他们把我送回的地方——追到昂蒂布——如今我抵达的地方——

text: When I look up at the blood on the sun, the pallor of the sky, when I think about what's been lost...
translation: 当我仰望太阳上的血色、天空的苍白，当我想到那些已经失去的东西……

text:
When I was coming up from Alexandria, they'd dynamited the pass at Ras en-Naqura, and I had to slip across the border in a Cypriot smuggler's jeep. The Cypriot got drunk enough to tell me he was running guns for an outfit called the Office of Onteiric Coordination - a covert limb of the [[Incorporate]] government with a mandate to shape history.

That was the first time I heard the name; but not the last.
translation:
我从亚历山大港北上的时候，他们在纳库拉角炸毁了山口，我只好坐着一辆塞浦路斯走私者的吉普车，趁夜溜过边境。那塞浦路斯人喝得烂醉，醉到肯对我说，他在为一个名叫「冥合办公室」的组织走私军火——那是[[集团]]政府的一只隐秘手臂，带着塑造历史的指令。

那是我第一次听到这个名字；但绝不是最后一次。

text: When I was last in the world, half the occult demimonde believed the [[Vagabond]] would soon rise in Pilgrimage to the [[Glory]]... but I knew well enough not to get involved.
translation: 我上一次在世时,隐秘的地下世界有半数人都相信,[[浪游旅人]]即将起身,踏上前往[[辉光]]的巡礼……但我心里清楚,不该卷进去。

text: When I was priest in [[Brancrug]], I sometimes saw Christopher Illopoly in his rooms in [[Hush House]] - to argue about theology and drink his horrible burdock tea. I saw it there, I think...
translation: 我在[[布兰库格]]任神父时,偶尔会去[[噤声居屋]]的房间拜访克里斯托弗·伊洛波利——为争论神学,也为喝他那难以下咽的牛蒡茶。我想,我就是在那里见过它……

text: When I was priest in [[Brancrug]], I sometimes saw Christopher Illopoly in his rooms in [[Hush House]] - to argue about theology and drink his horrible burdock tea. I saw it there.
translation: 我在[[布兰库格]]任神父时,偶尔会去[[噤声居屋]]的房间拜访克里斯托弗·伊洛波利——为争论神学,也为喝他那难以下咽的牛蒡茶。我就是在那里见过它。

text: When I was young and foolish, I tried to find the Roost where the Aviforms exchanged their secret gossip. I'm very glad I failed.
translation: 我年轻时又笨又莽，曾试图找到鸟形诸司辰交换秘闻的栖木。我很庆幸自己失败了。

text: When I've convinced Nina to help me... then I can leave.
translation: 等我劝动尼娜来帮我……那时我才能离开。

text: When I've spent the day as my outer self, I don't dream about it.
translation: 当我以「外在的我」度过一整天，便不会梦见它。

text: When first I came in, you said that I reminded you of someone you knew long ago...
translation: 我进门时,您说我想起您很久以前认识的一个人……

text: When he and I made the arrangement to supply my special requirements, Mr Hobson. This is the world we live in; but it is not an arrangement that an honest man would have offered me.
translation: 就在我与他就供应我的特别要求达成约定之时,霍布森先生。我们活在这个世道里;可这不是一个诚实的人会给我的约定。

text: When one's suitcase has been confiscated, tailor subverted, or laundry pre-empted...
translation: 当行李箱被没收、裁缝被策反，或者洗衣计划被别人抢先一步时……

text: When the Bureau still mattered a damn.
translation: 在防剿局还值得一提的那个年头。

text: When the Sun's House is quiet
translation: 当太阳居屋静谧时

text: When the [[Enemy]] was in Paris, Reinhardt wrote this. They had little affection for swing, the Enemy. So Reinhardt was careful. So this isn't precisely swing...
translation: [[敌人]]在巴黎时,莱因哈特写了这首。敌人对摇摆乐没什么好感。所以莱因哈特很小心。所以这首并不算是严格的摇摆乐……

text: When the feast of the Sun's Resurrection came to Brancrug, the rectory was still cold - those old stone walls, thick as a castle's - and with no housekeeper, I had to lay my own fire. But the spring sunlight was warm, so I liked to go down and take my lunch in the Sweet Bones. Hot potato pasty or a slice of starygazy pie. And the strangest conversations at the corner tables.
translation: 当太阳复活节降临布兰库格时，教区住宅里依旧寒意逼人——那些古老的石墙厚重得宛如城堡一般。又没有管家照料，我只得亲手生火取暖。不过，春日的阳光已经暖和起来，所以我总喜欢走到甜美的骨头吃午餐。一份热腾腾的土豆馅饼，或是一块仰望星空派。还有角落餐桌旁，那些最离奇古怪的交谈。

translation: 是的。他在凯尔伊苏姆。

text: Yes. I enjoyed her talent for stripes.
translation: 是的。我很欣赏她那手条纹功夫。

text: Yes. I have questions that need answering.
translation: 是的。我有几个问题需要答案。

text: Yes. I often pass them on my constitutional walk. 'Janvier,' I say to myself. 'These are bad times. I had never expected to outlive any city that I called home.'
translation: 是啊。我常常在散步时从它们旁边经过。「雅维埃,」我对自己说,「这是艰难的时世。我从未想过,自己会活得比我称之为家的每一座城市都久。」

text: Yes. I suggest you tell me the truth, Doctor.
translation: 是。我劝你把真相告诉我,医生。

text: Yes. I'm on the way to becoming something greater.
translation: 是的。我正走在通往更伟大的路上。

text: Yes. Irregular, even. But though I wish to help, I must account for my actions. If I am asked why I shared this information - then if I can say that I needed your expertise - it will go easier for us both.
translation: 是的，甚至可以说是不合常规。但即便我愿意相助，也必须为自己的行为负责。若有人问起我为何泄露这些信息——那时，我若能说，我需要你的专业——对我们俩都会好办些。

text: Yes. It has holes in it, for instance.
translation: 是的。比如，它上面有洞。

text: Yes. Please respect my privacy.
translation: 是的。请尊重我的隐私。

text: Yes. The sun is not what it was...
translation: 是的。太阳已不是从前的太阳……

text: Yes. There's something I need from her.
translation: 是的。我有样东西要从她那儿得到。

text: Yes. They're mismatched - one aquamarine, one a jewel-bright violet. They lack pupils, but the wide-eye effect and the vivid colours make Reparata look alert, watchful, knowing.
translation: 睁着。而且并不相称——一只海蓝宝石色,一只宝石般明艳的紫罗兰色。它们没有瞳孔,但那瞪圆的眼形与鲜明的色彩,让雷帕拉塔看起来警觉、机敏、洞悉一切。

text: Yes. This. Exactly. So I am going to tell you where I will find your Lagasse. And I hope that you will no longer trouble my affairs.
translation: 是的。正是。正因如此,我打算告诉你到哪儿去找你的拉加斯。希望从今往后,你不再搅扰我的事务。

text: Yes. To his memory.
translation: 是的。敬他的在天之灵。

text: Yes. What are they?
translation: 是的。它们是什么？

text: Yes. What walked only in the night, walks in the daylight.
translation: 是的。只在夜里游荡的东西，如今在白昼行走。

text: Yes. Wiser not to discuss her, even during daylight. And especially not to mention her name.
translation: 是的。明智的做法是不要谈起她,哪怕是在白天。尤其不要提起她的名字。

text: Yes. Yes! It is a pact now. Our pact.
translation: 好。好!如今这便是约定了。我们的约定。

text: Yes. Yes, I did. But it's been... ten years? More? You look very different. But not so very much older.
translation: 是的。是的,我们见过。但那已是……十年前?或许更久?您看起来判若两人。不过,倒也没老太多。

text: Yes. Yes. I only wish I could see her when the pain begins.
translation: 好。好。我只盼疼痛开始的时候,我能亲眼看着她。

text: Yes...
translation: 是啊……

text: Yes: I do also deal in a quieter business than books.
translation: 「是的:我确实还做着一桩比卖书更安静的生意。」

text: Yes; I must confess that I am. I had hoped you would be able to open the box. I did not expect you to succeed so... anticlimactically.
translation: 是的；我承认确实如此。我本指望你能打开这盒子。却没想到你成功得如此……平淡。

text: Yes?
translation: 嗯？

text: Yes? Just two blots of black lead in milky glass, with the carefully innocent vagueness of every iconographic virgin.
translation: 睁着?不过是在乳白色的玻璃上,两团黑色的铅迹,带着每位圣像画中童贞女都有的、刻意为之的天真与朦胧。

text: Yes? Then listen.
translation: 是吗?那就听好。

text: Yes? Yes!
translation: 真的？太好了！

text: You are prepared to testify, if we need you later? Publicly, in court?
translation: 以后有需要时，你会出庭作证吧？公开地，在法庭上？

text: You are a signaire. You should know how these things are done. Tell him my name.
translation: 你是个符师。这种事的门道,你该明白。告诉他我的名字。

text: You are a decent man. I place my trust in your decency.
translation: 你是个正派人。我把信任托付给你的正直。

text: You are a stranger here, monsieur. You should be more careful with your threats.
translation: 「您是这里的生面孔,先生。威胁的话,还是小心些为好。」

text: You are fortunate. Three days in the week, I could not even serve you this.
translation: 您运气好。一周里有三天，我连这个都没法给您端上来。

text: You are friendlier now that Sinombre can help? Well, let's call it a change of the heart.
translation: 西诺姆布尔能帮上忙了,你就热络起来?唔,就当这是一次心的转变吧。

text: You are here
translation: 你在这里

text: You are mortal. And ignorant. Nothing you say can approach what a Lantern-long feels.
translation: 你是凡人。而且无知。你说的一切,都无从触及灯之长生者的感受。

text: You are not quite a scholar, but not quite a boor. It will do, for this sliver of day.
translation: 你算不上学者,也算不上粗人。于这一隙白昼,已然足够。

text: You are not the first fool to be snared.
translation: 你不是第一个被网住的傻瓜。

text: You are not the one I called.
translation: 你不是我召唤的人。

text: You are not the one I summoned. The signaire. Go away from here.
translation: 你不是我召来的那位。符师。离开这里。

text: You are recalling folk-tales and fairy-stories in which an animal is recruited as a spy.
translation: 你是想到了那些民间故事和童话吧,里面总有动物被招募去做探子。

text: You are religious, I see.
translation: 看得出，你信教。

text: You are right to identify a certain risk to the fragile psyche - even when we have of course discarded the esoteric myths around the symbol. But fire also is perilous, no? And we keep fire in our library. Safely behind a grate.
translation: 你说得对,要看出这对脆弱心灵的某种风险——哪怕我们当然已经摈弃了围绕这象征的神秘传说。但火也危险,不是吗?可我们照样在图书馆里生火。安安全全地待在壁炉栏栅后面。

text: You are skilled enough for this recipe… but only with Hushery in a <sprite="VenueImages" name="quietplace"> Quiet Place or <sprite="VenueImages" name="shadowedplace"> Shadowed Place
translation: 你的技艺足以应付此配方……但只有身处<sprite="VenueImages" name="quietplace">安静之地或<sprite="VenueImages" name="shadowedplace">幽暗之地施展静默术时才可。

text: You are skilled enough for this recipe… but only with {0}
translation: 你的技艺已足以炼制此配方……但仅限于{0}

text: You are speaking of the [[Cross]]-change, I suppose, Mr Hobson? What an amusing fellow you are. Perhaps you should consider a career on the stage.
translation: 你说的想必是介壳种之变吧,霍布森先生?你可真是个有趣的人。也许你该考虑去舞台上谋个前程。

text: You are teasing me now. I had thought we were friends. But it seems I am nothing to you.
translation: 你这是在戏弄我了。我原以为,我们已是朋友。可看来,我对你什么都不是。

text: You are the signaire? I am Zèlia. Do not ask my family's name.
translation: 你就是符师?我是泽莉亚。不要问我娘家的姓氏。

text: You are wise to be wary, my guttering light. But Sinombre is not what she was. Come closer, come closer, look into the scrine... and Sinombre will give you her light.
translation: 你懂得提防,是明智的,我这将熄的光。但西诺姆布尔,已不是昔日的她。走近些,再走近些,望向圣龛……西诺姆布尔会把她的光给你。

text: You asked me to get drinks for everyone here...
translation: 是你让我给在座各位端酒的……

text: You called me 'hollow of spirit and brazen of heart.' What did you mean?
translation: 您说我是「魂灵空虚,心坚如铜」。那是什么意思?

text:
You can evolve an empty [[Passion]] into any Passion you've recently acted with, as long as you have enough of the right [[Experiences]]. You can evolve existing Passions, too, but only when appropriate - Anger can evolve to Honour or Ambition, but not Compassion or Whimsy.


Evolving a Passion levels it up, and Passions can't go above 9. So you can't evolve any Passion once it's reached the max. But by the time all three Passions are at 9, you'll have a very clear idea who your Spencer is.
translation:
只要拥有足够的相应[[经验]]，你就能把空置的[[激情]]演化为任何你近来以之行动的激情。已有的激情也可以演化，但只在恰当之时——愤怒可以演化为荣誉或野心，却不能演化为悲悯或奇想。


演化激情会使其升级，而激情不能超过 9 级。所以任何激情一旦到顶，便再也无法演化。但等到三项激情都到 9 时，你的斯宾塞是个什么样的人，你心里便一清二楚了。

text: You can pay in cash, or you can offer items for barter, if you have anything the merchant's interested in. But you'll often need to top up with cash - look at the total in the barter block.
translation: 你可以付现金，也可以拿出商人感兴趣的东西来以物易物。但很多时候，你还得用现金补足差额——看看易物栏里的总数。

text: You can't stop me.
translation: 你拦不住我。

text: You can't tell me what your old friend looks like?
translation: 您连自己老朋友的长相都说不出?

text: You can't touch me now...
translation: 你现在碰不到我了……

text: You didn't act much like a priest, when we were out in Ghardaïa.
translation: 我们在加尔达亚那阵子，你可不像个神父。

text: You don't have enough of the currently selected currency to cover this purchase. Use the picker at the top to select a currency you have more of - or offer items in barter, if you have anything the merchant will accept.
translation: 你手中目前所选货币的余额不足以支付这笔交易。用顶部的选择器换一种你更充裕的货币——或者拿出物品以物易物，只要你有商人愿意收的东西。

text: You don't like Strathcoyne?
translation: 你不喜欢斯特拉斯科因?

text: You don't wonder why they're there?
translation: 您就不奇怪,它们为何会在那里?

text: You go away for a long time and return a different person - you never come all the way back.
translation: 你离开很久,回来时已是另一个人——你永远不会完全归来。

text: You great lump of dough. [But he says it softly.]
translation: 你这团大面团。[不过他说得很轻。]

text: You had your free drinks, and my business cannot wait. Let's not pretend we're family.
translation: 你已经喝过你的免费酒了,我的正事等不起。别装得我们像一家人。

text: You have a name that opens doors, Monsieur 'obson.
translation: 您有一个能开门道的名字,奥布森先生。

text: You have indeed an admirable profile, M. Hobson, but perhaps it is more suitable to admire it elsewhere.
translation: 霍布森先生，您的侧影确实令人称羡，不过，或许还是到别处去欣赏更为妥当。

text: You have my promise that I'll help you, the next time that you'll need it.
translation: 我向你承诺:下次你需要帮助之时,我会相助。

text: You have returned to pay your bill?
translation: 您是回来结账的？

text: You have something - something on - [Brush significantly at your own arm.]
translation: 您身上有什么——有什么——[意味深长地掸掸自己的胳膊。]

text: You hungry? This omelette... I think I went too far. It's really two omelettes. Maybe three. I'm going to need some help.
translation: 饿不饿?这份煎蛋卷……我觉得我摊过头了。实际上这是两份蛋卷。也许三份。我需要帮手。

text: You kept that?
translation: 那件东西,您还留着?

text: You kidding? I can't do this alone.
translation: 开什么玩笑?这种事我一个人可干不来。

text: You knew me as Spencer Hobson.
translation: 您认识的我是斯宾塞·霍布森。

text: You knew me as Sylvain Huissier.
translation: 您认识的我是西尔万·韦西耶。

text: You know Reinhardt, but you don't know 'Nuages'?
translation: 你知道莱因哈特,却不知道《云》?

text: You know Vincent?
translation: 你认识文森特?

text: You know my name?
translation: 你知道我的名字?

text: You know who I am?
translation: 你知道我是谁？

text: You know, I think that would be therapeutically unhelpful for you.
translation: 你知道吗，我倒觉得，那对你的治疗可没什么好处。

text: You know, [q=alias.familiar], in this town we call them cards.
translation: 你知道吗,[q=alias.familiar],在这镇上,我们管那叫纸牌。

text: You know. You take what you can get. Better than sleeping on the ground. Or in a barn. Or in a ditch waiting for the spidermist to get me. Or even the barracks back in Ghardaïa.
translation: 你知道的。有什么就凑合什么。总比睡在地上强。比睡在谷仓里强。也比躺在沟里等蜘蛛雾来收拾我强。甚至比加达亚军营里的日子强。

text: You like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这儿吗?

text: You may know that I'm a medical man myself. I'm concerned for her health.
translation: 你可能也知道，我自己是行医之人。我担心她的身体。

text: You may leave now, Monsieur Hobson. I very much hope that you will. Good day.
translation: 你现在可以走了,霍布森先生。我非常希望你会走。日安。

text: You mean the holes in the world?
translation: 你是说世界上的洞？

text: You mean your employer? And mine? Nothing I'd care to air. [Vincent winks.]
translation: 你是说你的雇主?也是我的?没什么我想声张的。[文森特挤挤眼。]

text: You mean, it'll cost me.
translation: 你的意思是,我得付出代价。

text: You mean, the Worms ate me, but here I am?
translation: 你是说，蠕虫吃了我，可我还在这儿？

text: You mean, you have two names? No, of course you do, that's all right, you see? That's why the saint brought you.
translation: 您是说,您有两个名字?不,您当然有,这没什么,您明白吗?正因如此,圣人才把您带来。

text: You must understand, an alienist - a physician of the psychic organs - I would prefer to say 'psychiatrist', if you are familiar with the term - is in some respects - and only in these respects - like an adept of the invisible arts -
translation: 您须明白,一位精神病学家——精神器官的医师——若您熟悉这个词,我更愿称其为“精神科医师”——在某些方面——而且仅限于这些方面——与一位隐形技艺的修士颇为相似——

text: You must. I will suffer this woman no longer.
translation: 你必须办。我再也忍受不了那个女人。

text: You need to work on your accent, Midnight Joe.
translation: 你的口音还得好好练练，午夜乔。

text: You refused the trabai. Why are you buzzing again in my ear?
translation: 你拒绝了那桩差事。为什么又在我耳边嗡嗡作响?

text: You remind me, monsieur, of a man I knew long ago. Before the Wars.
translation: 先生,您让我想起一位故人,那是我很久以前认识的。大战之前。

text: You said I would 'open her eyes'. The window? The saint? Or...
translation: 您说过,我会「睁开她的眼睛」。是那扇彩窗?是圣人?还是……

text: You said you had files on me. I'd like to see them.
translation: 你说过你手上有我的档案。我想看看。

text: You said. Stop wasting my time. The trabai first.
translation: 你说过了。别再浪费我的时间。差事要紧。

text: You see? My point exactly. We get more ignorant each time we open our mouths.
translation: 瞧见了吗？正是我的意思。我们每开口一次，就变得更无知一分。

text: You seem surprised, Doctor.
translation: 你似乎很惊讶，医生。

text: You strike me as a man who understands the value of his time. Let me put a number to that value. [20 francisques]
translation: 我看您是懂得自己时间价值的人。让我给这价值标一个数。[20 法兰西斧币]

text: You too, chef.
translation: 你也是,头儿。

text: You want me to fetch drinks for you and your friends.
translation: 你想让我给你和你的朋友端酒。

text: You wanted me to punish Philomèle. But you said 'Cornéline' just now.
translation: 你要我惩罚的是菲洛梅尔。可你方才说的是“科尔内利娜”。

text: You were a Bureau man, were you not? I used to make it my business to keep abreast of Bureau matters.
translation: 你曾是防剿局的人,对不对?从前,打探防剿局的事务是我的本分。

text: You were born in the Republic, you mean? You are a stranger in the State?
translation: 您的意思是,您生在共和国?在这邦国里,您是异乡人?

text: You were warned.
translation: 我可警告过你了。

text: You wouldn't usually walk into a greengrocer and try to sell them apples... but things are different since the Wars, and merchants are usually up for bartering, as long as you're offering something they can use or sell. Mouse over the [[Aspects]] in the Merchant Buys... block. Janvier, for instance, will buy anything tagged as Luxuries or Refinements.
translation: 你通常不会走进果蔬店，试图把苹果卖给他们……但战争以后，世道不同了，只要你能拿出他们用得上或卖得掉的东西，商人们通常都乐意以物易物。将光标移到「商人收购……」栏中的[[性相]]上。比如让维耶，任何标注为奢侈品或精制品的物品，他都收。

text: You'll be Hobson, then.
translation: 那么,你就是霍布森了。

text: You'll consider it? Consider it quickly. I have told you what I want. And how I will reward you.
translation: 你会考虑?那就快点考虑。我已经告诉你我要什么了,也告诉你我会怎么酬谢你。

text: You'll find it pretty damned therapeutically unhelpful if you don't tell me.
translation: 你要是不告诉我，你很快就会领教，那才叫对治疗毫无好处。

text: You'll have something?
translation: 您要来点什么？

text: You'll need an Ingredient for each open input slot - it has to possess all the [[Aspects]] below the slot. A flame icon means that the ingredient will be consumed as Fuel - if there's no flame, it's a Catalyst and you can reuse it.
translation: 每一个开启的输入槽位都需要一种[[原料]]——它必须拥有槽位下方列出的全部[[性相]]。火焰图标意味着该原料会被当作燃料消耗——若没有火焰，它便是催化剂，可以重复使用。

text: You'll speak more freely if I top you up with wine?
translation: 我把你的酒添满，你说话会更痛快吧？

text: You're Greek?
translation: 你是希腊人?

text: You're a Mansus-spirit. And not a well one, or you wouldn't choose to be here in the Sanitarium.
translation: 你是漫宿之灵。而且是个不健全的,否则你不会选择待在这疗养院里。

text: You're a doctor, and your patient records are confidential.... unless I crack open your puzzle-box. That's a little unusual, isn't it?
translation: 你是医生，病人的病历是保密的……除非我撬开了你的谜盒。这多少有点不寻常，不是吗？

text: You're a fulgent. A Lantern-long. A bodiless immortal of the Company of Lights...
translation: 你是一名辉耀者。灯之长生者。辉光会社中无形的不朽者……

text: You're a gentleman.
translation: 你是个正人君子。

text: You're a liar, Aubière.
translation: 你撒谎,奥比埃。

text: You're a philosopher?
translation: 您是哲学家?

text: You're an Icarian?
translation: 你是伊加利亚人?

text: You're back.
translation: 您回来了。

text: You're changing the subject... Father. [Vincent gives his chortling head-shake.] What changed?
translation: 你在岔开话题……神父大人。[文森特咯咯笑着摇了摇头。] 是什么变了？

text: You're going to America?
translation: 您要去美国?

text: You're gone from me now...
translation: 你如今,已离我而去……

text: You're looking for my favour? Well, it's yours. And to your question - I was not among the unfortunate fruiting few, in Epirus. The Plague of Leaves still spared me that.
translation: 你在求我的垂青?好吧,它归你了。至于你的问题——在伊庇鲁斯,我不在那些不幸结果的少数人之中。叶疫好歹,没让我遭那一桩。

text: You're set this item as active. Active Items work slightly differently in Travelling at Night from equipped items in most games. Mouse over the ACTIVE ITEMS header to learn more.
translation: 你已将这件物品设为活跃。在Travelling at Night中，活跃物品的运作方式与大多数游戏里的已装备物品略有不同。将光标移到「活跃物品」标题上，可了解更多。

text: You're sitting very close to those... holes.
translation: 你坐得离那些……洞太近了。

text: You're these boys' governess, I take it?
translation: 我猜，你是这帮小伙子的家庭教师？

text: You're very annoying.
translation: 你真烦人。

text: You're... American?
translation: 你是……美国人?

text: You've created something! Click to collect it. Any catalyst ingredients are also ready to be collected; any fuel ingredients have been consumed.
translation: 你制作出了某样东西！点击即可收取。催化原料也都可以收取；燃料原料则已被消耗。

text:
You've found a private place to change [[Outfits]]. You start with two: the one you stepped off the train wearing, and your dressing gown.

You're probably exhausted by now - consider resting to heal [[Troubles]]. Switch to your dressing gown in your Outfits grid, and you'll be able to sleep.

You might want to switch back to your daytime Outfit before leaving your room, although the other residents of this place are reasonably relaxed about that sort of thing.
translation:

text:
You've gained your first [[Trouble]]. This happens. Life in post-Wars Europe is awful.

[[Fascination]], [[Dread]], [[Weariness]] and [[Pain]] are reduced by sleep. You'll find somewhere to sleep in Antibes later. [[Traces]] will slowly creep up if you sleep in one place too long, but are reduced by travelling.

If you let a Trouble rise high enough, it'll start causing you problems. See the Footnote for the Trouble you just gained.

Mouse over the icons under your character portrait whenever you want to see how your Troubles are affecting you. You can also see your Trouble totals in your Inventory. (Why the Inventory? Because Troubles can also occasionally be used in Crafting.)

text:
Zachary Wakefield. Quiet, courteous, tenacious.  In those days, he was an atheist and I was not, but he would ask me to sit with him when the storms shook Hush House in autumn. They reminded him too much of artillery-fire.

Later, we were in the Suppression Bureau together. Much later, I learnt that something had invaded him, though I learnt, too, that he kept it in check better than I ever managed.

Wakefield was never a happy man. The night often reminds me gleefully how much Wakefield and I have in common.
translation:
扎卡里·韦克菲尔德。沉静、有礼、坚韧。那些年月里他是无神论者，我不是，但秋天风暴撼动[[噤声居屋]]时，他会请我陪他坐着。那风暴让他想起太多炮火。

后来，我们一起在防剿局任职。再后来，我得知有什么东西侵入了他，不过我也得知，他把它压制得比我强得多。

韦克菲尔德从来不是个快活的人。夜晚常常幸灾乐祸地提醒我，韦克菲尔德与我有多少共同之处。

translation: [虚晃一下，然后拔腿就跑。]

text: [Firmly close my mouth.]
translation: [紧紧闭上嘴。]

text: [First class] I've had it with compromises. No more compromises.
translation: [一等座]我受够将就了。不再将就。

text: [Flags. Everyone gets so excited about flags.]
translation: [旗帜。人人都为旗帜激动不已。]

text: [Flattery] I came here for a trivial reason. Now I've met you, I have a much better one.
translation: [恭维] 我来这里,本是为了一件微不足道的小事。如今遇见了你,我便有了好得多的理由。

text: [Flip through.]
translation: [翻看。]

text: [Flip.]
translation: [翻动。]

text: [Fold my arms, remain impassive.]
translation: 抱起双臂，不动声色。

text: [Follow Jaume towards the beach, until the rain lifts like a curtain.]
translation: [跟着若梅走向海滩,直到雨幕如帘卷起。]

text: [Follow Léon as far as the edge of the square... then feint sideways and make a dash for it.]
translation: [跟着莱昂走到广场边缘……然后突然向侧面虚晃一步，拔腿就跑。]

text: [Follow Léon, cheerfully.]
translation: [兴高采烈地跟着莱昂走。]

text: [Follow Léon, gloweringly.]
translation: [阴沉着脸跟莱昂走。]

text: [Forge] WE MAY ACHIEVE, the painting declares.
translation: [铸] “我们能有所成”,画作如此宣告。

text: [Frown.]
translation: [皱眉。]

text: [Funny-looking doodah.]
translation: [模样古怪的小玩意儿。]

text: [Funny. Smile.]
translation: [很好笑。微笑。]

text: [Gesture carelessly] "Bronze is the mirror of the face; wine, the mirror of the mind."
translation: [随意一挥手] 『青铜是面孔的镜子，美酒是心神的镜子。』

text: [Get out.]
translation: [出来。]

text: [Get up from the bar.]
translation: [从吧台起身。]

text: [Give a slow smile, finish my drink, and stand up.]
translation: [缓缓露出微笑,喝完杯里的酒,站起身来。]

text: [Give my full attention to the coffee.]
translation: [把全部注意力交给咖啡。]

text: [Glance through the darkened windows.]
translation: [透过昏暗的车窗瞥一眼。]

text: [Go away.]
translation: [走开。]

text: [Go back out into the rain.] It's a long way to Mimata, and I won't be able to return immediately to Antibes. Perhaps I have unfinished business here.
translation: [回到外面的雨中。]去米玛塔路途遥远,而且无法立刻返回昂蒂布。也许我在这里还有未了之事。

text: [Go.]
[Grail] It looks nothing like Nina. But somehow it reminds me of when I came here seeking her. Perhaps I just remembered the painting from that day...
translation: [杯] 它一点也不像尼娜。但不知怎的,它让我想起当初我来到这里寻她的情形。也许,我只是记起了那一天见过的那幅画……

text: [Grail] Somehow, it brings [[Nina Lagasse]] to mind...
translation: [杯] 不知怎的,它让我想起[[尼娜·拉加斯]]……

text: [Grail] Who knows? But the darkness between the trees draws me.
translation: [杯] 谁知道呢？但树丛间的黑暗吸引着我。

text: [Growl.]
translation: [低吼一声。]

text: [Grumbles inarticulately as he gathers up the cards.]
translation: [一边收牌,一边含混不清地咕哝。]

text: [Grunt vaguely.]
translation: [含糊地哼一声。]

text: [HOROMACHISTRY] 'He cannot be stilled; he demands the dance; he is beaten, like a drum.'
translation: 司辰学。「他无法静止；他渴求舞蹈；他遭人敲打，如同鼓面。」

text: [HOROMACHISTRY] 'He cannot harm you; he cannot find you; he always has what you desire.'
translation: 司辰学。「他无法伤害你；他无法找到你；他总拥有你所渴望的东西。」

text: [He scowls, but makes no attempt to snatch it. Instead he scrutinises it, eyes crinkling, lips moving slightly.]
translation: [他皱起眉,却并不来夺。他只是细看护照,眼角皱起,嘴唇微微翕动。]

text: [He scrutinises the passport, eyes crinkling, lips moving slightly. He hands it back to me.]
translation: [他细看护照,眼角皱起,嘴唇微微翕动。他把护照递还给我。]

text: [He smiles, tentatively at first, and then with a rush of surprising warmth.]
translation: 「他笑了——起初还带着试探，随即涌出一阵出人意料的暖意。」

text: [He takes a step backwards.] I...
translation: 「他向后退了一步。」我……

text: [He winces, as if I'd said something crude.]
translation: [他皱了一下眉,仿佛我说了什么粗鄙的话。]

text: [He's holding a circular box the size of a small cake-tin. A worn silver-gilt dove sits atop it.]
translation: 他捧着一只圆盒，大小如同小号蛋糕模。盒顶蹲着一只磨损的银鎏金鸽子。

text: [Her calves are furred with mosses and spotted with lichens. Beneath that, her skin is glossy, but with dashed lines and bumps, like the bark of an olive tree. Her feet are bare: below her ankles, the effect is even more marked, and her flesh has begun to curl like roots.]
translation: [她的小腿覆着苔藓的绒毛,缀着地衣的斑点。底下,她的皮肤泛着光泽,却布满断线般的纹路和隆起,像橄榄树的树皮。她赤着脚:脚踝以下,那种变化更加明显,她的血肉已开始像根须一样卷曲。]

text: [Her eyes glitter; her hands open and close.]
translation: [她眼中闪闪发光；双手张开又合拢。]

text: [High and perilous knowledge?? Show me, now!]
translation: [高深而危险的知识??现在就让我看看!]

text: [His eyes widen] I do hope that I remember this, when I am awake again.
translation: 「他睁大了眼睛」我由衷希望，等我醒来时，还能记得这一切。

text: [His face clears.] Perhaps I can.
translation: 「他面色缓和下来。」或许我可以。

text: [Hold it just out of reach.]
translation: [举在他够不着的地方。]

text: [Hold out a hand for the box.]
translation: 伸出手，向他讨要盒子。

text: [Horomachistry] 'The Cross died not, but passed within.' They're gone, but some of them became us.
translation: 司辰学。「介壳种并未死去，而是转入内里。」他们消失了，但其中一些化作了我们。

text: [I added something to Philomèle's drink. Watch and wait to see any effect.]
translation: [我在菲洛梅尔的酒里加了点什么。且看效果。]

text: [I added something to their drinks - and something more to Philomèle's. Watch and wait to see the effect.]
translation: [我在他们的酒里加了点什么——给菲洛梅尔的还额外加了料。且看效果。]

text: [I added something to their drinks. Watch and wait to see the effects.]
translation: [我在他们的酒里加了点什么。且看效果。]

text: [I could talk to Father Jaume again.]
translation: [我可以再去和若梅神父谈谈。]

text: [I don't want to show him my papers. Make a show of searching for them.]
translation: [我不想给他看证件。装模作样地翻找一阵。]

text: [I have a deck of cards that match the ones in the shoe. With a little care, I could reliably draw a winning hand. Unless I got caught.]
translation: [我有一副牌，与鞋里的那副花色一致。稍加小心，我就能稳稳抽到一手好牌。除非被当场抓包。]

text: [I have my funds tucked away somewhere safe...]
translation: [我的钱,藏在某个安全的地方……]

text: [I have no papers I'm willing to show the milicien.]
translation: [我没有愿意给这个民兵看的证件。]

text: [I hesitate. Vincent listens.]
translation: [我踌躇片刻。文森特静静听着。]

text: [I hold the big man's gaze steadily. He gnaws at the inside of his cheek, suddenly uneasy.]
translation: [我稳稳地迎上大汉的目光。他咬起脸颊内侧,忽然有些不安。]

text: [I speak of my reincorporation in [[Alexandria]], beneath the eyes of two old friends and one new.]
translation: 「我谈起自己在[[亚历山大港]]重获肉身之事——在两位旧友与一位新识的注视之下。」

text: [I speak of my time in [[Ys]] behind the wave, where they took the Worms from me.]
translation: 「我谈起自己在[[伊苏]]、海浪之后的时日——在那里，他们取走了我体内的蠕虫。」

text: [I've already learnt all I can here.]
translation: [这里我能了解的,都已了解了。]

text: [If I craft a Bewitch item before I go back to the bar... I could definitely make the drinks loosen their tongues.]
translation: [若我在回酒吧前炼制一件迷惑道具……我定能让那些酒水撬开他们的嘴。]

text: [If I craft a Wither item before I go back to the bar... this is my chance to place the curse on Philomèle that Madame Zèlia requested.]
translation: [若我在回酒吧前炼制一件凋零道具……这正是我按泽莉亚夫人的请求，向菲洛梅尔施下诅咒的机会。]

text: [If I've gathered enough information from the window... I might recall an odd folktale.]
translation: [若我已从彩窗上收集到足够的信息……我或许会想起一则奇异的民间传说。]

text: [Ignore the animal.]
translation: [别理会这只动物。]

text: [Incline my head and stay.]
translation: [微微点头,留下来。]

text: [Incline my head and withdraw.]
translation: [微微颔首，抽身退去。]

text: [Indicate her cigarette] Could you spare one of those?
translation: [指指她的香烟]「能匀我一支吗?」

text: [Inquisitive] Dreams of a... personal nature, you mean?
translation: 「探询地」你是说……私密性质的梦？

text: [Insincere] And you out here on duty? I'm sorry.
translation: [假惺惺] 你还得在这种天气里执勤？真遗憾。

text: [Interrupt] Spit it out, man.
translation: [打断] 有话直说,老兄。

text: [Into the room. The cell?]
translation: [走进房间。牢房？]

text: [Invent a name.]
translation: [编一个名字。]

text: [Ironic] We all should be grateful for the protection of our [[Incorporate]] allies against the [[Icarian]] menace.
translation: [反讽] 我们都该感激[[集团]]盟友的护佑，以御[[伊加利亚]]之患。

text: [It isn't particularly funny. Smile anyway.]
translation: [并不怎么好笑。但还是笑一笑。]

text: [It never hurts to make friends.]
translation: [交朋友总没坏处。]

text: [Join the card game.]
translation: [加入牌局。]

text: [Just smile.]
translation: 只是微笑。

text: [Just watch, silently.]
translation: [只是默默地看着。]

text: [Keep my distance.]
translation: [保持距离。]

text: [Keep my eyes on the floor. I don't want anyone to remember my face better than they have to.]
translation: [目光落在地板上。我不愿任何人把我的脸记得比必要的更清楚。]

text: [Keep my eyes on the ground; don't draw attention.]
translation: [眼睛盯着地面;别引人注意。]

text: [Keep my movements slow, moving out of town into the quieter areas of the Cap d'Antibes.]
translation: [放慢动作，离开城区，走向昂蒂布海岬较为幽静的地带。]

text: [Keep running.]
translation: [继续跑。]

text: [Knock] It has that quality. I wonder what he found there...
translation: [启] 确有那种质地。不知他在那里寻见了什么……

text: [Knock] What would they find on that mountain? The Mansus? The City Unbuilt?
translation: [启] 他们在那座山上会寻得什么？漫宿？未建之城？

text: [Knowing] Dreams of a personal nature, you mean?
translation: 「会意地」你是说，私密性质的梦？

text: [Lantern] St Michael is a favoured Name of a certain solar Hour. I remember when things were clearer. Should I pray...?
translation: [灯] 圣米迦勒是某位太阳司辰所宠爱的名。我记得世事尚属清明之时。我该祈祷吗……？

text: [Laugh.]
translation: [笑出声来。]

text: [Lean close] No more than they deserved.
translation: [凑近] 他们罪有应得。

text: [Lean forward] Tell me where Nina is. Or I'll go straight from here to the Milice to let them know about your 'quieter business'.
translation: [倾身]「告诉我尼娜在哪里。否则,我直接从这里去法国民兵那里,让他们知道你那桩“更安静的生意”。」

text: [Lean over the edge.]
translation: [探身越过边缘。]

text: [Leave it for now.]
translation: [暂且搁下。]

text: [Leave the Verdant Place alone for the moment.]
translation: [暂且别动那片青翠之地。]

text: [Leave the matter for now.]
translation: [此事暂且放下。]

text: [Leave without a word.]
translation: [一言不发地离开。]

text: [Leave, with a peremptory nod.]
translation: [不容置疑地点了点头,离开。]

text: [Leave.]
translation: [离开。]

text: [Leave]
translation: [离开]

text: [Leave].
translation: [离开]。

text: [Legal Truth] I'm English.
translation: [法律实话] 我是英国人。

text: [Leopold struggles to decide on an expression. Eventually, he grinds his teeth..]
translation: [利奥波德努力想摆出一副表情。最终，他磨了磨牙。]

text: [Let him take it.]
translation: [让他拿去。]

text: [Let the cards fall where they may - a one in five chance of winning.] 'A throw of the dice will never abolish chance!'
translation: [让牌听天由命——五分之一的机会能赢。]“骰子一掷,永远取消不了偶然!”

text: [Let's find out.]
translation: [去弄清楚。]

text: [Lie] 'Thunderskin?' I've never heard of it.
translation: 谎话。「轰雷之皮？」我从没听说过。

text: [Lie] Back to Algeria. Another engagement with the Légion.
translation: 谎话。回阿尔及利亚。再入外籍军团服役。

text: [Lie] Say rather a friendly campfire, Aristide. [Nod at his pipe.] I'll see you again.
translation: [谎话] 不如说是一堆友善的篝火,阿里斯蒂德。[朝他的烟斗点点头。] 我们还会再见。

text: [Lie] She owes me a great deal of money.
translation: [谎言] 她欠了我一大笔钱。

text: [Lie] She's an old friend. I heard she'd come here, to Antibes.
translation: [撒谎]她是我的一位老朋友。我听说她来了这里,昂蒂布。

text: [Lie] Staff.
translation: [撒谎]工作人员。

text: [Lift the Coca-Cola that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯可口可乐。]

text: [Lift the camomile tea that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯甘菊茶。]

text: [Lift the glass of pastis that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯茴香酒。]

text: [Lift the glass of red wine that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯红酒。]

text: [Lift the glass of water that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯水。]

text: [Lift the glass of white wine that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯白葡萄酒。]

text: [Lift the possibly-coffee that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯疑似咖啡。]

text: [Linou's grin becomes wolfish.]
translation: [利努的笑容变得狼性十足。]

text: [Listen to his footsteps retreat down the corridor.]
translation: [听着他的脚步沿走廊远去。]

text: [Look around.]
translation: [四下看看。]

text: [Look away.]
translation: [移开目光。]

text: [Look each of the others in the eye.]
translation: [与其余每个人目光相对。]

text: [Look for [[Nina Lagasse]]. Until you find her, 'why' is less important than 'where'.]
translation: [去寻找[[尼娜·拉加斯]]吧。在找到她之前,「为什么」不如「在哪里」重要。]

text: [Look her straight in the eye] Much better than you suggested, madame. Perhaps you have a secret recipe? But your secret is safe with me.
translation: [直视她的眼睛] 比您说的好得多，夫人。也许您有秘密配方？不过您的秘密，我会守口如瓶。

text: [Look him in the eye and wait.]
translation: 直视他的眼睛，等着。

text: [Look out across the sea. It's a beautiful day. Nothing like the drab town streets.]
translation: [望向海面。天气晴好,与镇上灰扑扑的街道全然不同。]

text: [Look out across the sea. Recall what was done to me beneath it.]
translation: [望向海面。回想大海之下,曾有人对我做过的事。]

text: [Losing hand] I have nothing here of any worth.
translation: [败局] 我手里什么值钱的也没有。

text: [Léon is far behind.]
translation: [莱昂已经远远落在后面。]

text: [Léon looks faintly disappointed, then rallies.]
translation: [莱昂看起来有一点失望，随即又振作起来。]

text: [Maintain a safe distance.]
translation: [保持安全距离。]

text: [Martyr's palm; saint's halo.]
translation: [殉道者的棕榈;圣徒的光环。]

text: [Match her smile.] Can we say: a favour for a favour?
translation: [回她一个微笑。]「我们能不能说:一桩人情,换一桩人情?」

text: [Mathis blinks slowly in response to my curtness. With insolent deliberation, he steps back to let me pass.]
translation: [马蒂斯对我生硬的回应缓缓眨了眨眼。他带着傲慢的从容,退后一步让我过去。]

text: [Mathis does not seem excited by my return.]
translation: [马蒂斯似乎并不为我的归来而振奋。]

text: [Mathis steps back to let me pass.]
translation: [马蒂斯退后一步,让我过去。]

text: [Mathis' eyebrows rise fractionally.]
translation: [马蒂斯的眉毛微微扬起。]

text: [Mathis' eyes flash with anger. But he says nothing.]
translation: [马蒂斯眼中闪过怒意。但他什么也没说。]

text: [Mathis' tone is still flat, but he meets my eyes now, almost courteously.]
translation: [马蒂斯的语气仍然平淡,但现在他会迎上我的目光,几乎称得上客气。]

text: [Menace] There are worse dreams you might experience, Doctor. Much, much worse dreams.
translation: 「恫吓」医生，你可能会做更可怕的梦。比这可怕得多、多得多。

text: [Menacing] That's unfortunate.
translation: [威胁] 那可真遗憾。

text: [Merchant] What do you have?
translation: [商人] 您有些什么?

text: [Mme Zèlia asked me to blight Philomèle. This is my chance.]
translation: [泽莉亚夫人嘱我向菲洛梅尔施下诅咒。这正是我的机会。]

text: [Mock indignation] 'Many years?' Mademoiselle! I reject the absurdity!
translation: [假装愤慨]「“多年”?小姐!我不接受这种荒谬!」

text: [Moth] Fascinating.
translation: [蛾] 迷人。

text: [Move closer; look at the skin of her legs.]
translation: [靠近些;看她双腿的皮肤。]

text: [Move on to other things.]
translation: [去做别的事。]

text: [Move on, up the leaf-dappled slope between stately trees, to a pair of iron gates.]
translation: [继续前行，沿庄严树木之间那条洒着叶影的坡道向上，来到一对铁门前。]

text: [Move on.]
translation: [继续走。]

text: [Mull a response.]
translation: 斟酌着如何作答。

text: [Murmur a prayer.]
translation: [低声祈祷。]

text: [Murmur a protective charm.]
translation: [低声念出一道护身咒。]

text: [My heart pulses with desperation. The night responds. Give in to that desperation.]
translation: 「我的心因绝望而搏动。夜回应了我。向那绝望屈服吧。」

text: [Neutral interpretation] 'Behold, a presentiment of roses.'
translation: 中性之解。「看哪，这玫瑰的预感。」

text: [Neutrally] You are a man of refined spirit.
translation: [语气平淡] 您是个品味高雅的人。

text: [No stories seem to be forthcoming. But Mathis is briefly lost in a pleasant reverie, and the atmosphere has thawed appreciately.]
translation: [似乎不会再有什么故事了。但马蒂斯短暂地陷入愉快的遐想,气氛明显回暖。]

text: [Nod and leave.]
translation: [点头离开。]

text: [Nod and move on.]
translation: [点头,继续。]

text: [Nod approvingly] "This horrible tearing thirst demands that you fill yourselves with wine."
translation: [赞许地点头] 『这可怕的灼渴，正催你们以酒灌满自己。』

text: [Nod confidently.]
translation: [自信地点点头。]

text: [Nod knowingly.]
translation: [心照不宣地点头。]

text: [Nod neutrally.]
translation: [平静地点头。]

text: [Nod sagaciously. Wink.]
translation: [睿智地点点头。眨眨眼。]

text: [Nod slowly.]
translation: [缓缓点头。]

text: [Nod stoically.]
translation: [坚忍地点点头。]

text: [Nod weakly.]
translation: [虚弱地点点头。]

text: [Nod. Pull a coin out of Strathcoyne's ear and offer it to him.]
translation: [点头。从斯特拉斯科因先生的耳朵里变出一枚硬币,递给他。]

text: [Nod.]
translation: [点头。]

text: [Nod; leave.]
translation: [点头;告辞。]

text: [Nod]
translation: [点头]

text: [Not yet.]
translation: [还不是时候。]

text: [The big man folds the money away with an air of complacent virtue. He is pleased, clearly, that the value of his time has been recognised.]
translation: [大汉带着一副自得的美德气派,把钱收了起来。显然他很满意,自己时间的价值终于得到了承认。]

text: [The big man scoffs.] 'I am not to be bought.' [He glances around to reassure himself that his virtue has been registered.]
translation: [大汉嗤笑一声。]『我可不是能被收买的。』[他环顾四周,好确认自己的美德已被看在眼里。]

text: [The big man softens, just a little. It is after all a golden kind of afternoon.]
translation: [大汉缓和了一些,只有一点点。毕竟这是个金光灿灿的下午。]

text: [The bleached room around me begins to flood with colour, as if paint had been dropped in clear water. I am returning to the waking world.]
translation: 「我四周惨白的房间开始涌满色彩，仿佛清水中滴入了颜料。我正要回到清醒的世界。」

text: [The bookseller raises her gaze from the newspaper.]
translation: [女书商从报纸上抬起目光。]

text: [The bookseller rests her chin on her fist and watches me. Blue smoke curls up from the cigarette in her mouth.]
translation: [女书商把下巴支在拳头上,端详着我。她叼在嘴里的香烟,升起袅袅蓝烟。]

text: [The calendrier should tell me where Nina is. I'll look in my inventory.]
translation: [那本日历应该会告诉我尼娜在哪里。我去背包里找找。]

text: [The cat does not let down its guard. The eyes continue to blaze like frightened head-lights at night. But we have established diplomatic relations.]
translation: [猫没有放松警惕。那双眼睛仍像夜里惊恐的车头灯般灼灼燃烧。但我们确立了外交关系。]

text: [The charm falters on my lips, and I find I've taken a step closer.]
translation: [咒语在唇边一顿,我发觉自己已经迈近了一步。]

text: [The eye opens very slightly wider.]
translation: [那只眼睛微微又睁大了一点。]

text: [The light doesn't dim, but it seems more remote, and the voice a little flatter. The pressure to approach eases so abruptly that I sway backwards.]
translation: [光没有变暗,却似乎更加遥远,声音也更平了些。那股催促靠近的压力骤然消解,我身形一晃,向后仰去。]

text: [The light is compellingly bright. It's difficult to look away. It would be much easier to step closer.]
translation: [那光强烈得摄人心魄。很难移开目光。迈步靠近,要容易得多。]

text: [The most Gallic of shrugs]
translation: [一个最法兰西式的耸肩]

text: [The nearest card player snuffles merrily around his pipe.]
translation: [离得最近的牌客就着烟斗，快活地吸着鼻息。]

text: [The necessary mental adjustments.]
translation: [做些必要的心理调整。]

text: [The next choice acts with a [[Passion]]. Choose a Passion you possess to refresh pips in your [[Aspect Pool]]. Choose a new one to start on the path to acquiring it - you can have up to three Passions.]
translation: [下一个选择会作用于一项[[激情]]。选择一项你已拥有的激情,可为[[性相池]]补充小点;选择一项新的,则是踏上习得它的道路——你最多可以拥有三项激情。]

text: [The night knows there is some small risk in sharing my name. But there may be no other way forward here.]
translation: [夜深知,说出自己的名字有些许风险。但眼下或许没有别的路可走。]

text: [The radio crackles and begins to fade... but almost immediately recovers. Mathis frowns, puzzled.]
translation: [收音机噼啪作响,开始变弱……但几乎立刻又恢复过来。马蒂斯皱着眉,一脸困惑。]

text: [The radio crackles, and fades abruptly to silence. The hall seems chillier. Mathis' eyes widen, and he takes a step back.]
translation: [收音机噼啪作响,骤然淡去,归于寂静。走廊似乎更冷了。马蒂斯睁大眼睛,退了一步。]

text: [The train whisle blows. The conductor is walking down the carriage, wearily bellowing. 'Mimata' he cries as he passes our compartment.]
translation: [火车汽笛鸣响。列车员拖着步子沿车厢走来，疲惫地吆喝着。经过我们的隔间时，他喊出“米玛塔”。]

text: [There's something more here...]
translation: [这里还有些别的……]

text: [These Opportunities await if you can  find a suitable place.]
translation: [若能觅得合适之地，这些机会正等着你。]

text: [Think things through on my way out of the office.]
translation: 在走出办公室的路上，把事情想清楚。

text: [Third class] Needs must in hard times.
translation: [三等座]时世艰难,也只能如此。

text: [This is a waste of time.]
translation: [这是在浪费时间。]

text: [This is embarrassing. I only have [q=cashState].]
translation: [真难为情。我身上只有 [q=cashState]。]

text: [This thing is not respectful. Frighten it away.]
translation: [这东西不懂规矩。把它吓走。]

text: [This will advance to the following morning, unless something wakes you in the night. Continue?]
translation: [这将推进到次日清晨，除非夜里有什么东西将你唤醒。继续？]

text: [Through glistening streets, beneath blinded windows, past scar and wailing stone, and into the sun on the other side of town.]
translation: [走过泛光的街道，经过闭目般的窗户、伤疤与哀鸣的石头，最终从城市另一头走进阳光。]

text: [To continue, explore.]
translation: [要继续,就去探索。]

text: [Toast] To Felix.
translation: [举杯] 敬费利克斯。

text: [Touch their drinks with a giddy influence, to ensure they speak freely.]
translation: [用一缕令人醺然的影响轻触他们的酒杯，好让他们畅所欲言。]

text: [True As Far As It Goes] Jaume, I was ordained at Plymouth Cathedral. Thirty years ago now.
translation: [大体属实] 若梅,我在普利茅斯大教堂受了按立。那已是三十年前的事了。

text: [Truth-ish] The seaside.
translation: 半真话。海边。

text: [Truth] Better to say, I was lost.
translation: 真话。不如说，我是迷了路。

text: [Truth] Feels right. I haven't thought too much about it.
translation: [真话] 感觉对。我没怎么细想过。

text: [Truth] I haven't really thought about it.
translation: [实话] 我还没怎么想过这件事。

text: [Truth] I know in my heart that I need to find her.
translation: [实话] 我心中明白,我必须找到她。

text: [Truth] I still haven't really thought about it.
translation: [真话] 我其实,还没好好想过这件事。

text: [Truth] I was born in Paris.
translation: [实话] 我出生在巴黎。

text: [Truth] I'm English.
translation: [实话] 我是英国人。

text: [Truth] I'm from Paris.
translation: [实话] 我来自巴黎。

text: [Truth] It's important. I heard she'd come here, to Antibes.
translation: [实话]这事很重要。我听说她来了这里,昂蒂布。

text: [Truth] Let's say I'm following my heart.
translation: [真话]就当我是在跟随内心吧。

text: [Truth] Of course not.
translation: [实话] 当然没有。

text: [Truth] Say rather a friendly campfire, Aristide. [Nod at his pipe.] I'll see you again.
translation: [实话] 不如说是一堆友善的篝火,阿里斯蒂德。[朝他的烟斗点点头。] 我们还会再见。

text: [Truth] There's a matter that only Nina can help with.
translation: [实话] 有件事,只有尼娜帮得上忙。

text: [Try to conceal a momentary fumble.]
translation: [试着掩饰一瞬间的手忙脚乱。]

text: [Turn an imaginary key in the lock of my mouth; drop the imaginary key into Aristide's pastis.]
translation: [在我嘴上的锁孔里转动一把想象中的钥匙;再把那把想象中的钥匙丢进阿里斯蒂德的茴香酒里。]

text: [Turn and leave without a word.]
translation: 转身，一言不发地离开。

text: [Turn away from the window.]
translation: [从彩窗前转过身去。]

text: [Turn away.]
translation: [转身走开。]

text: [Turn my face up to the sun. Close my eyes.]
translation: [把脸迎向太阳。闭上眼睛。]

text: [Turn to the radio. Silence it with a pale phrase.]
translation: [转向收音机。用一个苍白的短句让它归于寂静。]

text: [Under this focused beam of bonhomie, Mathis unbends very slightly.] Euh.
translation: [在这道热忱的目光之下,马蒂斯稍稍松弛了些。]呃。

text: [Unleash my most charming smile and reach to shake his hand] Thank you so much for your help earlier. I've spoken to the doctor.
translation: [绽放我最迷人的微笑,伸手去握他的手] 太感谢您之前的帮助了。我已经和医生谈过了。

text: [Until then.]
translation: [到那时再说。]

text: [Use the alarm clock before you sleep, if you want to wake in the middle of the night and prowl round the Sanitarium unobserved.]
translation: [若想在半夜醒来、神不知鬼不觉地巡游疗养院，请在睡前使用闹钟。]

text: [Use up a Razor Blade.]
translation: [消耗一片剃刀刀片。]

text: [View black market goods.]
translation: [查看黑市货物。]

text: [Vincent guffaws.] My lieutenant - we were in the Légion!
translation: [文森特放声大笑。]我的中尉——我们可是在军团里待过的人!

text: [Vincent has joined you as a companion, and will assist with Skill challenges where he can.]
translation: [文森特已成为你的同伴,会在力所能及处协助你应对技艺挑战。]

text: [Vincent leans forward and whispers:] It got into my dreams, last time.
translation: [文森特探过身来,低声说:]上次,它钻进了我的梦里。

text: [Vincent shivers - though with what emotion is not immediately obvious.]
translation: [文森特打了个寒颤——至于那是出于何种情绪,一时还看不分明。]

text: [Wait for him to finish]
translation: [等他把话说完]

text: [Wait for the shadows to deepen before I step through to the kitchen.]
translation: [等阴影渐浓,再迈步进入厨房。]

text: [Wait impassively. Don't rise to the bait.]
translation: [无动于衷地等着。不上钩。]

text: [Wait. Employ a little magic of transgression to enter the kitchen.]
translation: [等着。动用一点逾越的魔法进入厨房。]

text: [Wait. When Linou is distracted, exit stage right.]
translation: [等着。趁利努分神之际,从舞台右侧退场。]

text: [Wait.]
translation: [等候。]

text: [Wary] ...I'll eat later.
translation: [警惕地]……我待会儿再吃。

text: [Watch him in silence.]
translation: 「沉默地注视着他。」

text: [Watch them.]
translation: [注视着它们。]

text: [Wave the matter away.]
translation: [摆摆手,拂开这个话题。]

text: [We won't usually tell you explicitly which choices act with which Passions - we let you roleplay, or guess.]
translation: [我们通常不会明确告诉你们,哪些选择对应哪些激情——我们让你们自己去扮演,或者自己猜。]

text: [We'll both travel in first class! Pay one thousand seven hundred and fifty francisques. Vincent will pay towards his own ticket.]
translation: [我们俩都坐一等座!付一千七百五十枚法兰西斧币,文森特为他的票分担一部分。]

text: [We'll both travel in second class. Pay seven hundred and fifty francisques. Vincent will pay towards his own ticket.]
translation: [我们俩都坐二等座。付七百五十枚法兰西斧币,文森特为他的票分担一部分。]

text: [We'll both travel in third class. Pay two hundred and fifty francisques. Vincent will pay for his own ticket.]
translation: [我们俩都坐三等座。付二百五十枚法兰西斧币,文森特自己付自己的票钱。]

text: [We'll rarely be explicit about how your earlier choices play into consequences. But we wanted to confirm that even tiny choices sometimes have some tiny relevance.]
translation: [我们很少明言,你此前的选择会如何演变为后果。但我们想让你确认:即便是微小的选择,有时也会有微小的牵系。]

text: [Welcome to Travelling at Night.]
translation: [欢迎来到Travelling at Night.]

text: [What does it remind me of?]
translation: [它让我想起了什么?]

text: [When I lift the drape, the light from beneath is enthrallingly bright. But I place the coin and step back before my mind can drift.]
translation: [我掀开幕布,底下溢出的光令人心神俱醉。但在心神游走之前,我放下钱币,退后一步。]

text: [Whirr. Click. Whirr.]
translation: [嗡鸣。咔嗒。嗡鸣。]

text: [Whistle jauntily.]
translation: [轻快地吹口哨。]

text: [Wink saucily.]
translation: [俏皮地眨了眨眼。]

text: [Wink. Begin to whistle a martial tune. Drum my fingers on the Bewitching tool.]
translation: [眨眨眼。开始吹一段军乐口哨。手指在魅惑工具上敲出节奏。]

text: [Wink.]
translation: [眨眨眼。]

text: [Winning hand] A natural!
translation: [胜局] 天牌!

text: [Winning smile] Relax, Doctor. You're asleep! This isn't the time to worry.
translation: 「胜券在握的微笑」放松，医生。你睡着了！现在不是担心的时候。

text: [Winter] All that optimism, and then the Wars. Everything is worse than when I went away.
translation: [冬] 那样多的乐观,然后便是战争。一切都不如我离去之时。

text: [Winter] Hideous.
translation: [冬] 丑陋。

text: [Winter] I remember the sorrows of the Great War...
translation: [冬] 我记起大战中的种种悲伤……

text: [Winter] It's just a forest at night. Not everything is occult.
translation: [冬] 不过是夜晚的森林。并非一切皆为玄秘。

text: [Winter] Peaceful.
translation: [冬] 安宁。

text: [Wipe my mouth and push the plate away.]
translation: [擦擦嘴,推开盘子。]

text: [Withdraw, for the moment.]
translation: [暂且告退。]

text: [Withdraw.]
translation: [退开。]

text: [Yawn rudely.]
translation: [粗鲁地打了个哈欠。]

text: [Yes, this is clearly acceptable. Quite acceptable.]
translation: [对,这显然可以。相当可以。]

text: [Yes: this response was conditioned by your choice when you came to Antibes.]
translation: [是:这条回应取决于你抵达昂蒂布时的选择。]

text: [You are Compassionate, now. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson]
translation: 「如今，你心怀悲悯。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

text: [You can now don the Father's Day outfit at a Wardrobe.]
translation: [你现在可以在衣橱换上「父亲节」套装了。]

text: [You can now don the Honneur et Humanité outfit at a Wardrobe.]
translation: [你现在可以在衣柜处穿上 '荣誉与人性' 套装。]

text: [You can now don the Man of Mystery outfit at a Wardrobe.]
translation: [你现在可以在衣橱换上「谜样男子」套装了。]

text: [You can now don the Summer Frivolity outfit at a Wardrobe.]
translation: [你现在可以在衣柜处穿上 '夏日轻狂' 套装。]

text: [You can now don the Trenchcoat Brigade outfit at a Wardrobe.]
translation: [你现在可以在衣橱换上「风衣纵队」套装了。]

text: [You could use a Wither item to this end. It could bring this Philomèle nightmares and bad fortune - sicken and immiserate her. It wouldn't kill her unless she's very weak. But it wouldn't be very nice.]
translation: [你可以用一件凋零之物来达成此事。它能给这个菲洛梅尔带来噩梦与厄运——令她染病、陷入困顿。除非她虚弱至极，否则不会要她的命。但这终究算不上光彩。]

text: [You have resolved to follow your Ambition. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation: 「你已决心追随自己的野心。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

text: [You'll do your best to be Honourable. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation: 「你将竭尽全力做个荣誉之人。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

text: [You're Whimsical now. At least until you're not.]
translation: 「你如今满怀奇想。至少，在不再奇想之前。」

text: [You're following your Curiosity wherever it might lead. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation: 「你正追随自己的好奇，无论它将通往何方。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

text: [You're surrendering to your Appetite. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation: 「你正臣服于自己的欲望。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

text: [You've acknowledged your Sorrow. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation: 「你已正视自己的悲伤。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

text: [You've rejected this Passion. If you act similarly again, you'll have the opportunity to reconsider - as long as you still have a free Passion slot.]
translation: 「你已摒弃这项激情。若你再次做出类似之举，将有机会重新考虑——只要你还有空余的激情位。」

text: [Your Anger burns furiously now. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation: 「你的愤怒如今熊熊燃烧。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

text: [[Gwendolen]] had one. She enjoyed its intricacies and described its alarm function in unnerving detail.
translation: [[格温德琳]]也有过一个。她喜爱其中的精巧繁复，还把它的闹钟功能描述得细致到令人不安。

text: [[Long]] whose patrons are dead or [[Uncounted]]. Their strength ebbs. Old age waits for them, if death doesn't find them first.
translation: 庇护[[司辰]]已死或被[[除名]]的[[长生者]]。他们的力量正在衰退。即便死亡不先找上他们，衰老也在等着他们。

text: [[Moth]] is drawn to the light; but look to the [[Cross]], children of difference, for [[History]].
translation: [[蛾]]为光所吸引;但若想寻得[[历史]],当看向[[介壳种]]——他们是差异之子。

text: [[Nina Lagasse]] was seen entering the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui. In the Cap d'Antibes, just past the park.
translation: 「有人看见[[尼娜·拉加斯]]走进了今日疗养院。在昂蒂布海岬,过了公园就是。」

text: [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: [[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

text: [[Nina Lagasse]]. Again.
translation: [[尼娜·拉加斯]]。还是她。

text: [[Nina Lagasse]]. And whatever cash you might have in that desk of yours.
translation: [[尼娜·拉加斯]]。还有你那张书桌里可能放着的现钞。

text: [[Nina Lagasse]]...
translation: [[尼娜·拉加斯]]……

text: [[Serena]] [[Blackwood]] serves as its Librarian.
translation: [[塞蕾娜]][[布莱克伍德]]担任其馆长。

text: [q=Dread] Dread - I'm growing Uneasy.
translation: [q=Dread] 恐惧——我渐渐感到不安。

text: [q=Dread] Dread is enough to take me from Unease to Despondency.
translation: [q=Dread] 恐惧足以把我从不安推向沮丧。

text: [q=Dread] Dread! I'm falling into Despair.
translation: [q=Dread] 恐惧!我正坠入绝望。

text: [q=Dread] Dread: I'm feeling Despondent.
translation: [q=Dread] 恐惧:我感到沮丧。

text: [q=Dread] Dread: I'm no longer Despondent.
translation: [q=Dread] 恐惧:我不再沮丧。

text: [q=Fascination] Fascination is enough to tip me over from Chrysophoria to Chrysolagnia, where the world grows more golden. I rather like it.
translation: [q=Fascination] 入迷足以把我从迷金症倾覆入恋金癖——彼时,世界变得更加金光粲然。我倒颇为中意。

text: [q=Fascination] Fascination: Chrysophoria, the first stage of a kind of delirium...
translation: [q=Fascination] 入迷:迷金症——某种谵妄的第一阶段……

text: [q=Fascination] Fascination: I'm feeling Chrysolagnic.
translation: [q=Fascination] 入迷:我感到恋金癖发作了。

text: [q=Fascination] Fascination: I'm no longer Chrysolagnic.
translation: [q=Fascination] 入迷:我不再恋金。

text: [q=Pain] Pain is enough to tip me over from Twinges to Injuries.
translation: [q=Pain] 痛苦足以把我从隐痛推向伤痛。

text: [q=Pain] Pain! My body is flooded with Agony!
translation: [q=Pain] 痛苦!剧痛淹没了我的身体!

text: [q=Pain] Pain. I'm suffering Twinges.
translation: [q=Pain] 痛苦。我正隐隐作痛。

text: [q=Pain] Pain. My Agony is gone.
translation: [q=Pain] 痛苦。剧痛已经消失。

text: [q=Pain] Pain: I'm feeling Injured.
translation: [q=Pain] 痛苦:我感到受伤了。

text: [q=Pain] Pain: I'm no longer Injured.
translation: [q=Pain] 痛苦:我不再受伤。

text: [q=Weariness] Weariness - I'm Exhausted!
translation: [q=Weariness] 倦怠——我已筋疲力尽!

text: [q=Weariness] Weariness is enough to make me Languorous.
translation: [q=Weariness] 倦怠足以让我慵懒。

text: [q=Weariness] Weariness is enough to tip me over from Languor to Drowsiness.
translation: [q=Weariness] 倦怠足以把我从慵懒推向困倦。

text: [q=Weariness] Weariness: I'm feeling Drowsy.
translation: [q=Weariness] 倦怠:我感到困倦。

translation: [q=alias.familiar]！

‘With us of the River,’ Sulinor volunteered, ‘we say: “I sleep; presently I row again.”’

‘Ah! At our end of the world we cry: “Gods, judge me not as a God, but a man whom the Ocean has broken.”’ Baeticus looked at Quabil, who answered, raising his cup: ‘We Sidonians say, “Mother of Carthage, I return my oar!” But it all comes to the one in the end.’
translation:
「我们这些河上之人,」苏利诺主动说道,「常说:『我睡去;不久我便再次摇桨。』」

「啊!在我们那世界的尽头,我们高呼:『众神啊,莫以神的标准审判我,只当我是被大洋击碎的一个凡人。』」拜提库斯望向夸比尔,后者举起酒杯答道:「我们西顿人会说,『迦太基之母,我归还我的船桨!』但归根结底,说来说去终归是一回事。」

“Are we dead yet?” someone would ask.
Then with a plastic toothpick
I’d draw blood from my little finger
to prove we were still among the living.
translation:
「我们死了吗?」总有人会问。
然后我会用一根塑料牙签
从小指上刺出血来
证明我们依然活在人间。

text: “Work, Family, Homeland.” When the Republic fell, the rump government in the south joined forces with the Enemy, preserving a kind of independence as l’Etat Francais. As the Enemy retreated, the State joined instead with the Allies, to preserve its indepennce again. And so poor France is sundered still, with Darlan and De Gaulle the bitterest enemies.
translation: 「劳动、家庭、祖国。」共和国倾覆后,南方残余政府与敌人联手,以法兰西国的名号保住了某种独立。敌人退却后,邦国又转而与盟友结盟,再次保住了自身的独立。于是可怜的法国至今仍被割裂,达尔朗与戴高乐成了最不共戴天的仇敌。
